body:
Thank you so much for sticking by me.
| | |

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96367976/509770674/175992266?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3027-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDQvMS84ODk1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MTk3NzQxYy1hZTk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zlBaIYTQpfDYyI21tQP46v1Ffg8SN2jtQ5TOV4nZxiE=)
Can I explain something, folks?
I grew up in a 24-by-36 foot house. I lost three fingers on my left hand in a meat grinding accident when I was a kid. I am and always will be a farmer, like my folks and my grandparents before me.

**In fact, I’m very proud to be the U.S. Senate’s only working dirt farmer.**
Every spring, I spend a lot of weeks working the stubble, getting equipment ready for planting, and out in the field seeding. Come summer, I am out there harvesting. I maintain my own heavy equipment and deliver my grain in a truck that’s a bit bigger than what any of my colleagues drive.

I buy grease by the case and seeds by the ton. I butcher my own beef. My wife, Sharla, and I work the farm hand-in-hand.
The task of scheduling my work in the Senate around the inflexible timing of farm responsibilities drives my staff crazy — but they know my farm work is non-negotiable. It keeps me, quite literally, grounded.

**And rather than spend my days hobnobbing with special interests, I rely on hardworking folks like you to power everything we do.**
**[That’s why I’m personally asking you to join my reelection team and split $5 between Jeanne Shaheen and my campaign today to help us defend Montana’s Senate seat. Anything you can give makes a difference.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96367979/509770677/175992266?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&amount=5&refcode=jtk3027-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDQvMS84ODk1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MTk3NzQxYy1hZTk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zlBaIYTQpfDYyI21tQP46v1Ffg8SN2jtQ5TOV4nZxiE=)** | | [Contribute](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96367982/509770680/175992266?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk3027-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDQvMS84ODk1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MTk3NzQxYy1hZTk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zlBaIYTQpfDYyI21tQP46v1Ffg8SN2jtQ5TOV4nZxiE=)

With Election Day right around the corner, I’m reaching out to see if you will join the Jane Fonda Climate PAC and PCCC in supporting a slate of climate champions in the final stretch of this critical election. [_**I want to tell you more about why I’m so excited to support these candidates, but first, can you chip in $20 to split a contribution for these candidates ahead of Election Day?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96368615/509784811/165661984?refcode=email_110124_kmr-fonda-split&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0YTRhZThiYS1iMTk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aLTR9M6j6oiMsGkQnZgHrZcd2XWoCQKjMJR663pUGdc=) I’m excited to team up with the PCCC to support a slate of incredible climate candidates running in competitive congressional races who are committed to tackling the climate crisis, including standing up to powerful special interests like the fossil fuel industry. These candidates need our help:
* **Kristen McDonald Rivet is running to flip Michigan’s 8th Congressional District**. In the state senate, Kristen helped pass ambitious clean energy legislation to address the climate crisis, create clean jobs, and save Michiganders money. She also secured funding to replace lead pipes and ensure kids have clean drinking water at schools.

* **Dave Min is running for California’s 47th Congressional District**. As a state senator, Dave chaired the Natural Resources and Water Committee and introduced legislation to terminate offshore oil and gas leases and secured funding to improve beaches.

* **Andrea Salinas is running for re-election in Oregon’s 6th Congressional District**. In Congress Andrea has been a tireless champion for our environment and the well-being of the entire Pacific Northwest. She’s fighting for a clean energy future for her daughter and all Americans. In 2022 Andrea won by less than three points, so it’s critical we defend her seat this year.

Corporate special interests and far-right extremists are pouring millions into these races to defeat these progressive climate champions. Hey, team – it’s Mark.

**We’re now just 100 hours until the election, and let me make one thing clear, Peter:** The momentum is on our side. Both in the race for the White House, and in key battleground House districts across the country.

And with just 4 Democratic flips needed for Democrats to take control of the House, the fate of the election could come down to turnout here in California.

So we’re knocking on doors, placing yard signs, and running through the tape to make sure Democrats turnout in droves on Tuesday.

[**We’re in the driver’s seat, but we need to keep our foot on the gas, Peter! Will you chip in $7 toward our $2,000 final fundraising goal & help fund our critical GOTV efforts through Election Day? »**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96369114/509800582/238616526?amount=7&refcode=MTFC_20241101_EMDF_E2_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM2MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MGU1M2I0YS1iNjk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=q935CG9fcRQ-Rvk5NzkAgck4CnSt3m_XUNj9A_pJXxQ=) | [CHIP IN $7 TO SUPPORT OUR VOTER TURNOUT OPERATION »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96369115/509800583/238616526?amount=7&amounts=10,25,50,100&refcode=MTFC_20241101_EMDF_E2_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM2MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MGU1M2I0YS1iNjk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=q935CG9fcRQ-Rvk5NzkAgck4CnSt3m_XUNj9A_pJXxQ=)

body:
Secret Service Corruption EXPOSED

[INSIDE JW]

Historic Judicial Watch Victory: Federal Appeals Court Rules Against
Counting of Ballots Received after Election Day

[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70933&L=33796&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cueW91dHViZS5jb20vd2F0Y2g/dj1QWEhLY2p5bkJndyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=1c8a2a3f0cbca7cb29dcc43ccbd1bff6e239f6e91764d6721af4268606feff2d]
In a huge victory for election integrity, the U.S. Court of Appeals
for the Fifth Circuit issued an opinion
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70933&L=33747&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2xpYmVydGFyaWFuLXBhcnR5LW9mLW1pc3Npc3NpcHBpLXYtd2V0emVsLWV0LWFsLW9waW5pb24tMDAwMzctNjAzOTUvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=cdc8cea64eee2b8dc8516ec0a0fc06ed0c5c752d062fd35f924a9bea2e9d8007]
reversing a lower court ruling on Mississippi’s election law that
permitted absentee ballots to be received as late as five business
days after Election Day.

Earlier this year, your Judicial Watch filed a civil rights lawsuit
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70933&L=31320&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvY291bnRpbmctYmFsbG90cy1hZnRlci1lbGVjdGlvbi8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=30445c04db80403014cf6801c0a539109bdf148b2ee17d0c66123ba49e0dfac1]
challenging the Mississippi election law on behalf of the Libertarian
Party of Mississippi (_Libertarian Party of Mississippi v Wetzel et
al._
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70933&L=31309&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2xpYmVydGFyaWFuLXBhcnR5LW9mLW1zLXYtd2V0emVsLWV0LWFsLWVsZWN0aW9uLWRheS1jb21wbGFpbnQtMDAwMzcvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=8b17a67db0b78887d0c4e1b32c94a7094cecaf7f1d08afbcdb222102c195103c]
(No. 1:24-cv-00037)). The court consolidated the case we filed with
one filed by the Republican National Committee, the Mississippi
Republican Party, and other complainants.

(Judicial Watch filed the first challenge
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70933&L=27407&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvbGF3c3VpdC1hZ2FpbnN0LWlsbGlub2lzLXRvLXN0b3AtY291bnRpbmctb2YtYmFsbG90cy1hZnRlci1lbGVjdGlvbi1kYXkvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=1b8b2e7ef9a18e3f797a44d49d3fad7b007089973d519a020f4f559472dd9712]
to require all ballots be received by Election Day in 2022 against
Illinois.)

The Fifth Circuit opinion states in part:

> Congress statutorily designated a singular “day for the
> election” of members of Congress and the appointment of
> presidential electors. Text, precedent, and historical practice
> confirm this “day for the election” is the day by which ballots
> must be both cast by voters and received by state officials. Because
> Mississippi’s statute allows ballot receipt up to five days after
> the federal election day, it is preempted by federal law. We reverse
> the district court’s contrary judgment and remand for further
> proceedings.
We argued that holding voting open for five days past Election Day
violates the constitutional rights of voters and candidates:

> Counting untimely, illegal, and invalid votes, such as those
> received in violation of federal law, substantially increases the
> pool of total votes cast and dilutes the weight of votes cast by
> Plaintiff’s members and others in support of Plaintiff’s federal
> nominees.
The complaint details that as many as 1.7% of votes cast in
Mississippi in 2020 were received after Election Day.

In our appeal filings
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70933&L=33274&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2xpYmVydGFyaWFuLXBhcnR5LXYtd2V0emVsLWFwcGVhbC1kb2NzLTczLTc0LTAwMDM3LTYwMzk1Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=de51263bab9da7114d450374580fc8e619e8d9d3d6f86f7552c016afa1b7a296],
we explained that the Mississippi law extending Election Day is
obviously at odds with federal law. The Fifth Circuit hearing can be
found here
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70933&L=33522&F=T&drurl=aHR0cDovL3d3dy5jYTUudXNjb3VydHMuZ292L29yYWwtYXJndW1lbnQtaW5mb3JtYXRpb24vY291cnQtY2FsZW5kYXJzL0RldGFpbHMvMTc5MC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=5d933be9f9c4d59547e517b1a479e1f62505d17f2e1ac55d9d15b9fc3a7965b8].
This is a historic victory for election integrity and voter rights and
confidence. This is a precedent that ensures that only ballots that
arrive by Election Day can be counted under federal law. We hope this
begins a national movement to increase voter confidence, comply with
federal law, and limit voter fraud by counting ballots that arrive
only by Election Day.

We are a national leader in voting integrity and voting rights. As
part of its work, Judicial Watch assembled a team of highly
experienced voting rights attorneys who stopped discriminatory
elections in Hawaii, and cleaned up voter rolls in California, Ohio,
Indiana, and Kentucky, among other achievements
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70933&L=21208&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvdGFnL252cmEvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=6895639061ab0e9dd273a0f81e79d0c7c0d5d5fea1149f126ef741e00ac8c21d].

Robert Popper, a Judicial Watch senior attorney, leads its election
law program. Popper was previously in the Voting Section of the Civil
Rights Division of the Justice Department, where he managed voting
rights investigations, litigations, consent decrees, and settlements
in dozens of states.

In a similar lawsuit, in 2022, we, on behalf of Congressman Mike Bost
and two other registered voters, sued
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70933&L=27407&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvbGF3c3VpdC1hZ2FpbnN0LWlsbGlub2lzLXRvLXN0b3AtY291bnRpbmctb2YtYmFsbG90cy1hZnRlci1lbGVjdGlvbi1kYXkvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=1b8b2e7ef9a18e3f797a44d49d3fad7b007089973d519a020f4f559472dd9712]
Illinois for allowing vote-by-mail ballots (even those without
postmarks) to be counted if received up to 14 calendar days after
Election Day if the ballots are dated on or before Election Day.

In May 2024, we sued
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70933&L=32338&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvY2FsaWZvcm5pYS1jbGVhbi11cC12b3Rpbmctcm9sbHMvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=43118f5469b09d5a03dd6c0922ba3e0197ee76e0636575890f560ca9c7026755]
California under the National Voter Registration Act
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70933&L=435&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVzdGljZS5nb3YvY3J0L25hdGlvbmFsLXZvdGVyLXJlZ2lzdHJhdGlvbi1hY3QtMTk5My1udnJhP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=f158da4a5ae1de35e565a6a8f53da89cd8322253d93d918bf210c72ca3be414b]
of 1993 (NVRA) to force it to clean up its voter rolls. The lawsuit,
filed on behalf of the Libertarian Party of California, asks the court
to compel California to make “a reasonable effort to remove the
registrations of ineligible registrants from the voter rolls” as
required by federal law (_Judicial Watch Inc. and the Libertarian
Party of CA v. Shirley Weber et al._
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70933&L=32353&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtd2ViZXItY2EtbnZyYS1jb21wbGFpbnQtMzc1MC8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=e1b1d4be2f932dadc091edcaea65d59d644a08fdfbe6395256c56543e625bc64]
(No. 2:24-cv-3750)).

In March 2024, we, Breakthrough Ideas, Illinois Family Action, and
Carol J. Davis sued
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70933&L=31560&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvaWxsaW5vaXMtdm90aW5nLXJvbGxzLz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=b9d889574013d51b5bb2a699b8d7eb63339c216bd80c8fc0830a6ff6ae1bf019]
Illinois
officials under the NVRA to force them to clean the State’s voter
rolls. (_Judicial Watch Inc., et al., v. Illinois State Board of
Elections, et al._
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70933&L=31545&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL2p3LXYtaWxsaW5vaXMtYm9hcmQtb2YtZWxlY3Rpb25zLWNvbXBsYWludC0wMTg2Ny8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=16428315e1a3dc5aa1a52e0025afa58f93fe983bcd5f4115a9b6f427df2cd076]
(No. 1:24-cv-01867).

In December 2023, a notice letter was
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70933&L=30885&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZGMtcmVtb3ZpbmctMTAzMDAwLWluZWxpZ2libGUtbmFtZXMvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=e81fbc7d3f8c3674910717882ce9fea86877f982d87ca6a7e38997b95e9101a3]
sent to election officials in the District of Columbia notifying them
of evident violations of the NVRA, based on their failure to remove
inactive voters from their registration rolls. The letter pointed out
that D.C. publicly reported removing few or no ineligible voter
registrations under a key provision of the NVRA. The letter threatened
a federal lawsuit unless the violations were corrected in a timely
fashion. In response to Judicial Watch’s inquiries, Washington, DC,
officials admitted that they had not complied with the NVRA, promptly
removed 65,544 outdated names from the voting rolls, promised to
remove 37,962 more, and designated another 73,522 registrations as
“inactive.”

In July 2023 we filed
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70933&L=29970&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvbWFpbmUtdm90ZXItcmVnaXN0cmF0aW9uLWxpc3QvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=0b13c12f3504e68c91f3c5e70822048a7bc16418245a735031cebe3e21a461d2]
an
_amicus curiae_ (friend of the court) brief
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70933&L=29957&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9jdW1lbnRzL3BpbGYtdi1iZWxsb3dzLW1haW5lLW52cmEtYW1pY3VzLTEzNjEvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=4302ed96bdee2727637b66a0f7b030bdf6b41c1406de46ddda073ea76c176150],
supporting the decision
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70933&L=29958&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9jYXNldGV4dC5jb20vY2FzZS9wdWItaW50ZXJlc3QtbGVnYWwtZm91bmQtdi1iZWxsb3dzLTM/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=3930c18c376ec71eff7127724e779880657957907370186cebae2f3cef39feed]
of
the U.S. District Court for the District of Maine, which struck down
Maine’s policy restricting the use and distribution of the state’s
voter registration list (_Public Interest Legal Foundation v. Shenna
Bellows_
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70933&L=29959&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly9kb2NrZXRzLmp1c3RpYS5jb20vZG9ja2V0L2NpcmN1aXQtY291cnRzL2NhMS8yMy0xMzYxP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=c7bc48c30d457a40723a9981bc38571bfe62c8a74e51658f99c7a5d3807a4828]
(No.
23-1361). According to a national study
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70933&L=29960&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvbmV3LWp3LXN0dWR5LXZvdGVyLXJlZ2lzdHJhdGlvbi8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=a43d7948c16cf1c66508bc6ec2ed6509b83546b9a935d7f32419f8cbfafca884]
conducted by Judicial Watch in 2020, Maine’s statewide registration
rate was 101% of eligible voters.

Judicial Watch in July 2023 also settled
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70933&L=29899&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvaWxsaW5vaXMtc2V0dGxlcy12b3Rlci1yb2xsLWxhd3N1aXQvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXdlZWtseSt1cGRhdGUmdXRtX3Rlcm09bWVtYmVycw==&hash=e9fe86b6ffc691611a0ad5b82b2d00d649a46ff71a19a63eec1320d04c5b286c]
a
federal election integrity lawsuit on behalf of the Illinois
Conservative Union against the state of Illinois, the Illinois State
Board of Elections, and its director, which now grants access to the
current centralized statewide list of registered voters for the state
for the past 15 elections.

In April 2023, Pennsylvania settled
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70933&L=29522&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvcGVubnN5bHZhbmlhLXNldHRsZXMtdm90ZXItcm9sbC1sYXdzdWl0Lz91dG1fc291cmNlPWRlcGxveWVyJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NvbnRlbnQ9QU1qY3dPRGs1TlRRJTNEJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj13ZWVrbHkrdXBkYXRlJnV0bV90ZXJtPW1lbWJlcnM=&hash=b33f9b5e5f1a5e111c3a1560505b53cf54fa81004f211534520c105700c0a578]
with us and admitted in court filings that it removed 178,258
ineligible registrations in response to communications from us. The
settlement commits Pennsylvania and five of its counties to extensive
public reporting of statistics regarding their ongoing voter roll
clean-up efforts for the next five years.

In March 2023, Colorado agreed
[https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=70933&L=29191&F=T&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvY29sb3JhZG8tdG8tc2V0dGxlLWxhd3N1aXQtb3Zlci1pbmVsaWdpYmxlLXZvdGVycy8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249d2Vla2x5K3VwZGF0ZSZ1dG1fdGVybT1tZW1iZXJz&hash=f7260ef63b15ec87f6d3c20cddc85a268ea7c93313b47b76439fc1861bc9d82c]
to settle our NVRA lawsuit alleging that Colorado failed to remove
ineligible voters from its rolls. The settlement agreement requires
Colorado to provide us with the most recent voter roll data for each

clean_body: Secret Service Corruption EXPOSED [INSIDE JW] Historic Judicial Watch Victory: Federal Appeals Court Rules Against Counting of Ballots Received after Election Day [] In a huge victory for election integrity, the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit issued an opinion [] reversing a lower court ruling on Mississippi’s election law that permitted absentee ballots to be received as late as five business days after Election Day. Earlier this year, your Judicial Watch filed a civil rights lawsuit [] challenging the Mississippi election law on behalf of the Libertarian Party of Mississippi (Libertarian Party of Mississippi v Wetzel et al. [] (No. 1:24-cv-00037)). The court consolidated the case we filed with one filed by the Republican National Committee, the Mississippi Republican Party, and other complainants. (Judicial Watch filed the first challenge [] to require all ballots be received by Election Day in 2022 against Illinois.) The Fifth Circuit opinion states in part: Congress statutorily designated a singular “day for the election” of members of Congress and the appointment of presidential electors. Text, precedent, and historical practice confirm this “day for the election” is the day by which ballots must be both cast by voters and received by state officials. Because Mississippi’s statute allows ballot receipt up to five days after the federal election day, it is preempted by federal law. We reverse the district court’s contrary judgment and remand for further proceedings. We argued that holding voting open for five days past Election Day violates the constitutional rights of voters and candidates: Counting untimely, illegal, and invalid votes, such as those received in violation of federal law, substantially increases the pool of total votes cast and dilutes the weight of votes cast by Plaintiff’s members and others in support of Plaintiff’s federal nominees. The complaint details that as many as 1.7% of votes cast in Mississippi in 2020 were received after Election Day. In our appeal filings [], we explained that the Mississippi law extending Election Day is obviously at odds with federal law. The Fifth Circuit hearing can be found here []. This is a historic victory for election integrity and voter rights and confidence. This is a precedent that ensures that only ballots that arrive by Election Day can be counted under federal law. We hope this begins a national movement to increase voter confidence, comply with federal law, and limit voter fraud by counting ballots that arrive only by Election Day. We are a national leader in voting integrity and voting rights. As part of its work, Judicial Watch assembled a team of highly experienced voting rights attorneys who stopped discriminatory elections in Hawaii, and cleaned up voter rolls in California, Ohio, Indiana, and Kentucky, among other achievements []. Robert Popper, a Judicial Watch senior attorney, leads its election law program. Popper was previously in the Voting Section of the Civil Rights Division of the Justice Department, where he managed voting rights investigations, litigations, consent decrees, and settlements in dozens of states. In a similar lawsuit, in 2022, we, on behalf of Congressman Mike Bost and two other registered voters, sued [] Illinois for allowing vote-by-mail ballots (even those without postmarks) to be counted if received up to 14 calendar days after Election Day if the ballots are dated on or before Election Day. In May 2024, we sued [] California under the National Voter Registration Act [] of 1993 (NVRA) to force it to clean up its voter rolls. The lawsuit, filed on behalf of the Libertarian Party of California, asks the court to compel California to make “a reasonable effort to remove the registrations of ineligible registrants from the voter rolls” as required by federal law (Judicial Watch Inc. and the Libertarian Party of CA v. Shirley Weber et al. [] (No. 2:24-cv-3750)). In March 2024, we, Breakthrough Ideas, Illinois Family Action, and Carol J. Davis sued [] Illinois officials under the NVRA to force them to clean the State’s voter rolls. (Judicial Watch Inc., et al., v. Illinois State Board of Elections, et al. [] (No. 1:24-cv-01867). In December 2023, a notice letter was [] sent to election officials in the District of Columbia notifying them of evident violations of the NVRA, based on their failure to remove inactive voters from their registration rolls. The letter pointed out that D.C. publicly reported removing few or no ineligible voter registrations under a key provision of the NVRA. The letter threatened a federal lawsuit unless the violations were corrected in a timely fashion. In response to Judicial Watch’s inquiries, Washington, DC, officials admitted that they had not complied with the NVRA, promptly removed 65,544 outdated names from the voting rolls, promised to remove 37,962 more, and designated another 73,522 registrations as “inactive.” In July 2023 we filed [] an amicus curiae (friend of the court) brief [], supporting the decision [] of the U.S. District Court for the District of Maine, which struck down Maine’s policy restricting the use and distribution of the state’s voter registration list (Public Interest Legal Foundation v. Shenna Bellows [] (No. 23-1361). According to a national study [] conducted by Judicial Watch in 2020, Maine’s statewide registration rate was 101% of eligible voters. Judicial Watch in July 2023 also settled [] a federal election integrity lawsuit on behalf of the Illinois Conservative Union against the state of Illinois, the Illinois State Board of Elections, and its director, which now grants access to the current centralized statewide list of registered voters for the state for the past 15 elections. In April 2023, Pennsylvania settled [] with us and admitted in court filings that it removed 178,258 ineligible registrations in response to communications from us. The settlement commits Pennsylvania and five of its counties to extensive public reporting of statistics regarding their ongoing voter roll clean-up efforts for the next five years. In March 2023, Colorado agreed [] to settle our NVRA lawsuit alleging that Colorado failed to remove ineligible voters from its rolls. The settlement agreement requires Colorado to provide us with the most recent voter roll data for each Colorado county each year for six years. In February 2023, Los Angeles County confirmed [] the removal of 1,207,613 ineligible voters from its rolls since last year, under the terms of a settlement agreement [] in a federal lawsuit [] we filed in 2017. We settled [] a federal election integrity lawsuit against New York City after the city removed 441,083 ineligible names from the voter rolls and promised to take reasonable steps going forward to clean its voter registration lists. Kentucky [] also removed hundreds of thousands of old registrations after it entered into a consent decree to end another Judicial Watch lawsuit. In February 2022, we settled [] a voter roll clean-up lawsuit against North Carolina and two of its counties after North Carolina removed over 430,000 inactive registrations from its voter rolls. In March 2022, a Maryland court ruled in favor [] of our challenge to the Democratic state legislature’s “extreme” congressional-districts gerrymander. The New York Post reported [] in October 2022 that “Vice President Kamala Harris was involved in a minor car accident Monday, one that was initially — and falsely — dismissed as ‘mechanical failure.’” The driver of her SUV struck a curb hard enough “that the tire needed to be replaced, bringing the VP’s motorcade to a standstill.” NBC reported [] that the vehicle had been partially airborne. In September, following up on reports that the Biden Secret Service denied President Trump’s requests for additional Secret Service protection, we sued [] the Department of Homeland Security for all Secret Service and other records regarding potential increased protective services to former President Trump’s security detail prior to the attempt on his life at his July 13 campaign rally in Butler, Pennsylvania. In August we released records showing that the Secret Service has made it a top priority that “diversity and inclusion is not just ‘talked about’ – but demonstrated by all employees through ‘Every Action, Every Day.’” [Emphasis in original] The records show the Secret Service demands that 12 percent of its workforce be composed of “persons with disabilities,” and that it is the policy of the Secret Service to provide equal employment opportunity without regard to such non-merit factors as “disability (physical or mental).” JUDICIAL WATCH SENDS ELECTION MONITORS TO WISCONSIN, LAUNCHES NATIONAL VOTER FRAUD HOTLINE Every day brings new reports of outright election fraud in states and cities across the country. We have always been out front in uncovering election abuses, and we’re active this season. Micah Morrison, our chief investigative reporter, provides an important [ [] in Judicial Watch’s Investigative Bulletin. With the race for the presidency hurtling to the finish line, Judicial Watch will dispatch an election integrity team to Wisconsin to help ensure free and fair elections. Wisconsin is a critical swing state with [ history [] of tumultuous electoral contests. “Judicial Watch’s teams will monitor the election in Wisconsin to expose and deter any fraud,” said Judicial Watch President Tom Fitton. Improper or illegal election activities are also the focus of Judicial Watch’s new [ Integrity Hotline []. Voters who witness fraud or intimidation, or suspicious activities at polling places or with voting machines, can send details to JW election experts at ElectionLaw@JudicialWatch.org. Judicial Watch has long been a national leader in ensuring election integrity and voting rights. Judicial Watch’s election integrity team is led by [ Popper [], the former deputy chief of the Voting Section of the Civil Rights Division of the U.S. Department of Justice and a veteran poll observer. “Voter fraud in one form or another is a feature of every election,” Popper says. “It can be impersonation fraud, absentee ballot fraud, registration fraud, double voting, noncitizen voting, or voting by those ineligible under state law. It’s hard to detect and prove, especially where the law requires a showing of specific intent, but we know it is there. And sometimes fraud can swing a close election. Clean elections are a critical component of an effectively functioning democracy. Dirty elections undermine confidence in the democratic system.” A key weapon in the fight to keep elections free and fair is the National Voter Registration Act, which mandates that states make “a reasonable effort” to remove from voting rolls “the names of ineligible voters” who have been disqualified from voting due to death or change of residence. States often dodge this responsibility, creating opportunities for election fraud. Legal pressure from Judicial Watch under the NVRA has led to the removal from voter rolls of more than four million ineligible voters nationwide. JW has spearheaded major voter roll cleanups in California, New York, Pennsylvania, North Carolina, Kentucky, Colorado, and elsewhere. Cleaner voter rolls mean cleaner elections. You can learn more about JW’s voter roll cleanups [ []. Judicial Watch fights on other legal fronts as well. In 2022, we [ [] a highly partisan Maryland redistricting plan initiated by Democrats in the state legislature. Last year, we [ [] Illinois to provide more transparency in its state-wide centralized list of registered voters. Earlier this month, we [ a major victory [] when the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit reversed a lower court ruling allowing absentee ballots to be received up to five days after Election Day in Mississippi. “Congress statutorily designated a singular ‘day for the election’ of members of Congress and the appointment of presidential electors,” the Fifth Circuit noted in [ ruling []. “Text, precedent, and historical practice confirm this ‘day for the election’ is the day by which ballots must be both cast by voters and received by state officials.” Judicial Watch’s Tom Fitton hailed the ruling. “This is a historic victory for election integrity and voter rights and confidence,” Tom said. “This is a precedent that ensures that only ballots that arrive by Election Day can be counted under federal law. We hope this begins a national movement to increase voter confidence, comply with federal law, and limit voter fraud by counting ballots that arrive only by Election Day.” MASS MIGRATION IGNITES U.S. TUBERCULOSIS RESURGENCE, FOREIGNERS ACCOUNT FOR 76% OF LAST YEAR’S CASES The Biden-Harris border invasion is a public health crisis. Our Corruption Chronicles blog [ [] the truth: Besides compromising the safety of Americans by [ over half a million illegal immigrants [] with criminal records in communities throughout the United States, the Biden administration has ignited yet another crisis by failing to properly screen migrants for contagious diseases. Judicial Watch has long reported on the serious health threat presented by illegal aliens and a decade ago [ [] that tens of thousands of illegal immigrant minors (Unaccompanied Alien Children—UAC) under Obama fueled a deadly respiratory virus epidemic that struck American kids across the country and killed at least nine. Months earlier a U.S. Congressman, who is also a medical doctor, had confirmed that UAC were bringing in serious diseases including swine flu, dengue fever, tuberculosis, and Ebola virus. In a [ [] to the director of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC), the Georgia lawmaker, Phil Gingrey, warned of a “severe and dangerous” crisis because the young migrants were importing infectious diseases from Central America that are considered to be largely eradicated in the U.S. That was over a decade ago under Obama’s weak border policies and, predictably, the problem has worsened significantly during the unprecedented illegal immigration crisis that has gripped the nation under Biden and his laughable border czar, Kamala Harris. Besides the detrimental impact on national security, civilian safety, and taxpayer-funded programs (among others), mass migration is compromising health. Specifically, tuberculosis (TB), a deadly infectious disease that attacks the lungs and was once considered to be eradicated in the U.S., is on the rise. A [ [] published by the Federation for American Immigration Reform (FAIR), a nonprofit dedicated to researching immigration issues, reveals that after decades of decline TB is resurfacing in the United States. “One key factor of the resurgence of TB in the U.S. is open borders and mass immigration,” FAIR researchers found. “The massive, unregulated influx of migrants from countries with higher TB rates than the United States has helped spread the disease. Even legal immigrants and refugees—who are required to undergo medical screenings before arriving in the United States—may have latent TB which then progresses to active TB and becomes transmissible once inside the United States.” TB cases in the U.S. increased by 34% between 2020 and 2023 and the number of TB cases is now higher than pre-pandemic levels in 2019, according to figures in the report. Nationally, 76% of TB cases in 2023 occurred in foreign-born patients and counties, states as well as metropolitan areas with high foreign-born populations have larger rates of TB than those with lower foreign-born populations. “Some countries of origin for both legal and illegal aliens have TB rates as high as 60 times the U.S. rate,” the FAIR report states, adding that “the government’s health screening for TB in potential immigrants is deficient” and that some categories of illegal immigrants do not undergo any type of health screening. Besides, latent TB is not grounds for inadmissibility even though some U.S. border regions have “TB rates exceeding rates in high-risk countries such as Afghanistan, Iraq, and Lebanon,” researchers found. It is important to note that the cost of treating each case of TB is more than $20,000 and can reach over $500,000 if it is drug-resistant, FAIR points out. “Data clearly indicate that the prevalence of tuberculosis is, in part, a function of immigration,” FAIR researchers write. “Medical experts have long acknowledged this connection.” For example, in 1990 the CDC wrote that many TB cases in the U.S. occur among foreign-born people with asymptomatic infection when they entered the United States. More recently, research published by the National Institutes of Health (NIH) determined that for countries with low TB rates, “immigration is an important factor in TB epidemiology, where migrants may originate from countries with substantially higher TB burden.” Incredibly, screening procedures for illegal immigrants entering the U.S. do not adequately guard against the spread of TB even though federal law states that aliens with communicable diseases “of public significance” are inadmissible. “However, the vast majority of aliens granted visas or who otherwise enter the U.S. are never medically screened,” FAIR researchers found. “Even for those who are medically screened, the standard for admission is lax, as it only excludes active TB and allows individuals with latent TB to enter the country, resulting in the importation of latent TB into the U.S. Until next week, [Contribute] [] [advertisement] [] [32x32x1] [] [32x32x2] [] [32x32x3] [] [32x32x3] [] Judicial Watch, Inc. 425 3rd St Sw Ste 800 Washington, DC 20024 202.646.5172 © 2017 - 2024, All Rights Reserved Manage Email Subscriptions [] |

body:
Clint St Mosley: My Closing Message | | | | |
---
| | | | | **We’re Almost Home – My Closing Message**
---
| | | | | As we head into the final days of our campaign, I am humbled by all of the help and support from volunteers, Democratic clubs and donors across the district and beyond. I cannot thank you enough!
I was inspired by Kamala Harris’s closing speech Tuesday in Washington, D.C., where she clarified the differences between herself and Donald Trump. Her positive message that focused on integrity, freedom and dignity, was a stark contrast from the angry MAGA message of grievance and division we saw at Madison Square Garden.
I said at the start of my campaign that building bridges, and not burning them, is what our district needs to break through the barriers stifling progress in Washington, and I was proud to hear that message from our next president, Kamala Harris.
With your support, I hope to build those bridges alongside President Harris and Michigan’s Congressional delegation come January.
**My Promise** As the **ONLY** candidate in this race to have the support of **both** the **Business Community** _AND_**Labor Unions** , I will work across the political divide to deliver pragmatic solutions that strengthen the families and small businesses across our district. My top priorities are:
**Creating the Opportunity Economy** where every worker has a chance to succeed through tax structures and policies that increase worker income and invests in education, infrastructure and building our economy from the bottom up, and middle out.
**Lower the Cost of Living** by increasing our housing supply and helping first-time buyers purchase a home; cutting taxes for wage earners and small businesses; outlawing corporate price gouging and lowering the cost of prescription drugs.
**Protect Reproductive Freedom** to ensure that women and families have full access to reproductive healthcare so _they_ can determine how and when to start a family, and to protect the health and safety of women across America.
**Protect Worker’s Rights** by protecting access to labor unions to improve wages, worker safety, and protect pensions and retirement plans. I will also support worker training and access to college and trade schools to help lift up all wage earners.
**Wellness – mental, physical, environmental:** I will improve access to affordable mental health and wellness programs through public/private initiatives, via expanded Medicaid/Medicare access, and by protecting the Affordable Care Act. I will also ban gas and oil drilling in the Great Lakes and work to cut carbon emissions in the U.S.
**Protect schools and families from gun violence** by expanding the common sense firearms safety programs passed by Democrats here in Michigan at the federal level, while ensuring that responsible, law-abiding citizens have the ability to own and use firearms under the 2nd Amendment as before.
**Retirement and Social Security** will be promises kept, and I will ensure Michigan’s seniors have the financial resources and access to affordable healthcare from the programs they paid into, and I will further expand caps on prescription drug costs.
**Outreach & Advertising**Our final campaign push is well underway. Our voter canvassing is knocking full speed ahead in each of the seven counties of CD-9. And, our latest digital ads launched last week highlighting Lisa McClain’s MAGA agenda, holding hearings on Hunter Biden’s laptop while ignoring the families in our district that need help.
Traffic to [**Clint4Congress.com**](https://clint4congress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e73040a2243d332c2516e1117&id=30b7076852&e=21c900a6be) has tripled in the past week, and we’re looking to run a final batch of digital ads targeting school safety and reproductive rights. If you’d like to help us strengthen that buy, you can help out [**HERE**](https://clint4congress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e73040a2243d332c2516e1117&id=6e0a5c4935&e=21c900a6be).
**In Closing** Winston Churchill once said, “To each, there comes in their lifetime a special moment when they are figuratively tapped on the shoulder and offered the chance to do a very special thing, unique to them and fitted to their talents.
“What a tragedy if that moment finds them unprepared for that which could have been their finest hour.”
I thought about that passage when my wife and I discussed my run for Congress. Life sometimes taps us on the shoulder and asks us to serve, to run toward danger while others run away – and to step up and do the impossible. I think of this with our sons. Will fear keep them from taking risks to achieve their dreams, will it prevent them from answering the call?
I’ve been through a lot in my life. I’ve overcome economic uncertainty and I didn’t have many opportunities early on, but thanks to some mentors, I was able to see a future for myself. I put myself through college and began a career. And later, after I was married with young twins, I made the leap to start a business.
But never in my life have I pushed myself like I have running for Congress. The risks were high, the odds of winning were slim. Would it cost me financially or friends and relatives? We had no way of knowing what challenges lie ahead, or if I had what it took to compete.
We just did it.
On behalf of the residents of CD-9, I sincerely feel good about our odds this Tuesday and hope our efforts will bring the long-needed changes to uplift this district. But even if we don’t win the seat, we’ve still won as Democrats.
Together, we’ve inspired a renaissance that is energizing Democrats across the district to stand up and to fight for what we believe in, and to lay the foundation for a stronger, more viable CD-9 – one that will inspire more to answer that call to serve and to cultivate the resources to help them succeed.
I’m also proud that I can say to my boys, when life tapped me on the shoulder, we answered the call.
To all, I am forever grateful for all of your support and friendship.
Let’s do this!!
Clint St. MosleyDemocratic Candidate,Michigan’s 9th Congressional District

This is not a drill, folks.
_NBC News_ reports that Mitch McConnell’s Super PAC is swooping in with a MASSIVE $6.2 million TV, radio, and digital ad buy to boost my far-right opponent and flip Nevada’s Senate seat.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96369914/509810364/1399532297?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk5326-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYTMzZmNkYy1iZTk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BE4QtFi8KDPEyRRxHiynMh_Y6L8Az9OLA6QUBTNMVwM=)
This is a full-blown emergency, friend. **[We need to raise another $750,000 before midnight tonight or else my campaign will be completely drowned out. Can you please donate $5 to my campaign?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96369915/509810365/-1820320011?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk5326-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYTMzZmNkYy1iZTk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BE4QtFi8KDPEyRRxHiynMh_Y6L8Az9OLA6QUBTNMVwM=)**
| | [DONATE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96369916/509810366/1399532297?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk5326-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiYTMzZmNkYy1iZTk4LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=BE4QtFi8KDPEyRRxHiynMh_Y6L8Az9OLA6QUBTNMVwM=)

Nevada was always going to be one of the most competitive – and expensive – battleground states of this election. Our last Senate race came down to a narrow 7,928 votes – less than ONE PERCENT – and ever since, Republicans have seen it as their BEST swing state pickup opportunity.
Our grassroots team has been able to fend them off so far, but a surprise ad blitz at this phase of the election has the potential to turn the tides against us and drown us out. **Republicans have dominated early voting in Nevada – and recent election data shows me plummeting in the polls.**

NOMINATE OUR FUTURE LEADERS
Your Nominations Can Help
Drain the Swamp
Dear Peter,
President Trump, Robert F. Kennedy Jr., and the unity coalition need your help in nominating individuals of integrity and courage for over 4,000 appointments in the future Trump Administration. This isn’t the old system of backroom deals; this is your chance to shape the administration through the new [NomineesForThePeople.com](https://www.mahanow.org/r?u=gdQik7DwppSEU7VAQ-Mm9sPM5K_hVNREx9rltplBvlfnOf1Io9ych-PeO0ge_JRf9Lvf3NDlpX8RXCf5y67Uqv93RtrnOJ-6H7MWbDhxasH7Bwr00r_oqUL-T9OmMyZx&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=nominees_11_1_24_1&n=5).
**Restore America’s Health and Integrity**
The Make America Healthy Again movement isn’t just about keeping our bodies healthy and toxin-free—it’s about restoring the Republic by draining the swamp and ending corporate influence. We can’t rely on the same revolving-door D.C. crowd. We need the best public servants our country has to offer—and we believe you know who they are.
**Nominate Someone Today**
Submit your nominations for those you believe should serve. These can be public figures, those you know, or even yourself.
👉 [Submit Your Nomination Here](https://www.mahanow.org/nominees-for-the-people?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=nominees_11_1_24_1&n=6)
Nominees are needed across all areas of government such as:
* • **Health, Food, and Agriculture**
* • **Housing, Economy, and Environment & Natural Resources**
* • **Education, Labor, Peace at Home, and Peace Abroad**
* • **Technology and Government Efficiency**

Your input is essential. Please participate as soon as you can before **November 5th** to help rally and motivate our community in these final days before Election Day. Your nominations will play a role in supporting Bobby’s work on the Transition Team and within the future unity administration.
**Share This Opportunity**
Encourage friends and family to join in—share [NomineesForThePeople.com](https://www.mahanow.org/r?u=gdQik7DwppSEU7VAQ-Mm9sPM5K_hVNREx9rltplBvlfnOf1Io9ych-PeO0ge_JRf9Lvf3NDlpX8RXCf5y67Uqv93RtrnOJ-6H7MWbDhxasH7Bwr00r_oqUL-T9OmMyZx&e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=nominees_11_1_24_1&n=7) widely so others can nominate and comment on future leaders too.
We’re excited to read your submissions and to see the vibrant discussions around these nominees. Your feedback on the site is also welcomed!
Thanks for being a part of this historic movement to bring the people’s voice to Washington.

subject: The most important week

body:
What matters most right now is that we do whatever we can to fund a campaign that can win. That’s the most important thing. Winning this race. | | |
---

---
| |
---
---
| | Fellow Patriot,I have an important message that I didn’t think I’d be sending you today. In just a moment, I am going to ask you to make a contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate. November 5th is _days away_ , and I’d really appreciate the chance to explain why this request — especially today — is so critically important.Here’s the truth:Right now, we have a week of media buys to pay for — the most important week of the entire campaign. And if we don’t raise what we need now, we will be forced to give up the airwaves and let Adam Schiff and the Democrat-machine backing him up run their attacks on me unopposed.What matters most right now is that we do whatever we can to fund a campaign that can win. That’s the most important thing. Winning this race. Not just for the sake of winning, but because of what it would mean to substitute my presence with Adam Schiff’s in the Senate.That’s a reality I don’t think any of us want to consider, but it’s what will happen if we come up short.Now, time is running out. In close campaigns, from the presidential race to your local city council contest, who the winner is comes down to turnout. That's why campaigns dedicate so many resources to Get Out The Vote, or GOTV, in this final stretch. They are trying to get potential voters not to stay home.
The best form of voter contact is knocking doors. For those who can't canvass, phone banking and texting are options, but the simple truth is that they aren't as effective as face-to-face conversation. **Go to[mobilize.us](https://substack.com/redirect/f7a2c697-c790-42b7-87e5-ce79f0b1f458?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to sign up for a shift near you.**
Thanks for reading Beyond the Whiteboard! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work.
[Subscribed](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9rYXRpZXBvcnRlcm9jLnN1YnN0YWNrLmNvbS9hY2NvdW50IiwicCI6MTUxMDU2NzAxLCJzIjoyMDUyNTY4LCJmIjp0cnVlLCJ1Ijo5MDUwMTE5MiwiaWF0IjoxNzMwNTE3NDI2LCJleHAiOjE3MzMxMDk0MjYsImlzcyI6InB1Yi0wIiwic3ViIjoibGluay1yZWRpcmVjdCJ9.oUZbd6F8k-N-gjGNAaw_ayF0KKaQOMwFZggc_h6FaqU?)
If you haven't knocked doors before, I know it can sound intimidating. But, take it from someone who's knocked hundreds of doors, if not thousands, over the course of three incredibly tough campaigns: it's easy, it's fun, and most importantly, it really does make a difference.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/67b801ac-2a2d-4f69-b2b1-ad519cb3a021?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Here are my tried-and-true canvassing tips that will prepare you for any situation:
1. **Knock loud; be proud.** Your first instinct might be to knock softly, hoping that the person isn't home. Absolutely not! Think about it: if there were a fire and you were trying to rescue your neighbor, would you quietly tap on their door? You are saving democracy. Pound on that door.

2. **Dropping lit ain 't it. **Lit dropping is not canvassing. You leave campaign literature if the person isn't home, but dropping lit does not win campaigns. You want to have a real conversation. So, walk up to that door, hope they're home, and knock really loudly.

3. **The ask is the task.** If you go spend ten minutes talking to someone and you leave without saying, "Will you vote for Kamala Harris and Democrats," guess what we have to ultimately do? Ask again. It's not enough to feel like you had a good conversation. Just make the ask.

4. **Don 't fear; bring the cheer!** Much like teenagers--and I speak from experience--voters can sense your fear. And if they sense fear, they will prey on you. You might be asked tough questions, but the harder the question gets, the bigger your smile has to be.

We need to do everything we can from now until polls close to elect people who share our values. Sign up at [mobilize.us](https://substack.com/redirect/f7a2c697-c790-42b7-87e5-ce79f0b1f458?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), lace up those shoes, and bring a friend. You'll feel amazing the morning after Election Day knowing you did your part for our democracy.
I'll see you out there!
Katie Porter

subject: Election homestretch - winning!
body:
| | | | |
# Eagerly Awaiting November 5th!
---
| | | |
---
| |
---
| _The main highway running through Tel Aviv this week thanks to Republicans Overseas Israel._
---
| It feels like we just keep _winning_ these days. _**I have no reason to think November 5th will be any different! **_
Solomon and I recently received a thank-you box from President Trump and the Trump 47 Committee. Among the goodies were a MAGA cap and the sharpie he used to sign it. His staff even framed one of the photos they had of us with President Trump. Treasures.
Just as priceless is the knowledge that our efforts at Republicans Overseas (RO) have now brought in **an estimated $55 million** worth of earned media from our rollout of President Trump's new policy supporting the end of double-taxation of overseas Americans. In other words, we went viral. (See my [last newsletter](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/pznGptHXb35XUZqlCKOeiw~~/AAAHUQA~/RgRpCCW-~~) for the video President Trump cut for us, the surrogate videos, and full statement.) Democrats Abroad, in the end, had no way to counter. They begged Kamala for a "me too" policy move to no avail. The White House held its first-ever Zoom call for American stakeholders abroad - and Kamala was a no-show. Such an epic failure that call was. Then they tucked tail and retreated.
_The Daily Kos _next attempted a hit piece claiming President Trump made up his entire policy only because Solomon Yue asked him to, and then referred to Solomon as "some random Republican dude." We laughed. A lot.
Our RO Israel office, for one, hasn't been able to keep up with the requests for voting and registration help from Americans - Democrat and Republican alike - wanting to cast their ballots for Trump. _Many _of these voters are registered in swing states ... If a state like PA is neck and neck in the end, and we're specifically pulling in those overseas votes there (which we ARE), they will make the difference. Just about every major media outlet in the world knows it.
To cap off the experience, the father of Reaganomics, Art Laffer, went on Fox Business in support of our effort. Grover Norquist, another iconic Reagan-era tax reform advocate interviewed with Bruce Ash on air in Arizona to throw his support behind this policy. Surreal!
Speaking of Arizona, JD Vance held a Zoom call from that state on Oct. 22nd, hosted by Lara Trump. We attended. Spirits are high because we have momentum and even the Harris/Walz campaign can see from their own internal polling that they're sinking. The situation has improved even more this week, but...
**...Don't take your foot off the gas. Talk to everyone and make sure they turn in their ballots. Vote like your kids' futures depend on it, because they do.**
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| | |
---
| |
---
| |
---
| Finally, a huge thank you to the [**Oregon Federation of Republican Women**](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/0syCFLUW_7vn7VtH-1NLUw~~/AAAHUQA~/RgRpCCW-P0UgOTcxODllYzU3ZDc3NTJiNzdlOGZkMDk1NWZhZDQ0MTJEF2h0dHBzOi8vd3d3Lm15b2Zydy5vcmcvVwVzcGNldUIKZw6-oCVn0vQnn1IUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAX2M~) with President Gerry Briggs for inviting me to be their keynote speaker at their recent meeting in Salem. They're really a neat group of ladies! Good hearts and conservative values ... Back in Baker City, the [**Baker County Republican Women**](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/aQoLMKI2iWy_AqVwXnWHiQ~~/AAAHUQA~/RgRpCCW-P0UgNDk0ZTM2Y2U4YzQzZjQ3ZGExM2I2MmNkYmRlMTkwMTVEEWh0dHBzOi8vYmNydy5vcmcvVwVzcGNldUIKZw6-oCVn0vQnn1IUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAX2M~) were busy as usual registering new voters up until the deadline. Voter registration is also a focus for our new nonprofit, the [**Oregon Conservative Caucus**](https://sptr.eocampaign1.com/f/a/PgrC9bU1WsEV9IwmiSQH1Q~~/AAAHUQA~/RgRpCCW-P0UgYWFmMDBjNTkyYzkzZGRkY2QwMDNkNmRhYTFlOGMzZjhEKWh0dHBzOi8vd3d3Lm9yZWdvbmNvbnNlcnZhdGl2ZWNhdWN1cy5jb20vVwVzcGNldUIKZw6-oCVn0vQnn1IUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAX2M~)**. **If you want to flip Oregon red without dealing with party apparatus drama, infighting, and ineffectiveness, check us out!

subject: Every Vote Matters – Let's Make Our Voices Heard for Jim Carris!
body:
Peter,As Election Day approaches on Tuesday, you have a critical choice: whether or not to vote.Sitting out an election might seem inconsequential, but in reality, **every vote not cast has a powerful effect** - it helps the Washington partisan political machine maintain its grip on the issues facing our 10th District. **When we don 't show up locally, we're effectively allowing others to decide our future nationally.**The 10th District deserves better. **If you believe in more money in your pocket, safer streets for our children, and securing America 's borders, your vote matters now more than ever.****[Jim Carris is committed to fighting for these values. He's not a career politician but a businessman, a husband, father, son, and hard-working taxpayer, just like you.](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-strhlx-tlidtddjku-r/) **Jim will ask the tough questions in Washington that you want answered and will demand resources be allocated to our struggling communities.Every single ballot counts - and the best way to ensure that our voices are heard is to vote early and encourage others to do the same.**We need to pack the polls, swamp the ballots, and energize our neighbors and friends to participate in this election**. Because every vote not cast is, ultimately, a vote for the other side. And if your friends need a little bit of convincing, bring them to the polls! Jim and our team are excited to tell everyone about Jim's plan to bring prosperity back to IL-10. See for yourself! **Today, I ask you to do two things:**
1. **Please get out and vote if you have not done so already**
2. **Please forward this email to your friends and family to encourage them to vote!**

Let's make our voices impossible to ignore. Let's bring change to the 10th District by electing [Jim Carris](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-strhlx-tlidtddjku-y/). [LAKE COUNTY VOTER SERVICES](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-strhlx-tlidtddjku-j/) [MCHENRY COUNTY VOTER SERVICES](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-strhlx-tlidtddjku-t/) [COOK COUNTY VOTER SERVICES](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-strhlx-tlidtddjku-i/) [DONATE $25 TO HELP TODAY](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-strhlx-tlidtddjku-d/) Together, we can make a difference._Peter_ Team Carris [](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-strhlx-tlidtddjku-h/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-strhlx-tlidtddjku-k/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-strhlx-tlidtddjku-u/)[](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-l-strhlx-tlidtddjku-o/) [ Share ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-fb-strhlx-tlidtddjku-m/) [ Tweet ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-tw-strhlx-tlidtddjku-c/) [ Share ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-li-strhlx-tlidtddjku-q/) [ Forward ](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.forwardtomyfriend.com/t-tlidtddjku-FE53F914-strhlx-l-a) | [Unsubscribe](https://carrj-jimcarrisforcongress.cmail20.com/t/t-u-strhlx-tlidtddjku-f/)

Most
Americans know very little about America's founding.

In
today's public schools, instead of learning about our Founding
Fathers and the U.S. Constitution's principles, they are
brainwashed with transgender ideology.

At The
Heritage Foundation, we're dedicated to creating conservative
policy solutions that will defend and sustain our republic. But
if our country is to survive, the American people must know our
founding principles and the history that brought it about.

That's
why my team at The Heritage Foundation is also committed to
teaching the public about American history and our Founding
Fathers.

We

This
informative book contains biographical essays about our Founding
Fathers like George Washington, Benjamin Franklin, and John Adams
along with insightful analysis of primary sources like the
Declaration of Independence, the United States Constitution, and
Washington's Farewell Address.

I'll never forget the day I stepped into the heart of darkness, facing off against the North Korean dictator, Kim Jong Un.

The rules were clear: no translator, no armed bodyguard, no photographers. I was completely alone, with only my convictions to guide me.

**But I wasn't intimidated. **

As the former Director of the CIA, I've stared down evil before, and I know that weakness is its fuel.

President Trump's unwavering resolve had my back, and together, we sent a message to the world: **America will not be swayed by tyranny.**

In that meeting, I saw something that the fake news media will never report: Kim Jong Un was rattled. His regime, built on fear, was shaken to its core by the unyielding strength of American leadership.

# Wokeism is Not a Latino Value
---
| In these final days of this 2024 election cycle, I wanted to share some thoughts with you.
---
| | | [](https://8d469khbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001H8p7mzGeJlcrI0S-WvPjUV0dAAX7U8VOIcZ8JSmd4koEwNgQAg0tqe1TvX7B-B1KJXsuEL0xToKrOp-UrkKh0Cv-z6jRQy-6kVXDC_JJpqnGZrkXKaXSluj8T0jPdNAizww-XGxbKcQUT-hDNrIj7y6-DLOPb_DoKhqHH8T96v9LhuDMpw1lWyKDpCu0dhR-L8ij7AVxmRfvluatAOHb2i6yRbebajiiVV7jBkrTYZnlygB0N4Pi6PkfC_fqWJ_mALOfMMxNsu0=&c=R9NV0Z1GhAbvqmFxgUDzobqyrBm1LK93C39ceF49VO9HiTmSg4hygw==&ch=UA2Wvfq98K-R1fcIGzGKwNQ1mFaMe82v_g6-eQLmLULeW01XpUqkNQ==)
---|---
Here's an article that I wrote a couple years back explaining that "wokeism" is not a value that Latinos appreciate.

"Wokeism in its purest forms breaks down clarity, and replaces truth with new grievance norms that masquerade as justice. Wokeists try to negate centuries of tradition, culture and science (!) by socially shaming opposing views and using coercive tactics on young children to adopt concepts that go against every grain of common sense and human understanding of the world around us. Woke gender ideology, being so totally antithetical to the Latino language and culture, plays a huge part of why Hispanics are universally turning away from the Democrat party."

"Now the left wants to replace Latino with 'Latinx.' It is the woke objective to erase gender by changing the masculine default of Spanish plural words: canceling the 'os' at the end of words by replacing it with an X. The gender confusion community seeks to do whatever it can to remove the uniqueness and importance of masculine and feminine in our culture, and in our language. Are we to begin to call our sons and daughters by ninx rather than nina or nino, our grandchildren nietx, our students alumnx, our friends amigx, our neighbors vecinx, and our partners companerx? We must end this abuse of language and stop the disrespect of our masculine and feminine natures. Let's maintain the proud heritage of the Spanish language which has existed for more than two millennia."

Click the image to read the whole article. Let me know what you think. You can reach me at 831-610-4555.

| This is huge, Peter. Lucas has withstood over $6 MILLION in false TV attack ads from Hawley’s campaign and billionaire-funded Super PAC since August — and he’s STILL managed to put this race in a STATISTICAL TIE with Hawley! By now, most Missourians know about Lucas’ unifying vision for our state. They know that he’ll fight like hell to protect our freedoms, rebuild our communities, and make real investments into Missouri — all things Hawley has failed to deliver during his six years in the U.S. Senate. But we can’t afford to let up now... Over these final 3 days, we need to do everything we can to reach the remaining undecided voters with the truth about their choice in this election. We need to keep our positive ads on TV. We need to keep reaching voters online, at their doors, and in their mailboxes. And now that no-excuse absentee voting has started in Missouri, we need to keep turning out every voter we can between now and Election Day on November 5th. That’s why we’re urgently asking: [Will you rush a donation of $10 toward our grassroots campaign to elect Lucas Kunce and Blue Amp Action right now? Friend,

A movement is growing, led by progressives-but supported by many well-meaning Americans-to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our
Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue-views we will make available to policymakers
and opinion leaders.

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics-too many Americans simply don't understand the
importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as ";Constitution 101" and ";The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands
of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty-including the importance of
the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63723454:WA7WFnWNu:m:3:2532013465:2C1291F8579C32AE8B15252822B2DBA4:r

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been ";pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding-not even indirectly in the
form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention-and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

## Texas Buys Border Land
The State of Texas has purchased two large ranches near the Mexican border for the purpose of constructing border walls. Texas Land Commissioner Dawn Buckingham announced Tuesday that her office had [purchased a 1,402-acre ranch in Starr County](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2SrCAUhJ8Gs2MBIo4BwU3M5qYbWvwclVqEWcBx5u23nHzTrv66uvvrPt-1Dz6u__WOqr6WNHPKBTAGlM9O-_CeReOUoW5kDSo2dLQXgknRbMrdaEeZEbLvZDf2umfUDNIJaRjDUcjGqyuMMcoZFbwb2nG5sUXS24J2FIOURFB0vqbc1g0rvnRZwjs9Mbc27U1QW62PQrp_hE-ET-d5tmtI7cfYrulJ-FQ3hDUkwqeIZyF8emQsBTIG1AUv4apA-JRsTQbzhVw4BB0d2LTvvhSfImYwh_32cd30Dtr-HD5jgayj3cBHKFXnDDYdsb6hJjCHDw5Myg4znDqEdqt7aLJyj9OH4IsciKDrrn34bKl_nvtU_DcAAP__hDl-3w) along the Rio Grande. In West Texas, the state purchased [the 353,785-acre Brewster Ranch](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGu4yAQRb_G7saCMQa7oNjG3dt2S2sCQ4wW4wjY5-TvV0n_yisdHV2dP1_bF8UU8_03HWzbM5wbClQgJQjcPMX02lTv7U34RfZspRnFpJTUqt_tTKx1cNJMRovZOz87mpTHxaMmjaGP9i2TUqAUCkczLGGWQYs5sFuU0bpTgn1sZxnazo2fVEN6nd9cBncefbJ7a4_ajb86XDtcr-saHiXzVa9Y-I10uL4nFE5MlWuH68cCd85cKEGi7OEMITqG279XhXEawcwTkCsMt8JXbVygUHY7xPzhDyp_oRXKlVyLZ4ZRIC5CGT3s7Uh9sf5xxZRi1aZT4n5QTJ-_7ceA3xb_BwAA__9lUnSG), the largest privately owned ranch in the state. A proposed 1.5-mile wall would edge the Starr County ranch, [blocking a particularly high-traffic border crossing](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2O6yAQRp8Gd1iAMdgFxW3c5bZbWmDG8UjYRDCJk7dfJduttP35fnS-LvPFY8Lj-t_v4Oi55lkJpbmUXKg5ekyvWTfRBRFH2YCTthO91tLoZnMmGBgUaOsD9OPQ6TDaYRiXPva9shAadO8yKYWSQqvOtuM6yNWIYYVl1NYYpgVEpFxa2oDg6euaXvkBpV3y3iS3Ed0q6_4xNTE1nefZhlwilAK3XOgNMTXhvuO1eMJ8MDXRBvwH4qdPiampkifg4f6qvOY7bfwzxIs_lo1T5uGOKXKkyvN5_Mo2xcXbiSlhNZZpcd09ps85-tPWw6nvAAAA__8ZWW9J) where extensive crime has been reported.
## Housing Shortage Worsens
Texas is among the U.S. states with the biggest housing shortage, leading to higher home prices and rents in the state, [according to a new report](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx00L1u7CAQxfGnwR0WM7DYLihu425vm9Iiy2BGwmZl2K-3j5w-_U_nSP-v63L1nHlf__uNXHvHsqBCIwGkwiV4zp_FdMF9qzBBRw4GrS7GgDVdchSmgewN4AIhjHYkrX3QYUSDGrWPHbtzDEAhKIN66Kc4QrRqjHSbzGCtMIoCt3L0LVGjt68xf8qTjv5Wti671Nq9Cv1P4CxwftxjOdajvFrqy7EKnHd61YX3ymtqVeCs5UVunDOXXW5cK--rTGWjKnmXLZF8yJN1hwv31-mqHYRR6-Y5_162Pxs8Hf4EAAD__2-2XwY). Based on 2022 data, Texas was 320,000 housing units [short of demand](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGu4yAURL_G7rDggnFcUGzjLttuabHmYiMRiOA6xH__lPSvHc2Mjs6_-3q3IYa0_7UPNPT2eQUOignBOKzOhnitqnfmP3ez6NGISfJRKaFVfxjkSk9WeO2thE2AljhxcHJGMXscoQ_mcyYEB8EVyGmY_U14zW8et1lNWneKowuUy0AHEr5t9fHKLyzDlh99NAfRs3byTwdLB0trbah2O0vBRJ9GB0vCVjtYvlt25LOGtLN65EJ2R7Yj0SdouVRkDuszELKEjW05VSrnRiEnVul0F6v2qkyO8yg1yL4Y92whxlD11Cm-P2yIXyr6VdPLwE8AAAD___K4bI8), with Houston in particular covering just 83% of demand, despite building 66,000 new homes that year. [Texas builds more homes](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGu4yAURL_G7rDggnFcUGzjLttuabHmYiMRiOA6xH__lPSvHc2Mjs6_-3q3IYa0_7UPNPT2eQUOignBOKzOhnitqnfmP3ez6NGISfJRKaFVfxjkSk9WeO2thE2AljhxcHJGMXscoQ_mcyYEB8EVyGmY_U14zW8et1lNWneKowuUy0AHEr5t9fHKLyzDlh99NAfRs3byTwdLB0trbah2O0vBRJ9GB0vCVjtYvlt25LOGtLN65EJ2R7Yj0SdouVRkDuszELKEjW05VSrnRiEnVul0F6v2qkyO8yg1yL4Y92whxlD11Cm-P2yIXyr6VdPLwE8AAAD___K4bI8) than any other state, but the housing gap continues to climb with the state's nation-leading population growth. The 2022 gap jumped up from the 306,000 mark for the previous year, indicating a worsening trend.
## Lone Star Rally Starts Up

# [President Andrew Jackson was involved in as many as 100 duels.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=smblak&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [U.S. History](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=smblak&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=smblak&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| T he seventh President of the United States was known to be as thin-skinned as he was quick-tempered. This dangerous combination resulted in Andrew Jackson challenging many a foe to a duel — [as many as 100](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=smblak&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), by some counts. Most of these confrontations involved little more than the combatants firing their guns into the air as a show of courage for not rejecting the initial challenge, but at least one turned deadly. It began when fellow horse breeder and longtime rival Charles Dickinson leveled a series of insults at Jackson (calling him a “worthless scoundrel” and referring to his wife as a bigamist, among other things), which escalated into a feud that ended with Dickinson’s death on May 30, 1806. Jackson barely escaped with his own life, as Dickinson fired upon him and hit the future President near his heart. The bullet was never removed, and Jackson carried it with him for the rest of his life.
---
Though Jackson participated in more duels than most, the practice was fairly commonplace at the time. Aaron Burr famously killed his personal and political rival Alexander Hamilton in one on July 11, 1804, at which time Burr was serving as Thomas Jefferson’s Vice President. Unlike Jackson, however, Burr was vilified for his actions — Hamilton was a founding father, after all — and Burr never held elected office again after his term ended.

## Andrew Jackson lost a presidential election despite winning the most votes.
The [presidential election of 1824](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=smblak&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) was hotly contested, with four different candidates receiving a substantial number of electoral votes: Jackson (99), John Quincy Adams (84), William H. Crawford (41), and Henry Clay (37). All four belonged to the Democratic-Republican Party, which was part of the problem: After winning six consecutive elections during the Era of Good Feelings — a time of economic prosperity in the new nation — the party failed to rally around one candidate. Jackson won more popular votes and electoral votes than his trio of opponents, but failed to secure a majority. This sent the election to the House of Representatives, as dictated by the 12th Amendment, with Adams emerging victorious. It wasn’t without controversy, however. Jackson accused Adams of striking a “corrupt bargain” with Clay (in which Clay used his influence as speaker of the House to swing the vote for Adams in exchange for the coveted secretary of state position) and used the accusation as a major part of his successful 1828 campaign.

clean_body: The seventh President of the United States was known to be as thin-skinned as he was quick-tempered. | T he seventh President of the United States was known to be as thin-skinned as he was quick-tempered. This dangerous combination resulted in Andrew Jackson challenging many a foe to a duel — , by some counts. Most of these confrontations involved little more than the combatants firing their guns into the air as a show of courage for not rejecting the initial challenge, but at least one turned deadly. It began when fellow horse breeder and longtime rival Charles Dickinson leveled a series of insults at Jackson (calling him a “worthless scoundrel” and referring to his wife as a bigamist, among other things), which escalated into a feud that ended with Dickinson’s death on May 30, 1806. Jackson barely escaped with his own life, as Dickinson fired upon him and hit the future President near his heart. The bullet was never removed, and Jackson carried it with him for the rest of his life. Though Jackson participated in more duels than most, the practice was fairly commonplace at the time. Aaron Burr famously killed his personal and political rival Alexander Hamilton in one on July 11, 1804, at which time Burr was serving as Thomas Jefferson’s Vice President. I'll never forget the day I stepped into the heart of darkness, facing off against the North Korean dictator, Kim Jong Un.

The rules were clear: no translator, no armed bodyguard, no photographers. I was completely alone, with only my convictions to guide me.

**But I wasn't intimidated. **

As the former Director of the CIA, I've stared down evil before, and I know that weakness is its fuel.

President Trump's unwavering resolve had my back, and together, we sent a message to the world: **America will not be swayed by tyranny.**

In that meeting, I saw something that the fake news media will never report: Kim Jong Un was rattled. His regime, built on fear, was shaken to its core by the unyielding strength of American leadership.
