# Saturday, November 2, 2024
---|---
**Good Morning**! On this day in 1947, the _Spruce Goose_ , officially known as the Hughes H-4 Hercules, made [its first and only flight](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0zzFuwyAUANDTwBbr88EQBoZKlTulHatOFg6fmBaHFONEvn3V7r3Ak977aTz5lNP18uoXci2WEQHVQYgD4Bh8yvuoeHCRCElycsJI6FVvQfHZ-UBnsIFIaQq9MZMFoyQE1XvsNUSe3K8mBKAQQijojlYCBms02qPUOjIFFFIrtfss6dpminkvd6rduSw8u7m128rkE8OB4bCXrW3dRAyHl68PqI-3Cb-BySGSb1slJp_X2VcKvLpwe6Sc06oNU3BZfMp_ZPuveHf4EwAA___LF1F-). Built by Howard Hughes and his team during World War II, this massive airplane was constructed primarily from laminated birch and spruce--hence the nickname the _Spruce Goose_. With Halloween behind us and stores stocking more Christmas merchandise, we want to know: "Is it too early to put up Christmas lights?" Share your opinion by taking the poll below. [BrainSync](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0zz9PwzAUBPBPY2-N_J7_xYOHCpQFWgkxFLFESf3cGty6Sk2jfHsUdub76U532PW7IeV0Pe2HC_kaS48C1QZgI7APQ8pLr3jwkQhJcvJgpdBKO6H42Ydj244WjZJKmAiWnNbOjBBGK6ElxZNf2wAEAgAo0bROCgzOGnStNCYyJSikWqbmq6RrPVPMS3nQ1BzLhWd_rvV2Z3LLsGPYzfPcDGNGUafvFTDs8PXtSa7Zi95_Hj5WJ7t7-ZmO1KfA5HPMy5XmQAH1O91Qbfnkw21OOae7sUyJ02VI-W-u_nf_4fE3AAD__y62WLo) is our sponsor today, offering information about brain health.
|

## Economy Adds Only 12,000 Jobs
The U.S. [added only 12,000](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHSoyAURp8GOxy4ImpBsY1dtt3SQbjGm0VwgMTJ2_-T9H_9zXxzzvl3W26WAsX7X3ugqVtaQIDiUnIBi7cU3otqvNkQAbsGjRw60at-EqrZjd68dqPU0K8eQDuLCtFO6zjqbexE35D5vEkpQEoplWjHqRPgp0HDNHZab0wJ9FRTbh-JYt1xC-_0wty6dDTB7LWehXV_GMwM5uu62ri6iFf57Azm9VkoYikMZnQppuPNYC54VjxWzPyr8khr4RnPlCu_dls5VX6gjYXvz5zJ2YiFrwkp3nmpmf4jzy5aOYydgCYbf14UAhU9MCXuh6Xwhau_xXoZ-AkAAP__fsds6w) jobs in October, far below expectations, marking the slowest month for hiring since December 2020. Economists had [projected at least 100,000 jobs](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0j7GOqzAQRb_GdEb2MEBcuHgNXV67JTJ4HCZxcGR7g_L3K7bf7kpXOkfn6zpfHUfeb__dk2wNaQYFKLWWCmbvOH5mbLwNREBdQ1aPneqxNwqbzXYj-R7X_kIu6L5HRBPQLIQmUABaG7YnTWsFWmuNqr2YToE34wDm0g1DEKjIc025vSfe60YhftKbcrumZxPtVuuriO6fgEnAdBxHuy5lp6Ocv4DpnAKmtNa0UJb3tBRZ3YPkxlVu3znz6naSpWZ-kICpyda_Do6RyzAKVLen4_jrqn-1vy38BAAA__8PcFvq) in the final report before Election Day, while September payroll gains were also revised down to 223,000 from 254,000. Last month's hurricanes and labor strikes contributed to the weak jobs report, with one expert noting it also reflects [a labor market cooldown](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLFu7CAURL8Gd1hwje2loNinJ3ebJkWUysJwbbPBYAG7zv595PSpRpqRRkfn4zbetPMuLG96Q1XmOAIDQTmnDEarnX-NorJqRgRsKlS8b1grWslEtSqtJyPMRXQoWw5GGtm3OM-GsZ7xvpsqp843zhlwzrlg9UU2DKzsO5CXputmIhhaV2Kq79GFsuLsX_GJqTZxq7xaS9kzaa4EBgLDcRz1lsO5ERgw0EcmMGwx4OtMnb6wnE00JU6Y6D1OmSbcYyr0sXiHiZZVB4omhri5XDLF7x1NQUtg0Iler7z4ZfokzRCNs6T5_-80g0d-x7RXSdn9cN673PVEsGXTzv-Clr_EPRX8BAAA__-kqXEc), "where growth is increasingly narrowly concentrated." Overall, the unemployment rate remained steady at 4.1%, the lowest level heading into a presidential election since 2000.
## White House Alters Official Transcript
White House officials allegedly altered the official transcript of President Biden's "[_garbage_](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2unDAUhJ_GdEb-u7AULjaK6G6aFLdEZ-1jOImxke1dsm8fkT7VjDTS6NP39bl8AkVK6w_Y0baQFyWU4VJyoRYPFN-L6bwNiAp1h1aOWnyYj0mYbrNBgFBwM2oADQ7MpKcAZvAADkc_mY7s9SalUFJKaUR_m7RQfhoHNd30MARmBHpqufS_MqW2YYjv_MLSu7x30W6tHZXpO1MzU_N5nv1e07UxNWPiz8rUnPC84siRGrmrnhs15Ft-VuQ5BHIEsXKIDQt63gqk6godjefAH-Qx8RXKA1bkLu87psbhYGqGwu932X4ff76YnrMjz_T3b5cqPOtPLEdXrD9OipHqMDIj1h0o_iNv_zP5supvAAAA___qvneZ)" remark despite concerns by official White House stenographers, according to a report by the Associated Press. According to a transcript prepared by the stenographers, Biden appeared to call [former President Trump supporters](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOrCAUQL8GOwz3gjoWFC95sZuX121pEK56NygG2JnM329m-61PcnJyPu7z3XHkc_vnDrJ1TTMqNBJAKpyD4_iaTRPsSoSkG7IwaNWZblSm2W3nO-rNoIPzMPgAy4ioDfiwwKhWbRq2bxuAQgAAo9rbqBWGcehxvOm-X4VRFLim3H4mPutOa3ylB-XWp6OJdq_1KkL_ETgJnNziT3qWdktvLHD6nyJX9kXg9Ny5ktzTVyHpYqVMQdbszuIzX1UuHOiUm8uL20j6dBx0VhmoXFxJ4FRqyi-hJw5C_wXojMKbHptsw_XkGLn0gzBqOxzHn7T626qHxe8AAAD__zYJawQ) "garbage" Tuesday when he told Voto Latino, "_The only garbage I see floating out there is his supporters_." The White House press office transcript [rendered the quote](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLHO4yAQBp_G7oh21xiHguKadLn2SmsNi8MJGwuTRHn7U67_y0-fNBrNn_t855TTvv7mTVyLZSYgrRAV0Bw45c-s--CiCMnQi8NpgFGPFnT_cHGZAgbyYHxgNAtAnMbAHtEansT0yX1piECIiBouVzsABTsZstfBmNhpkJBaqZe_Je3tITF_ykvqxZetz-7R2nF2w6-Obh3d-NjlfX6v76gt-Swd3ZYUZFcr14VXUa3yfvqajqaOp9RWVE2-qFaf26EGMkJxRMNWs56ANQ2AyFabxdBIfXXheKec02mmTsO6ccr_XdpPbV6O_gUAAP__xttkLg) as "supporter's" instead of "supporters," which aides claimed was criticizing comedian Tony Hinchcliffe specifically, not Trump supporters. An email and two officials [confirmed that the press office](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOtDAQg58mdKBkCCQUKf4m3f7tlWiWDDCnLEEku4i3P3H9NZYLy7a-r8f4QI68Lf_xRa7MaQQJulaqljAG5HiNugpuJgJqK3LKtLLT3SB1tTo1SbSd7jAoa-epGySFYNCiRT0hmord3aaUBKWU0rKxQyshDKaHwbZ9PwstKXBJR_OdeCsrzfFKHzqaKb2q6NZS9izafwK8AH-eZ_POWFLA6w4I8Lmk4xLgNzqzAL-nyIWn297DArxSAry85Vy5UL2md6b6yYG2uhy45engvdQLHk9cSIA33WDsYEFKI8BXhwv7yTFy7o3Qcnkhx99z5S9YHwc_AQAA__80BGj3) made the changes after conferring with Biden in a breach of protocol and transcript integrity.
## Daylight Saving Time Ends Sunday
This Sunday at 2 a.m., clocks will roll back one hour, [ending daylight saving time](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0jzFvgzAQhX-NvRmdzwaHwUMXtnTtiC7xGa41EAUrKP--onu3Jz3pve_7uo5XkiLr9EkLx5q3EQG9sdYAjomkvEevU8zMyE5ztMFB69sevJ4j3rILNiGH7DoHxH2bMYFtCQIQoZZ4rlkLaK21HppL7wBTHzrsL67rsvLASer2bL43WevMuby3Fz-b-7boEudaH7tyHwoHhcNxHM39tq987GevcDijwiHRu8g0V7PTS9bJVFnYZCrF3Oj-Y04GhYN-xvQ4pBTZu6A8TAtJ-Tuq_4m_Iv4GAAD__zyUWQc) for 2024, a 238-day period intended to extend daylight hours through spring, summer, and part of autumn. The idea of switching the clocks is often attributed, perhaps humorously, to [Ben Franklin](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LFugzAQxvGnMZuRfTYGBg9d2NK1I7rgM1xq7AicVHn7Kt27_obvk_5fl_mCnDivn7iTr7HMoMBKraWCOSCn12yb4CMRkGnI696oznajss3mKQy2J7x240DOueXam9gh9QuZIQwGG_bvNa0VaK21Ve0wGgVh7B2Mg3EuCqsocC1Heyuc60YxvcqTjnYpe5P8Vuv9FOZDwCRgitxSeAiYKAuYzoUpLyQxB0nhsWDl8vYr5RvunGU8MH8nflvAV-J1q_LEJ-f1lJV3ag4f7j-cEp-uF1atO3L6O67_hXh6-A0AAP__7HtgnQ), who suggested the French adjust their sleep schedules to save on candles and lamp oil. Daylight Saving Time Ends Sunday This Sunday at 2 a.m., clocks will roll back one hour, for 2024, a 238-day period intended to extend daylight hours through spring, summer, and part of autumn. The idea of switching the clocks is often attributed, perhaps humorously, to , who suggested the French adjust their sleep schedules to save on candles and lamp oil. Daylight saving time was established as federal law in 1966, but in the early 2000s from the last Sunday in October to the first Sunday in November to allow more daylight for Halloween trick-or-treating. The money isn’t in the budget yet—but with polls in the margin of error, running these final ads could be enough to break the tie in Jon’s favor and win this race. = If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Jon Tester and Kirsten Gillibrand will go through immediately: | | | = | | = | | = | | = Every time I take a risk on this campaign, it’s because I believe in this team. I’m confident grassroots supporters like you—who’ve stepped up time and time again—will help us win this Senate race. With just 3 days until Election Day, Jon and our team need you now more than ever. Thank you, Shelbi Campaign Manager Team Tester | * | = A note from Kirsten: Friend, I can’t thank you enough for standing by my side in the critical fights ahead of us. As Democrats face our toughest Senate map in decades, I need your help more than ever. While Republicans only have to defend 10 seats in 2024, Democrats have to defend 23 — and if the GOP flips just two of them, it will deliver Senate control back to Mitch McConnell. Now, experts at FiveThirtyEight are saying that the GOP has a clear path to the majority. As right-wing special interests gear up to pour millions into flipping the Senate, we need to fight back right now. But I refuse to take a single cent from corporate PACs, which means I’m relying on your grassroots support. = And if you’d like to become a core member of my team and receive exclusive texts from my campaign, = Thank you, Kirsten Gillibrand

This initiative is not merely about economic reform. It is an attempt to impose global rule by so-called experts.

Some social media companies are censoring our efforts to promote a seminar we hosted on the Hillsdale campus that explored the topic of the Great Reset. Fortunately, we can communicate directly with you.

In this seminar, we...

---
Never could this young boy have imagined he'd one day be sending an email like this.

Peter, it's Troy Downing.

If you don't have a lot of time,**** all you need to know about me is I only care about three things: **God, family, and country. [I'm running for Congress to defend those three things for myself and every American.](https://click.updates.troydowning.com/?qs=98348a78b232a2a1409dadf44589decb0e019a8dacc31f0bf9ac2434f3d29f74331b508942249ca4d28e784ebb355421ed15676db9220e4b "I’m running for Congress to defend those three things for myself and every American.")**
---
| [](https://click.updates.troydowning.com/?qs=98348a78b232a2a1745d874c1df27100abb6f694d43556233734b12b834cf24473c156be617840c96d69729b3ba95728940ea3e44d66006d)
---
Growing up, I was a bit of a nerd. I studied mathematics and computer science in college. Then I started my own business that merged with Yahoo!. I started other small businesses in insurance and real estate, but then my life changed forever...

Like millions of Americans, September 11th was a turning point in my life.

**I immediately enlisted in the United States Air Force/ANG.** I served two tours of duty in Afghanistan as part of a Combat Search and Rescue (CSAR) squadron.
---
| | | | [](https://click.updates.troydowning.com/?qs=98348a78b232a2a1745d874c1df27100abb6f694d43556233734b12b834cf24473c156be617840c96d69729b3ba95728940ea3e44d66006d)

---
After eight years of service, I honorably discharged from the Air Force and returned to my wife and kids back home in Montana.
---
| [ ](https://click.updates.troydowning.com/?qs=98348a78b232a2a1745d874c1df27100abb6f694d43556233734b12b834cf24473c156be617840c96d69729b3ba95728940ea3e44d66006d)
---
We are partners in a local distillery in Bozeman and when the COVID pandemic hit, our community went above and beyond to help our friends and neighbors. There were shortages of toilet paper, sanitizing wipes, and hand sanitizer in every single store.

We quickly turned our whiskey distillery into a hand sanitizer production facility to provide free hand sanitizer to families, first responders, and hospitals.
---

In the Combat Search and Rescue (CSAR) Community, we live by this motto:

_**These things we do, that others may live.**_

I've taken this motto with me in everything I do. I've taught my kids to live by this. And now, my public service is not finished. **[I'm running for Congress to preserve our American way of life, protect our God-given rights, and defend our nation with everything I've got.](https://click.updates.troydowning.com/?qs=98348a78b232a2a11a852632425dd96d02f52f9788d30333d2ab53643ed07996fd261d2d6069a24de41c2eb4234584d4323b3e4de5961c1e "I’m running for Congress to preserve our American way of life, protect our God-given rights, and defend our nation with everything I’ve got. I'm running for Congress for our **FAMILIES** , so our kids have every open opportunity to succeed.

I'm running for Congress for our **COUNTRY** , so every future generation can still call the United States of America their home and the best country that has ever graced God's creation..

Peter, this race won't come cheap. Democrats are chomping at the bit to flip Montana BLUE so they can turn our state into the next California! I can't let that happen, but I'm hoping strong faithed Patriots like you will help win this fight.

2. **Tim Sheehy is wrong for Montana.** He wants to privatize health care, transfer off our public lands, and wants to ban abortion.
3. **Mitch McConnell is desperate to beat me.** He named me one of his top targets, and outside groups are spending millions to pummel me with attacks.
4. **Their attacks are working.** The polls have tightened into a statistical tie, and this race couldn’t be any closer—**[your $7 will help us pull ahead.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/82128?refcode=em20241102-8588&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amount=7&t=5&akid=8588%2E614464%2Eog3zj6)**

clean_body: Hey Peter, it’s Jon Tester. I need your support to get our message in front of as many voters as possible. So I’m humbly asking: Here are 7 reasons why your donation today is so important (that’s one for every finger!): 1. Newsweek ranks this race a toss-up, which means your gift will have a huge impact on our ability to raise the resources we need to win. 2. Tim Sheehy is wrong for Montana. He wants to privatize health care, transfer off our public lands, and wants to ban abortion. 3. Mitch McConnell is desperate to beat me. He named me one of his top targets, and outside groups are spending millions to pummel me with attacks. 4. Their attacks are working. The polls have tightened into a statistical tie, and this race couldn’t be any closer— 5. I won my first Senate race by just 3,562 votes... and this election could be even closer. 6. Montanans are voting as we speak, and we’re falling behind on our fundraising. If we can’t afford to keep our ads up, our opponent’s attacks will drown us out just as voting begins. 7. We can’t win without you., we’d have the resources we need to overcome the attacks, break our tie in the polls, and win this race. But not everyone will, so I’m asking you personally: If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: If we win in Montana, we can defend our way of life, safeguard a woman’s right to make her own health care decisions, and protect our public lands for generations to come. —Jon Paid for by Lucas Kunce for Missouri

| | Dear Friend,

Citizens are free to say what they think. Subjects aren't.

Sadly, the question of whether we are citizens or subjects has become politically controversial in our country. A clear sign of this is the attempt to suppress the expression of obvious truths, such as the fact that boys cannot become girls.

Another sign that many of our leaders consider us subjects is their denial of our right to decide who is allowed to enter our country--indeed, they tell us that if we complain about mass illegal immigration, we are racists.

**This is a pivotal time in our nation 's history--a time when we must stand up and forthrightly demand to be treated as citizens, not subjects. Because freedom hangs in the balance.**

A poisonous ideology has infected almost every major American institution. Only a few still stand in defense of freedom and the right of self-government.

One of the most important of these is **Hillsdale College**. And today, my friends at Hillsdale need your partnership and support in their mission to preserve the blessings of civil and religious liberty through education.

For 180 years, Hillsdale has offered its students the kind of education America's founders thought necessary to sustain free government. And in recent decades, Hillsdale has extended its teaching mission nationwide with a vast national outreach effort.

This outreach effort includes its free publication _Imprimis_ , its free online courses, and its tireless work to return excellence--including excellent civics instruction--to American K-12 education.

And Hillsdale College does all of this while refusing to accept one penny of government funding--not even indirectly through federal or state student grants and loans.

# [Help animals in puppy mills, roadside zoos and labs! Pass the "Better CARE for Animals Act"!](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3ab7dd63-3f42-4a31-9452-18a557dd3cbd/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T3d36f903-9e8a-44e6-9642-aaf036b9dd06/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)
---
| | | The Animal Welfare Act is meant to protect animals in facilities regulated by the U.S. Department of Agriculture like puppy mills, roadside zoos, or laboratories. Yet repeat offenders who continue to violate basic standards of animal care in these facilities face little to no consequences. As a result, countless animals are suffering. Many violations are egregious—including denying veterinary care to animals who are emaciated, sick, injured, or unable to walk. **[The Better CARE for Animals Act will strengthen enforcement of the Animal Welfare Act](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4d54377f-790b-4004-ba8e-763fe8285649/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** by enabling the Department of Justice to collaborate more effectively with the USDA to hold accountable animal businesses that violate the most basic rules of humane care. It also allows the DOJ to seek stronger penalties for repeat offenders, including license revocations, civil penalties, and the use of seizure and forfeiture of animals experiencing harmful treatment. **[Please urge your members of Congress to support this critical bill today!](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tc3c7167e-1c00-4cb9-b47a-5465fab6f7cc/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** This change is long overdue. Consider that in May of 2022, the DOJ filed a lawsuit documenting dozens of animal welfare violations at a breeding facility for animals used in research. Among the many violations noted, beagles were being killed instead of given veterinary care for easily treatable conditions, and, over an eight-week period, 25 beagle puppies died from cold exposure. The company that owned the facility eventually entered a settlement agreement leading to the transfer of roughly 4,000 dogs to animal adoption organizations, but it should never have taken so long to save these dogs since USDA inspectors had documented dozens of violations at the facility in 2021 and 2022. If the DOJ had better tools to punish chronic violators, like this facility, it's possible some of these animals could have been saved. [**The Better CARE for Animals Act will give DOJ better tools to enforce the Animal Welfare Act, prosecute repeat offenders, and help save suffering animals before it's too late. Please urge your members of Congress to support this critical bill today!**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T2320ea5f-c8bb-4cd1-b651-7cad3753ae27/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | Hi Peter, As Asian Americans, we take care of each other — in our homes, at our workplaces, and when we vote. name: Douglas Carswell
subject: Whoever wins on Tuesday, Ignore the Doomsters
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/ignorethedoomsters?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Dear Friend, **Trump or Kamala? We’ll know who’s won in just a few days.**

Whoever is elected the next President, we can count on the fact that supporters of the losing candidate won’t take it well. **So polarized is our politics, supporters of the defeated candidate may despair.**
---
|
---
_Down to the wire?_
| **Trump or Kamala, there’s going to be an outbreak of doomerism in the days that follow. Many may wallow in pessimism.** Some might even sound like they are willing Bad Things on America merely to vindicate their own political preferences. Don’t.

**Whatever happens, Americans should avoid catastrophizing about the outcome.** Life in this country has been getting better over the past few decades, despite rather than because of some of the politicians America has had.

Steve Pinker, the cognitive scientist, reminds us of this with a series of graphs he produced, showing how life has improved in America since the early 1970s.
---
|
---
_America since 1970 has improved by many measures._
| The red and the blue bands above show who was in the White House as output shot up 321 percent since 1970, and the population increased by 63 percent.

**America’s industrial output today is approximately twice what it was in 1980.** It's nearly three times what it was when Lyndon Johnson was in the White House. So much for the myth of American “de-industrialization”.
---
|
---
_Life expectance up, Homicide down_
| Life expectancy is also up (although it has largely flatlined since Obama became President). Homicide, too, is down (although there was a nasty jump that started during Obama’s second term).

**Over the past five decades, poverty in America has plummeted.**

Among those officially classified as “poor”, 99 percent live now in homes that have electricity, water and a fridge. 95 percent have a television. 88 percent have a phone. 71 percent own a car. And 70 percent have air conditioning.

In the early 1970s, many Americans simply didn’t have many of these things.

In the late 1970s, to buy a 14-inch television, the average American earning the average wage would have needed to work 70 hours to earn enough. Today, a vastly better TV can be purchased for the equivalent of 4 hours of work.

**The first cell phones in the early 1980s retailed for almost $4,000 - or over $10,000 in today’s prices. They needed re-charging after 30 minutes.** Today, almost every American can afford a far better cell phone for a fraction of the cost.

America has 50 states, and thanks to Article 10 of the Constitution, those powers not “specifically given to the federal government, nor withheld from the states, are reserved to those respective states, or to the people at large”. Perhaps it is time to abide by that Amendment?

**Stay true to America’s Founding Principles, and America will, I hope, continue to prosper whoever lives at 1600 Pennsylvania Avenue.**

If the question of who lives in the White House for the next four years is overshadowing everything across the country, maybe it’s time to listen to the former Texas Governor, Rick Perry, who once suggested that we ought to make Washington as inconsequential as possible.

Cheer up and have an awesome week ahead!
---

---

Douglas Carswell

Hi Friend,
As we close in on E lection Day - THIS TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 5th! - I wanted to take a moment to say thank you to so many of you for your incredible work, passion, and encouragement. Our fight to elect Kamala Harris as our next President along with Democrats up and down the ballot has been an inspiring and noble cause and I am in awe of the work that we've all been able to accomplish.
I've been working day and night to make sure that we don't leave anything on the table in this fight for our democracy . As we push through the finish line together, I'll be curing ballots, facilitating votes, talking to our neighbors at community events, and working to Get Out The Vote in every corner of our community. Please join me in committing to taking one extra action - one more canvassing shift, one more phone call, attend one more event - before polls close next Tuesday.
We know that the future of our country will be decided in Pennsylvania and it’s up to each of us to stop Donald Trump once and for all!
Let's finish this together!
Nina

name: Kamala Harris
subject: I am so proud to be on this team with you.

body:
I am asking for your support one last time before Election Day.
---
| [](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-hfp-split-november-2024?refcode=em_20241102_2160_fr&refcode2=khp_em_20241102_b1_kdh_dnc_fl&amount=10&akid=2160%2E22930333%2ErXO5vG)
---
Derek, these past few months have been a whirlwind. So, I wanted to step back and take a few minutes to remind you how we got here -- and why your support for the DNC and for our campaign is so important to our success on Election Day in three days.
**The truth is: I am no stranger to unlikely journeys.**
I grew up in the East Bay, immersed in the ideals of the civil rights movement, and at a young age I decided I wanted to be a lawyer. I wanted to protect people because I believe everyone has a right to safety, dignity, and justice.
Every day in the courtroom, I stood proudly before a judge and said five words: Kamala Harris, for the people. Throughout my career, I have only had one client: The people.
Today, we have the chance to chart a new way forward -- not as members of any one party or faction, but as Americans.
I want you to know that I will be a president who unites us around our highest aspirations. A president who leads and listens, who is realistic, practical, and has common sense. A president who always fights for the American people.
I cannot do it alone. No one person could. It takes a team. It takes millions and millions of people coming together at once to shape the outcome of this election and elect Democrats up and down the ballot.
Millions of Americans have already voted, and millions more will vote on Election Day. We need to do everything we can -- and I mean everything -- to reach every last voter to win the White House and elect Democrats nationwide. We need Democrats elected at every level who will fight to deliver on our vision for the future, from the Oval Office to local office.
**So, with time running out to make an impact before Election Day, I am asking for your support one last time:**
[**Derek, will you help us get out the vote over these final days by splitting $10, or whatever you can afford, between the DNC and our campaign before our midnight deadline? Every dollar will help us reach more voters and elect Democrats in key battleground states and swing districts before the polls close on Election Day.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-hfp-split-november-2024?refcode=em_20241102_2160_fr&refcode2=khp_em_20241102_b1_kdh_dnc_fl&amount=10&akid=2160%2E22930333%2ErXO5vG)

---
USO Supporter,
November is Military Family Appreciation Month, and I can't think of a better way to spend this month than honoring the contributions and sacrifices of our country's military families.
This is personal for me. During my deployments to Afghanistan after 9/11, my wife and daughters had to navigate long stretches without me when I was deployed on and off over the next seven years.
As the COO of the USO, it's part of my mission to ensure that military families receive the support they need, whether through our 250 centers worldwide where our service members can focus on connecting with their loved ones before returning to the challenges they face every day, or our USO Warrior and Family Centers where families can reunite during times of healing.
**[Will you please give $29 now in honor of Military Family Appreciation Month?](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/~8eXC0zwvYFy/VzQ4SWhYcFM5bVEwMGFSQURxa1ZzNGI0TEtzY2xkdmNmOWdaUnpHb0p5Y2tKOHdnVW8wckFzR0xsU1RuMkNtV3lnUzZhWEV4M0NjUDdoU1RKZGxXZ2M3blIxZHNCSEpxWm00aGF4UnBZa0U9S0/VXhGOU5PNXFYd1kza3N1VkhkeGorSG5qVXhmRVluT0FXcGJ3MEFXZU5LdHBGeEpQWjFsbHl6bURidlQ0QVZEMWFuaVdvUnNIbHFuQVZtZG5qbXM0NVpiOFJveFJGTDVHS0)**
[GIVE $29 TO
SUPPORT MILITARY FAMILIES](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/7P90hVL2ygC-)
---
At the USO, we believe it's not just the service member who serves -- it's the entire family. And that's why we've set a goal to raise $50,000 via email and text messages this month to support service members and their families.
**But we can 't do this without supporters like you. Our heroes in uniform and their families are counting on us -- especially this time of year, when so many of them will be spending the holidays apart.**
**[That's why I'm personally asking, will you give $29 now to help us hit our $50,000 goal to honor our service members and their families who have sacrificed so much as we celebrate Military Family Appreciation Month?](https://links.e.uso.)**
[GIVE $29 TO
SUPPORT MILITARY FAMILIES](https://links.e.uso.org/els/v2/Dd9Kh-)
---
From someone who knows how much it matters, thank you for supporting military families.
--Christopher Plamp, COO, USO

**Bold. Unapologetic. Determined.** These words describe one of the most important women in history, a woman a shocking number of people have never heard of: Save the Children's founder, **Eglantyne Jebb**.

Derek — My
whole life, I’ve looked up to my dad, Adam.

Not just because he’s a member of Congress, or because he served as an
impeachment manager in the case against Donald Trump, or on the January
6th Committee — though I am proud of him for all of those things!

I admire my dad because he is tireless and relentless in his work to make
a difference for others — especially young people like me and my brother
Eli.

Whether he’s fighting to reform the Supreme Court so my generation is not
beholden to an ultra-conservative judiciary, or fighting to cancel student
loan debt, or fighting to restore reproductive rights, or fighting to
protect our clean air and water, he’s taking on big fights to help other
people out.

My dad is one of the most selfless people I know.

Growing up, I would watch him at campaign events, asking people over and
over again how he could help and hearing about their struggles. For most
people, it would probably be exhausting and quite challenging — especially
when the former president of the United States is always demonizing you.

But my dad has never wavered in his work to make real change. For your
grandma, your neighbor down the street who is a veteran, your teacher,
your kids and grandkids, for everyone.

And that’s why I know he’s going to be a damn good Senator. We have just a
few days left to make it happen, which is why I’m earnestly asking you,

body:
This is why I’m running for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat.
#
Hi Peter, it’s Lucas Kunce.
The community that supported my family after we were bankrupted by medical bills is what motivated me to run against Josh Hawley for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat. **Please let me tell you why:**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83260?refcode=em20241102-8603&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8603%2E614464%2Ep6dHnE)
I grew up in a working-class neighborhood in mid-Missouri. It was one of those places where the curbs crumbled into the streets and the sidewalks were so tilted you couldn’t really walk on them — though they made a pretty good bike ramp for all of us kids.
We all ran in and out of each other’s houses, everyone’s parents took care of everyone. **It was a magical place to live.**
Like so many families, mine lived paycheck-to-paycheck — and when my littlest sister was born with a heart condition, we were bankrupted by medical bills.
Our family got by thanks to the generosity of our community — most people had no more money than we did, but helped us anyway. Our neighbors and friends took the rest of us kids into their homes while my parents were with my sister at the hospital over 100 miles away. And when we were all home together, they brought more meals by the house than we could ever hope to eat.
Their support helped me go to college, and after that I joined the Marines to honor everything our community did for me and my family growing up.
But when I came home between tours in Iraq and Afghanistan, I found that old magical place picked for parts — our local corner store was boarded up, our family’s first home in the neighborhood was bulldozed to the ground.
**Now it’s an empty lot:**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83260?refcode=em20241102-8603&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=8603%2E614464%2Ep6dHnE)
While all of us were risking our lives to build up towns like Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Herat, career politicians and corporate elites like Josh Hawley let our towns and neighborhoods at home waste away. And then, after spending 20 years and $6.4 trillion on pointless forever wars and defense contractors, they couldn’t figure out how to invest a fraction of that amount back into our own country.
**I’m running for U.S. Senate because it’s time everyday Missourians — people who know how to take care of each other, like the ones in my old neighborhood — called the shots in this country.[And today, I’m asking for your support to help me make it happen.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83260?refcode=em20241102-8603&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=8603%2E614464%2Ep6dHnE)**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/83260?refcode=em20241102-8603&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=8603%2E614464%2Ep6dHnE)
**If you’re ready to take back power from the giant corporations and corrupt, career politicians who’ve waged economic warfare on our country, I need you on November 5th, Peter.[Will you add a $10 donation to my campaign right now so we have the resources to fight back against Josh Hawley’s attacks, keep airing our own positive message, and flip this U.S. Senate seat in just 3 days? clean_body: This is why I’m running for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat. Hi Peter, it’s Lucas Kunce. The community that supported my family after we were bankrupted by medical bills is what motivated me to run against Josh Hawley for Missouri’s U.S. Senate seat. Please let me tell you why: I grew up in a working-class neighborhood in mid-Missouri. It was one of those places where the curbs crumbled into the streets and the sidewalks were so tilted you couldn’t really walk on them — though they made a pretty good bike ramp for all of us kids. We all ran in and out of each other’s houses, everyone’s parents took care of everyone. It was a magical place to live. Like so many families, mine lived paycheck-to-paycheck — and when my littlest sister was born with a heart condition, we were bankrupted by medical bills. Our family got by thanks to the generosity of our community — most people had no more money than we did, but helped us anyway. Our neighbors and friends took the rest of us kids into their homes while my parents were with my sister at the hospital over 100 miles away. And when we were all home together, they brought more meals by the house than we could ever hope to eat. Their support helped me go to college, and after that I joined the Marines to honor everything our community did for me and my family growing up. But when I came home between tours in Iraq and Afghanistan, I found that old magical place picked for parts — our local corner store was boarded up, our family’s first home in the neighborhood was bulldozed to the ground. Now it’s an empty lot: While all of us were risking our lives to build up towns like Habbaniyah, Fallujah, and Herat, career politicians and corporate elites like Josh Hawley let our towns and neighborhoods at home waste away. And then, after spending 20 years and $6.4 trillion on pointless forever wars and defense contractors, they couldn’t figure out how to invest a fraction of that amount back into our own country. I’m running for U.S. Senate because it’s time everyday Missourians — people who know how to take care of each other, like the ones in my old neighborhood — called the shots in this country. If you’re ready to take back power from the giant corporations and corrupt, career politicians who’ve waged economic warfare on our country, I need you on November 5th, Peter. Peter,
As we approach Election Day, we are in the final stretch of our grassroots campaign to support 13 incredible young progressive candidates who are ready to make a difference in our communities.
These candidates embody the change we need — fighting for social justice, climate action, and equitable education. But they can't do it alone. We have one last chance to ensure they have the resources to mobilize voters and share their vision.
**Why Your Support Matters:**
* **Time is of the Essence:** Every moment counts. Early voting is already underway, and we need to ensure that every voter knows who is on the ballot.
* **Your Donation is Critical:** With just days to go, we’re making a final push to fund canvassing efforts, phone banking, and outreach materials. Every dollar you contribute will directly impact our ability to get these candidates elected.
* **A New Generation of Leadership:** By electing these 13 young leaders, we’re not just changing who sits in office; we’re investing in a future that prioritizes the needs of our communities.

Please join us in this critical effort. Your donation of $5 can make a significant difference in our GOTV strategy. Together, we can ensure that these candidates have the support they need to succeed.

| | | | folks, it’s Jon. Can I be real with you? [**_I’m no stranger to tough elections, but I’ve never run a race like this. I’m in the fight of my life right now, and I could really use your help. I’ll explain more in a second, but first, will you make a split donation to my campaign today?_**](https://click.nodemleftbehind.com/click/gpnv-2vafgp-g4nlms-kyd76rh4/) Here’s two things I think you should know: 1) Mitch McConnell has made me his top target this cycle, and his super PAC allies are spending nearly $90 million in ads to tear me down. _That’s more outside cash than all of my previous races combined_. 2) Polling experts have rated this race a toss-up, which means we need all the resources we can get to build a winning operation. I won my first Senate race by just 3,562 votes—and this one could be even closer. That’s why it's such bad news that **our fundraising has taken a nosedive in the past 48 hours.** We have to right the ship _immediately_ , so I’m personally asking: **Will you split a donation to my campaign today?** Thanks, I really appreciate the support. —Jon

#

Peter, I just got off my first round of calls, and in about 15 minutes, I have to head out for a full day of events. But while I have the time, I wanted to reach out.
If you’re anything like me, the way you shake off the nerves is by staying busy. And I hope (if you’re able) that you take the time to knock on some doors or make phone calls to get out the vote over the next three days.
But if you’re at home looking for something to do, please. Let me explain why your support — even today, with three days until the election — is so important.
Back in September, there were a significant number of undecided voters left in Arizona — anywhere from 5-10% of all voters. Then early voting started, and people began making their choices. Over the last few weeks, we’ve seen what was at times a double-digit lead in our favor narrow. It was gradual at first, but all of a sudden not one, but **TWO polls came out showing Kari Lake leading us** , and a third with us just barely ahead.
We always knew this would be a fight to the finish. We were prepared for that. But we never thought it would be this close — _or that we would be falling behind Kari Lake_ — with just three days left.
Peter, I did not come this far to lose to the “MAGA Queen.” We’ve worked too hard for that. But to regain the lead and defend everything we’ve accomplished in Arizona, I have to absolutely floor it over these next three days.
I need to raise $1.5 million dollars by midnight on Election Day to cover the additional cost of this last-minute surge. And the only way I can do that is with your support.
[**Please, Peter. I know you’ve done so much already, but I need you to make a donation of $20.24 or anything you can afford to give. Last year, during a routine anatomy scan at 19 weeks pregnant, Allie received the devastating news that the baby she was joyfully expecting, Miley Rose, was not going to make it.

Following the diagnosis, Doctors warned that continuing the pregnancy would endanger Allie’s life. But, **the Tennessee state legislature,_which is 85% male_ , had passed a near-total ban on abortion in 2022.** She was forced to leave her home state, devastated and heartbroken, to obtain the life-saving care she needed:

_“With a risk of sepsis, blood clots, or more, I underwent an emergency abortion. I did this alone: in a city I had never been to before, without my family or my husband there by my side,”_ Allie said.

However, her legislator, Rep. Jeff Burkhart, did not have any empathy for her experience. He told her that if his own daughter had been in her position, he’d have wanted her to _continue the pregnancy..._ he also told her “most of the time the pregnancies that go bad are usually the first pregnancy.” (???)

It’s way past time we elect legislators, not mansplainers who have no idea what they’re talking about.

Betches News recently published the audio from that conversation, _“In recently unearthed audio from June 2023, Republican Tennessee representative Jeff Burkhart is heard speaking to two women who had lost pregnancies. In the conversation he actively tried to invalidate their experiences because of his own misinformed understanding of reproductive health. Almost a year earlier, a ban on abortion from the point of conception with zero exceptions went into effect in Tennessee.”_

After the conversation, Phillips wrote to Buckhart and said, _“Every chance I get to tell my story, I will... Who knows, maybe one day I’ll run against you.”_

Friends, it’s Julia Louis-Dreyfus. If you know me, you know I love a good joke. But today, I’m reaching out about something that couldn’t be more serious: this year’s election in the battleground state of Nevada.
With everything from abortion rights and climate change to the future of our democracy at stake, I’ve been paying close attention to which states and which races are the most important — and everything I’m reading says that Nevada will be decisive for control of the White House and the Senate.
That’s why I’m personally reaching out to ask: Will you join me in supporting Senator Jacky Rosen by splitting $10 between her reelection campaign and Tim Kaine today? Every dollar will go a long way toward making sure she wins in Nevada so we can keep the Senate and the White House blue. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-rosen]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-rosen]
Right now, Nevada is ranked as one of the few true toss-up states in the entire country. That’s why Republicans are doing everything in their power to win here — so they can reelect Donald Trump, defeat Jacky Rosen, take control in Washington, and implement their far-right Project 2025 agenda.
Look, I’ve witnessed my fair share of fictional, dysfunctional government (I mean, have you seen Veep ?). If we’re going to stop Trump’s GOP from making that kind of chaos and dysfunction real again, then we need to make sure Jacky Rosen wins in November and can defend our Senate majority. But the polls show her neck and neck with her Trump-obsessed MAGA opponent.
That’s where your grassroots support comes in. Jacky’s race will be decided on the margins, which means each and every dollar will make a difference. My career as an actor spans decades — but so too does my time as an activist. From supporting the farm worker movement with Cesar Chavez in California to campaigning for Ted Kennedy's presidential campaign in Florida (yes, Florida!) to supporting Democratic Senate candidates, I've never been shy about getting involved and fighting for what's right.

Fighting for what's right most usually demands articulating what is wrong. And Florida's GOP senator Rick Scott — who is beholden to Donald Trump — is absolutely wrong for Florida and our nation. A Republican majority in the Senate, with Donald Trump in the White House, is downright wrong and dangerous for our nation.

You know it as well as I do. Trump and Scott are beholden to an extreme ideology that attacks the heart of our nation — our freedom and democracy — while empowering and enriching themselves and their allies. Their agenda wouldn't just send our nation backward, but it would also cause untold harm.
**That's why I'm all in to help Debbie Mucarsel-Powell win in Florida. If we win in Florida, Democrats hold the Senate. If we win in Florida, we stop Donald Trump. If we win in Florida, the "what's next?" is building a country with new, hopeful ideas and possibilities. **

So please, respond before midnight tonight and tell us: Who will you vote for? | | | | | * | = A note from Kirsten: Friend, I can’t thank you enough for standing by my side in the critical fights ahead of us. As Democrats face our toughest Senate map in decades, I need your help more than ever. While Republicans only have to defend 10 seats in 2024, Democrats have to defend 23 — and if the GOP flips just two of them, it will deliver Senate control back to Mitch McConnell. Now, experts at FiveThirtyEight are saying that the GOP has a clear path to the majority. As right-wing special interests gear up to pour millions into flipping the Senate, we need to fight back right now. But I refuse to take a single cent from corporate PACs, which means I’m relying on your grassroots support. = And if you’d like to become a core member of my team and receive exclusive texts from my campaign, = Thank you, Kirsten Gillibrand

Fellow Friends,
[Pledge your support](https://substack..T6jpAcVjNdh_NFnFcc-tmcwZL4J5O7DG4SsvkX8cC24?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=151067426)
Early Voting ends Sunday. We've been out on the Campaign trail for almost a year and now it is time to take action at the ballot box. We need your support so please get out and vote. **We are three days from the Main Event - For us it is a David v. Goliath story.**
We have been identifying and posing solutions to issues facing the citizens of this district and will continue to do so **and we have been working with the local candidates**
**Our Campaign has been one about Federal Solutions to Local Problems** that you and I face living in the Constitution State of Connecticut. We have also looked at world issues and issues that need to be addressed in Congress especially on global energy and reduced global emissions (See [Article](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/40db40d4-519f-4190-ae65-7e32a8d5227b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)).
We've been out there: knocking doors, talking to people at Garbage dumps (_**long before we were called garbage**_), talking to you, marching in parades, talking to our youth, our veterans, talking to communities that have been ignored. We have also spent a lot of time talking to people in the supermarkets about their pocketbook issues. **We have a pretty good feeling of the pulse of this State and this Country.**
Here are some of the issues that matter to Every Day Nutmeggers like You.
**Connecticut has a border crisis.** Immigration and bad economic policy is affecting everyone and causes rampant inflation. The fentanyl and trafficking making its way to our backyard must stop. **At the grocery stores, many people are waiting to shop on sale days and many are shopping at multiple supermarkets to take advantages of different sales**. The sales price of groceries today were the regular prices under the Trump administration.
There is no price gouging at supermarkets as they typically run on less than a 2% profit margin and high volume. **They are struggling due to high energy costs, supply chain issues, and theft.** Crime is rampant and our police need to be supported and this mantra of Crime Pays Under Harris and Himes needs to be reversed.
**Education** \- Parents want to be able to send their children where they want and we have been advocating for school choice. When we marched the Puerto Rican Day parade, so many parents expressed the challenges of working two or three jobs to be in a position to send their children to private or parochial schools because Bridgeport ranks at the bottom of the school districts of 161 out of about 165. ([See our article on Your Child, Your Choice.](https://open.substack.com/pub/drmichaelgoldstein4ct/p/your-child-your-choice?r=26c3ku&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web))
**Housing** is another major issue and not just 8-30g. Rents keep going up and the supply of housing is an issue in some parts of our district. Pricing is going up for inflationary reasons as cost of home heating is up. Cost of electricity is up. Cost of insurance is up. Hartford keeps jamming 8-30g down our throats. This mandate does not solve the real problem, which is enough affordable ownership of housing. **Our children cannot afford to live in Fairfield County.** (See our article on [housing](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/dccf95aa-daad-4ffa-adbd-7d8603409ab6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)). **We Need a Return to Local Control and Affordable Home Ownership and Building Equity.**
**Medicare -** We are seeing Seniors on fixed income getting the shock of their lives as Medicare funds were diverted - **Only $280 Billion** \- to subsidize the Green New Deal of the Inflation Reduction Act. This will cause major issues and we have to take care of our [seniors](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/4235c566-f55f-4198-963b-355b89783a8f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
**Business** \- Companies are moving out of Connecticut. The only companies that come here are doing so because they have to. When they get here, they are stuck in traffic because I-95 doesn't move - You can blame Himes for that one - [See our article - When you Are Stuck on I-95 - Blame Himes)](https://open.substack.com/pub/drmichaelgoldstein4ct/p/i-95-when-you-are-in-traffic-blame?r=26c3ku&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web).
This infrastructure and energy crisis is causing issues to Commercial Real Estate Concerns and we need to bring more jobs to Connecticut with **new pro-business strategies** including: reduced regulatory burdens, expedited zoning and permit approvals, improving the infrastructure with less congested highways and improved commuter rail service. Federal tax incentives and opportunity zones are tools that can be used to attract new businesses to our beautiful state. These are techniques being used by other states to lure away Connecticut businesses. **We need to be more aggressive in both attracting and keeping businesses here.** ([See our Article on Addressing our Commercial Markets](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/6daa23f1-9e4e-44d9-8658-35fbc3680cff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)).
**I-95** \- It needs solutions and some work is being done. Our new concern is that the roads are being improved by contractors not from Connecticut - **We have to try and keep jobs here and keep the money in Connecticut that will flow into Connecticut**. We launched an inquiry after you complained about New York license plates on the construction vehicles (see [article](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/8046dcc5-feaf-43a7-8651-cd3b2a09611c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)).
**Electricity -** As for electricity, our bills have gone up significantly because of the public benefit. The electric company should pay for these green initiatives which benefits them by reducing their need to supply additional electricity. **You are not obligated to help your neighbor make improvements in a classic taxation without representation.** In the interim, I have proposed a deduction on your taxes for this mandate while you push your local State Reps and Senators to push back. ([See our article on electricity](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/dc7ab48b-f7a4-4f5f-872a-b09b57d5fce3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)).
**The Border -** The border is another big issue, which is woven into many of these other issues and impacts our lives. I am all about closing the border especially after Prison gangs of Tren de Aragua are now killing people in Stamford (See [Article](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/7667e6c8-96e7-49d0-81cc-99e45fa49e5a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)). **Protecting Women means keeping them safe and keeping known criminals from coming into this country and deporting illegals that commit violent crimes against women and children.** My Opponent voted Against the Violence Against Women by Illegals Act - and was wrong on the facts at our [debate](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/5dc80471-af6e-4e47-a1ff-d69c8ec19667?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Most of Americans are in agreement on crime and safety. However, Jim Himes has been horrible on the Border and even suggested that we should bring refugees from Gaza. ([See our article on Hamas and Himes](https://open.substack.com/pub/drmichaelgoldstein4ct/p/no-process-is-strong-enough-to-vet?r=26c3ku&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web))
**Veterans** \- We've also talked about how veterans have been ignored with better treatment given to illegals and the lack of good resources for veterans to treat their PTSD and other ailments following their service to this grateful nation. ([See our Article on Our Veterans](https://open.substack.com/pub/drmichaelgoldstein4ct/p/what-about-our-veterans-vote-august?r=26c3ku&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web)).
**Israel -** Harris and Himes have been terrible on Israel despite the fact Jim Himes largest donor is AIPAC. Himes has pandered to CAIR and was silent when both President Biden and Vice President Harris snubbed Netanyahu and Israel on a very important diplomatic mission. That was their first mission since October 7. ([See our Article on Biden and Harris Snub Israe](https://open.substack.com/pub/drmichaelgoldstein4ct/p/biden-and-harris-snub-israel?r=26c3ku&utm_campaign=post&utm_medium=web)l) .
These protests and violence on college campuses needs to end. Free speech is one thing, it is another to incite violence and desecrating government property and attacking our flag while Universities are told by Chuck Schumer to bury the issue.
**WHAT CAN YOU DO?**
Now ask yourself what can you do. _**If any of these issues strike a nerve it is time to take action.**_ As we have been in the words of the Doobie Brothers - Takin it To the Street, it is your turn to **Take it to the Poll** s and Tell Your Friends. Cast your vote. It matters and you matter. So Let's build the greatest team going into this November to take back Connecticut and Heal this Country.
We are out there working hard for the working people of Connecticut that have been ignored.
On Tuesday, November 5th, go out make your voices heard . **The silent majority can no longer be silent any longer. IF YOU DO NOT GO OUT AND VOTE - YOU HAVE NO ABILITY TO COMPLAIN.**
_**We are leaving it all on the field and will not stop until the polls close.**_
Thank you for your continued support - We will not be ignored any longer.
**Put a Doctor in the house and you can do that on November 5th by casting your vote for Dr. Michael Goldstein.**
**Stand up for America and Our Future and the Future of Our Children and VOTE FOR ME ON ROW B.**
**I would be honored by your support and tell your friends to get out and vote.**
Thank you for your continued support. **This is a David v Goliath Moment and We the People Can Do this Together - that one stone is your vote at the polls.**

Peter,

# **RITE Helps to Secure Victory on Undated Ballots in Pennsylvania **

(Harrisburg, Pennsylvania – November 2, 2024) - Restoring Integrity and Trust in Elections (“RITE”), a non-profit organization that supports litigation to ensure election security and integrity, today announced a significant victory against yet another attempt by liberal activists to subvert Pennsylvania’s law that requires mail-in ballots to be signed and dated.

The Supreme Court of Pennsylvania rebuked a lower court that tried to eliminate the dating requirement at the eleventh hour. [This decision](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=a9d1f4d71f&e=ea91f782ea) ensures that the dating requirement will be fully enforced throughout the Commonwealth in this year’s elections for President, Senate, and down throughout the ballot.

RITE is pleased that the Supreme Court of Pennsylvania adopted the arguments RITE submitted in its [brief](https://riteusa.us12.list-manage.com/track/click?u=dc5917dfc5aa19cc3795efbb2&id=783fa14736&e=ea91f782ea) to block the lower courts’ reckless efforts to upend the Commonwealth’s elections.

“This is yet another damning loss for activists who want to take a sledgehammer to simple election security measures,” said Derek Lyons, President and CEO of RITE. “So-called ‘voting rights groups’ have had Pennsylvania’s simple dating requirement in their crosshairs for four years now. They have filed every lawsuit imaginable to invalidate it, with the same result each time: A loss. Today, the Pennsylvania Supreme Court delivered a victory for the rule of law and delivered a strong message to those trying to manipulate the courts to undermine election rules enacted into law by democratically elected legislatures. RITE is honored to play a role in ensuring elections are administered in accordance with the law so that the public can have confidence in their results.” ###

| **Wokeism is Not a Latino Value**
---
| | | | | | | | | | | In these final days of this 2024 election cycle, I wanted to share some thoughts with you. Here's an article that I wrote a couple years back explaining that "wokeism" is not a value that Latinos appreciate.
---
| [](https://hernandezforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=314f047675baff18221b82bdc&id=1cc73982a5&e=638e6c2751)
---
| _"Wokeism in its purest forms breaks down clarity, and replaces truth with new grievance norms that masquerade as justice. Wokeists try to negate centuries of tradition, culture and science (!) by socially shaming opposing views and using coercive tactics on young children to adopt concepts that go against every grain of common sense and human understanding of the world around us. Woke gender ideology, being so totally antithetical to the Latino language and culture, plays a huge part of why Hispanics are universally turning away from the Democrat party."_
_"Now the left wants to replace Latino with ‘Latinx.’ It is the woke objective to erase gender by changing the masculine default of Spanish plural words: canceling the ‘os’ at the end of words by replacing it with an X. The gender confusion community seeks to do whatever it can to remove the uniqueness and importance of masculine and feminine in our culture, and in our language. Are we to begin to call our sons and daughters by ninx rather than nina or nino, our grandchildren nietx, our students alumnx, our friends amigx, our neighbors vecinx, and our partners companerx? We must end this abuse of language and stop the disrespect of our masculine and feminine natures. Let’s maintain the proud heritage of the Spanish language which has existed for more than two millennia."_
Click the image to read the whole article. Let me know what you think. You can reach me at 831-610-4555.
---

Your vote really matters. Help us get the word out - tell your friends, consider donating to my campaign, vote by November 5th!

I’ll never forget when Kamala officially accepted the Democratic nomination at the convention. The hope and pride I felt.
I remember thinking: _How lucky am I to be married to this woman?_
Not because of where she's been.
Not because of what she'll do.
**But because of who she is.**
She's kind, strong, smart, driven. She cares. When she sees a problem, she doesn't complain about it or find somebody to blame -- she gets to work. Simply put, she's a badass.

Nancy Northup, President & CEO
Rachana Desai Martin, Chief Government and External Relations Officer
Benita Miller, Vice President, U.S. Programs
Elisabeth Smith, Director, State Policy & Advocacy | [**RSVP NOW**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96400920/509880306/-1206405312?sourceid=1150010&utm_campaign=25thfge-1005mdx-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=townhall&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZmU4OWRmOC0yNTk5LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zwiXL6wjb8w1XOsZj5aFMvgpSQDHdoLALOI3kyd03jA=&emci=2475e8b3-cf97-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=7fe89df8-2599-ef11-88ce-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=954237 "RSVP NOW")

We'll discuss the path ahead for abortion rights in the U.S., and most importantly, how the Center intends to carry this fight forward—regardless of who is in the White House. The tragedy there underscores why our campaign calls for an arms embargo against Israel and a halt to international funding that fuels apartheid. We are committed to ending the cycles of violence that continue to devastate lives and communities, ensuring that our foreign policy prioritizes peace and human rights for all. Right now, **the** **DNC is spending hundreds of thousands on anti-third-party ads** , aiming to dissuade young voters with messages that call us “spoilers.” But this election is bigger than that. We have a duty to vote with our conscience and push back against a system that allows the suffering of our Palestinian brothers and sisters to continue unchecked. From Maine to Washington, North Carolina, Wisconsin, Louisiana and Minnesota, we’re building a new political network focused on justice for working and vulnerable communities. This Justice for All network is setting legal precedents, creating a more accessible path for independent candidates in the future, and ensuring that voices demanding real change continue to be heard for years to come. Peter!

Monday is the day before Election Day – but it’s WAAAAAY more than that.

It’s Election Hero Day! 🎉

We all benefit from the contributions made by election officials, their
staff, and poll workers – and that’s why we have an entire day dedicated
to celebrating these election heroes!

[ https://act.powerthepolls.org/signup/add-your-name-thank-our-election-heroes-nov-2024/?t=1003&akid=8820%2E934366%2EIc-XZu ]Will you join us in celebrating these American heroes by signing our
virtual thank-you card? We’ll then send you this printable coloring sheet
that you can use to thank your local election heroes in person.

[ https://act.powerthepolls.org/signup/add-your-name-thank-our-election-heroes-nov-2024/?t=1004&akid=8820%2E934366%2EIc-XZu ]Download and Print! Thank You Election Heroes Coloring Page

[ https://act.powerthepolls.org/signup/add-your-name-thank-our-election-heroes-nov-2024/?t=1005&akid=8820%2E934366%2EIc-XZu ]Add your name now – and download this coloring sheet!

Voters around the country are heading to the polls to make their voices
heard in state and local elections. The folks who greet these voters and
assist them in casting ballots are helping power our democracy – and
that’s why we call them heroes.

Behind the scenes, there are even more people working hard to make sure
our elections run smoothly: state and local election officials, municipal
clerks, and the office staff who help people register to vote and make
sure every vote is carefully counted.

We’re celebrating each and every one of these heroes today, and they
deserve our thanks.

[ https://act.powerthepolls.org/signup/add-your-name-thank-our-election-heroes-nov-2024/?t=1006&akid=8820%2E934366%2EIc-XZu ]Sign the virtual card and leave a message of gratitude

Thanks for showing gratitude to the folks who make our elections work!

—The Power the Polls Team

body:
| The stakes of this race are high and it’s going to be close. But the power is in your hands.
---
[](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1142?refcode=kh_em_do_20241102_b15_kh_tier1_do_do_fl_ak&amount=47&amounts=47%252C75%252C100%252C250%252C500&utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241102_b15_kh_tier1_do_do_fl_ak&t=1&akid=236%2E2563979%2EmzP4G8)
Peter, I am spending the final few days of this campaign holding rallies across the battleground states. We were in Arizona and Nevada on Thursday. Wisconsin yesterday. Georgia and North Carolina today, Michigan tomorrow. All across Pennsylvania on Monday. _The energy is extraordinary._ But let me be clear: This is going to be a very close race. The polling shows we are essentially tied with Donald Trump _in each of these states_. We are going to win -- but this election, and the person sitting in the Oval Office in January, will be determined by a small number of people who are deciding right now whether they should get out and vote or stay home on Election Day. **I am counting on your help to reach these crucial voters before polls close on Tuesday.** Peter, you have real power to shape the outcome of this election, especially in Pennsylvania. We won this state by less than 100,000 votes in 2020 -- just 1% of the vote. It looks like it will be just as close this year. **[You can use this link to find a volunteer event happening near you, or choose one from the list below. Let’s do this.](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1218?utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241102_b15_kh_tier1_do_do_fl_ak&t=7&akid=236%2E2563979%2EmzP4G8)** **[The Final Stretch Canvass with PA Dems in East Stroudsburg!](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1219?c0=706995.oA9jNT&utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241102_b15_kh_tier1_do_do_fl_ak&t=10&akid=236%2E2563979%2EmzP4G8)** Sunday, November 3rd, 9:00 a.m. East Stroudsburg, PA 18360 | | [RSVP HERE](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/1219?c0=706995.oA9jNT&utm_campaign=kh_em_do_20241102_b15_kh_tier1_do_do_fl_ak&t=11&akid=236%2E2563979%2EmzP4G8)

Kamala

Hello,
After the 2022 election, I had a hard decision to make.
When I ran against Lauren Boebert in 2022, I knew we could win. No one believed me – not the Democratic party, not the Republican party, and certainly none of the political pundits.

subject: KDKA: Our race "could determine control of the U.S. House."
body:
PA-17 race set to determine control of Congress

|
---
Friend, We are just days away from voters determining who will represent them in Congress, but even in the closing stretch, we are still finding ways to share our message with voters across Western Pennsylvania. **Trib Live: Deluzio, Mercuri face off for pivotal 17th Congressional District seat** [](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=f04aMgqN2VKEa3-3PIK_LGXBqO_2Rknck7NZRBNRrT_FVl-y8Mdk2smBZcI7NTcfID8K9EFIIpLrV879k0tD4g3rpzW80upNKilaQ7_LDR7o7y-TgIEJ3pX8yQSaP948oOo8HTojszVNhUIMFQJDWACR5GArZgc-sfucjjNfOpc&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=11_02_24_email_to_supporters&n=1) Republican Rob Mercuri, a Pennsylvania state representative, is looking to unseat Democratic U.S. Rep Chris Deluzio in a pivotal congressional district that could be crucial in determining which party controls the U.S. House of Representatives. [Click here](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=f04aMgqN2VKEa3-3PIK_LGXBqO_2Rknck7NZRBNRrT_FVl-y8Mdk2smBZcI7NTcfID8K9EFIIpLrV879k0tD4g3rpzW80upNKilaQ7_LDR7o7y-TgIEJ3pX8yQSaP948oOo8HTojszVNhUIMFQJDWACR5GArZgc-sfucjjNfOpc&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=11_02_24_email_to_supporters&n=2) to read the full article. **Rob Joins KDKA to Discuss State of the Race** I was happy to join Jon Delano on KDKA-TV recently to share my vision for how we unify our country, the contrasts that exist with my opponent, and the ways we create opportunities for all Americans. [](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=W9vrCvmlcrdKdDtMBNJcNhW1qK8VvhczBOEdZyY37eZeS9siA0NvAlztPmfHl6nrQEf46VVSB5wT_lWz6V7_LB4dpfq22hFASR3dFvxRF_Y&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=11_02_24_email_to_supporters&n=3) The future of our country and the direction of Congress could rest with the voters of the 17th Congressional District. With our pro-growth, pro-family, and pro-unity platform reaching new voters each day, we know which candidate will be chosen by the voters! You can see my full interview by [clicking here.](https://robmercuri.nationbuilder.com/r?u=W9vrCvmlcrdKdDtMBNJcNhW1qK8VvhczBOEdZyY37eZeS9siA0NvAlztPmfHl6nrQEf46VVSB5wT_lWz6V7_LB4dpfq22hFASR3dFvxRF_Y&e=3e5e734082f1493d27255edb80fe3a63&utm_source=robmercuri&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=11_02_24_email_to_supporters&n=4) **Going Strong Through Election Day** With only three days to go, our grassroots team is out in full force. We had a great Friday afternoon knocking doors in Scott Township, where Auditor General Tim DeFoor joined us! We were so excited to have him campaign with us and help us get out the vote! ******It’s Important to Know Your Polling Location!** If you haven’t utilized the early voting options, it means you’re preparing to vote in-person on Election Day! Peter, I grew up across the street from one of Donald Trump's golf courses in New York. This one, in fact: ↘↘ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96409510/509902118/-1361974956?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20241102_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZTkyNWY1NC0yZjk5LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KjuWRwz7zPyzlBCfgdrF3n15u1zHzEzGqffPckTutQU=) Yes, really. But it was not the way I think you're picturing it in your mind — let me explain.

I didn't live in a skyrise apartment or a mansion with luxuries at my fingertips.

**I grew up in the Throggs Neck Houses, a crumbling public housing project among vermin, lead, and mold, across from Trump's Golf Course in The Bronx.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96409528/509902159/-1361974956?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20241102_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3ZTkyNWY1NC0yZjk5LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KjuWRwz7zPyzlBCfgdrF3n15u1zHzEzGqffPckTutQU=) My mom was a single mom, working multiple jobs to keep food on the table. I'm so grateful for how much she sacrificed to provide for our family.

Living across from Trump's Golf Course, I had to see a reminder every day of how easily and often our government supports and enables the ultra-wealthy at the expense of working families.

You see, the New York City government shoveled over _$100 million in government aid_ to develop this golf course with Donald Trump and the corrupt Trump Organization. _They did this while New York families like mine lived in hunger and poverty across the street._

But, I always try to look at the positives — growing up smelling the stench of Donald Trump (even before he became president) has led me to where I am today: **Fighting in Congress for justice for real working families.**

When I work on legislation, I always think about the families who are struggling just like mine did. I lived that experience — it is not abstract to me. And I'll never forget it.

I hope you feel like you have a better sense of who I am and what my values are. I swear that I'm fighting for those values every day in Congress.

Right now, the shadow of Trump and his MAGA cult looms large. They're determined to strip our right to vote, give tax breaks to people like Trump, and put special interests ahead of working families _– and they’re raising millions to pull it off._

But we have something they don’t, Peter: A powerful grassroots movement made up of working people, not faceless corporations. name: Angus King
subject: Long days and long nights
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BENNET FOR COLORADO
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bennet-aking?refcode=X_110224_BennetKing_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bennet-aking?refcode=X_110224_BennetKing_act]
Friend, Michael Bennet here. I’d like to share a message with you from a truly unique man I have the honor of serving with in the U.S. Senate: Angus King. Angus is a critical partner of mine in the U.S. Senate, and we can’t afford to lose his thoughtful, compassionate, bipartisan approach to policy making.
He’s running for reelection in Maine and I’d like to ask you to support his campaign by splitting a $20 contribution between us.
There’s just too much on the line — from reproductive rights to access to the ballot box — to risk losing Angus and letting Republicans take back the Senate majority. Can you chip in today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bennet-aking?refcode=X_110224_BennetKing_act]
- Michael
- - - - - Forwarded Message - - - -
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bennet-aking?refcode=X_110224_BennetKing_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bennet-aking?refcode=X_110224_BennetKing_act]
As of today, there are only three days until Election Day. And as you might know, I am up for reelection. With time running out and the future of our democracy on the line I could really use your support.
Can you donate any amount right now to be split between my campaign and my friend Michael Bennet so that we can keep delivering for the American people? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bennet-aking?refcode=X_110224_BennetKing_act]
DONATE NOW [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bennet-aking?refcode=X_110224_BennetKing_act]
Here in the Senate, there are often long days and late nights. It’s not always glamorous, but I wouldn’t change it for the world – it’s the job you hired me to do. From helping address the cost of living to speaking on the Senate floor in defense of women’s rights, this work is incredibly rewarding.
I can’t wait to keep fighting for you and your communities in the Senate if you give me the opportunity. But team, I need your support – large or small, it doesn’t matter – if I’m going to win my re-election campaign in November.
Can you make a donation large or small to be split between myself and Michael Bennet right now? With the clock ticking, I promise every single dollar counts. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bennet-aking?refcode=X_110224_BennetKing_act]
DONATE $5 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bennet-aking?refcode=X_110224_BennetKing_act&amount=5] DONATE $10 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bennet-aking?refcode=X_110224_BennetKing_act&amount=10]
DONATE $20 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bennet-aking?refcode=X_110224_BennetKing_act&amount=20] DONATE $50 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bennet-aking?refcode=X_110224_BennetKing_act&amount=50]
DONATE $100 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bennet-aking?refcode=X_110224_BennetKing_act&amount=100] DONATE OTHER [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/bennet-aking?refcode=X_110224_BennetKing_act]
Politics are more divisive than ever. Partisan bickering and extremism have become the new normal. But I truly think that we Americans agree on far more than we disagree on, and we should find common-sense solutions that work for everyone. Every day I go to work in the Senate, I aim to rise above that partisanship to fight for the solutions that benefit all Americans.
Are you with me?
—Angus

Our team has knocked on more than 3 MILLION doors in states that could be decided by a small number of votes. We’re STILL reaching voters who are undecided. Are you with us? Today is the final day of our pre-election fundraising campaign. A group of donors is triple matching every contribution until midnight. MAKE YOUR 3X GIFT >> You know what’s at stake. The future of our democracy — and of our planet — comes down to what happens in the next few days. Every. Single. Vote. Counts.I’ve never seen an election polling this close — where virtually every swing state is a true toss-up. When things are this close, victory will come down to turnout. If the environmental movement turns out, I know we can win.And I also know that if voters who support our issues stay home, Trump will be our next president. So we’re asking one last time today — please, help our organizers knock on doors, call, and text to get environmental voters to the polls. It’s the final weekend before Election Day — our organizers are working around the clock, running on cold coffee and even colder pizza. We’re asking everyone who can to pitch in to let them know: we’re cheering you on! TRIPLE YOUR IMPACT: Help turn out environmental voters in PA, MI, WI, NC, NV, and AZ. Let our organizers know you’ve got their backs! Even $5 helps >> MAKE YOUR 3X GIFT >> Thanks, Peter — for everything you do for people and the planet! # Election Day is TUESDAY!
---
| This past week marks a full year since I quit my job and gave up my housing to start this journey and fight for a better future here in Texas.
It was in incredible feelingto go to the polls on Thursday to check that box next to my nameand reflect on all of the supporters who helped get me to this moment!
---
| **I truly cannot thank you enough!**
Over the past year, I have poured over 5,000 hours into our campaign to Flip Chip, knowing it’s an uphill battle and thatthe game is rigged against us.
Why? Because I believe we deserve a representative who values public service, someone who will work hard to improve our lives instead of playing politics, someone who will represent all of us and is willing to work across the aisle to get things done for us.
We have a lot of problems to solve, and as a scientist, that’s what I’m trained to do and will do for our districtwhen I’m elected to Congress!
---
| In this final push, I will continue to give this campaign my all, by greeting voters at the doors, knocking on doors, and making calls.
Follow along on social media for campaign updates in these final days, and help us out by spreading the word about why you are supporting me and why we must #FlipChip.
