| | | | | If you haven’t caught up on our latest No Doubt About It episodes, you’re in for some real insights and a dose of fiery discussion. Here’s a quick recap of what went down this week, plus a look at what’s coming up! **(Exciting news about Election Night at the end!)**
---
|
# Here’s What You Missed:
---
|
* [**Mayor Keller & a “Mystery” $500,000 Bill:**](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=3e5f4bd00f&e=567664f14c)**** Is Trump really on the hook for this alleged “unpaid bill” from the city? Mark dives into this political stunt and calls on leaders to keep things respectful and safe for everyone as Trump heads into Albuquerque.

---
[](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=e52bb0c93f&e=567664f14c)
|
* **Senator Heinrich’s Rally Comments:** Martin Heinrich suggested that New Mexicans attending the rally might resort to violence. Mark doesn’t hold back as he challenges this rhetoric and urges leaders to put politics aside.

---
[Stream Episode Now](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=1f1456079f&e=567664f14c)
|
* **Trump's Popularity in PA – Insights from John Fetterman:** We dive into Fetterman’s warning for fellow Democrats on Trump’s real support in Pennsylvania. Could Trump sweep both the popular vote and the electoral college?

* **Plus, Krysty tackles a deep and thought-provoking question:** Should Christians engage in politics? It’s a powerful listen that’s sure to get you thinking.

---
[Stream Episode Now](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=0270e26abc&e=567664f14c)
|
# Here’s What’s Coming Up:
---
|
* **Saturday Afternoon Preview:** We’ll drop an early episode with all the latest from the national election, plus our fresh insights after attending the Trump Rally right here in Albuquerque.

* [**Election Night Live Stream – Don’t Miss It!** ](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=529da9b82c&e=567664f14c)Join us Tuesday at 9 pm MST on YouTube for our Election Night Live Stream as we bring you real-time updates on both local and national results.

Tune in, listen, and get involved in the conversation that New Mexico isn’t having anywhere else!

“Voting is fun. Voting is easy. And everyone is doing it!”
When you’re an organizer, that sentence is one of the first things you learn about getting out the vote. The #1 way to make sure people actually go vote is by letting them know those three facts.
Voting is fun. Not only are you exercising your civic duty and your fundamental right by voting, you also get a great sticker!
Voting is easy. Between the 200+ early vote centers in San Diego County, the ballots mailed directly to voters, and the official ballot drop boxes, voting is so easy .
Everyone is doing it. Here in CA, more than five million people have already returned their ballots. It’s a party!
So as you’re going about your weekend, whether you’re canvassing, phonebanking, or just running errands, I hope you’ll tell everyone you talk to that voting is fun, easy, and everyone is doing it – and then remind them to go to IWillVote.com [https://iwillvote.com/] for any and all information they need to go vote!
If you’re looking for volunteer opportunities in these final days, you can find them here [https://go.kamalaharris.com/] . And if you still need to return your own ballot...what are you waiting for?!
Go, vote, win!
-Sara

_Our borders won’t be secured, inflation won’t go down, communities won’t get safer, and government overreach won’t be reeled in_.

body:

Peter, this is probably the longest email you’ll ever get from
me.

But it’s also one of the most important, so it really would mean a lot to
me if you could read through it.

If you’re in a hurry or if you’re already sold and ready to do whatever it
takes to help me defeat Larry Hogan and defend our Senate majority,
[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/33436?t=1010&amount=25&akid=3181%2E52803%2E7kOuRk ]then please consider making a quick grassroots contribution to give us
the resources and momentum to win this race in just 3 days!

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/33436?t=1011&amount=25&akid=3181%2E52803%2E7kOuRk ]Donate

I want to outline our campaign's message to fill Maryland’s open U.S.
Senate seat. It hinges on 3 major components:

Power to the People

This campaign has never been about me,
Peter. It’s always been about
Marylanders, our families, and our communities.

And when Republican Larry Hogan entered the race putting our Democratic
Senate majority at risk, it became about the future of the entire country.

That’s why Republicans are pouring millions of dollars into this race. But
during the Democratic Primary, we proved that Maryland is won by the many,
not by the money.

We’ve never had limitless resources, million dollar checks, or shady dark
money super PACs pulling the strings. Instead, we built a grassroots
coalition of people in every corner of the state who stepped up to
volunteer, donate, and talk to their neighbors about our campaign.

Your time and your contributions were the driving force behind our primary
victory, and we need to continue building on that in order to win on
Tuesday.

Focus on the Issues that Matter

While Republicans are lining up to get behind Donald Trump and his
divisive MAGA agenda, we're focusing on the issues that matter most to
people — like protecting abortion rights, improving wages, and preserving
our democracy.

My Republican opponent Larry Hogan hopes Marylanders won’t remember that
as governor, he vetoed legislation that would have expanded access to
abortion care throughout the state.

He’s banking on Marylanders forgetting that he vetoed a $15 minimum wage
and legislation to benefit unions and workers.

He’s hoping Marylanders won’t realize that electing him means handing
control of the Senate over to extremists like Ted Cruz and Lindsey Graham.

On the issues that matter most, Hogan’s record speaks for itself: He’s all
wrong for Maryland, and he’ll say and do whatever he thinks will win him
this seat.

Make the Case for a Democratic Senate Majority

Here’s the truth,
Peter: There simply isn’t any
way Democrats maintain our razor-thin Senate majority if Larry Hogan wins
this open seat.

Mitch McConnell handpicked Hogan for this race because he sees Maryland as
his best chance to flip a seat, retake the majority, and enact his
far-right, anti-choice agenda.

If the GOP retakes the Senate, they'll have the power to pass a national
abortion ban, roll back environmental protections, undermine our
elections, and so much more.

Hogan has proven that he cannot be trusted to protect our reproductive
rights or put Maryland families first. Defending the Senate is the only
way to protect our freedoms, uplift working families, and preserve our
democracy.

We’ve got a winning message that’s resonating with voters,
Peter, and I need your support
to make sure everyone hears it. [ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/33436?t=1012&amount=25&akid=3181%2E52803%2E7kOuRk ]Can I count on you to chip in $25 to
give our grassroots team the resources we need to reach Marylanders across
the state?

If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your
donation will go through immediately.

Thank you for taking the time to read this, Peter.

Together,

Angela Alsobrooks

In 2016, Donald Trump skillfully manipulated cable news outlets like CNN and Fox News to spread dangerous lies and hatred. **He won because the media prioritized ratings and profits over truth, leaving our country forever changed.**
As Election Day draws closer, it’s clear nothing has changed. Desperate to win and avoid prison, Trump is doubling down on his lies and attempts to stoke fear and anger. Increasingly, he sounds less like a presidential candidate and more like an autocrat.
Unfortunately, judging by the coverage, the media hasn't learned anything in the last decade. Throughout the cycle, they gave Trump wall-to-wall coverage and continued to play “both sides” instead of calling out Trump’s authoritarian ambition.
We founded COURIER as a direct response to these failures. We believe that restoring public trust in journalism is essential to strengthening our democracy. Building that trust starts with calling out misinformation and delivering quality, local news to the communities that need it most.

**2\. We will restore trust in journalism by covering local stories that matter most to the communities we serve.** The best antidote to bad information is good information. We will never compromise our values just to drive clicks and profit.
**3\. We will deliver our news to the online spaces where people spend their time.** Social media newsfeeds. Inboxes. Search engines. By bringing quality journalism to the online spaces where misinformation is thriving, our reporting dismantles right-wing propaganda in real time before it can spread.
Right now, our newsrooms across eleven battleground states are committed to reporting the facts on the issues that matter and calling out and combating misinformation wherever we see it.
**We’re correcting the record on election misinformation as Trump and the right try to spread conspiracies that the election is fraudulent.**

subject: Doing More for Harris This Weekend
body:
Rallies and Resources | |

| | | As evangelical Christians, we know our every action matters to elect Vice President Harris as President, who will lead our country with compassion for the vulnerable, joy, and a commitment to freedom. **_So we prayerfully encourage you to do all you can this weekend, Monday, and Tuesday to elect Vice President Harris as President. Here are rallies to attend with links to preferred viewing areas, resources to help your networks to vote, and a new ad by and for people of faith to watch and share with your communities_**. Please vote, share, and pray as together we elect Vice President Harris as our President on Tuesday. Thank you for all you’re doing. We’re praying for you. [**New Ad By and For People of Faith**](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=87c1cac8bd&e=43463f1dee): **_Please Watch and Share with Your Communities_**

**Rallies: Sign Up, _Invite Friends and Family (These Special Links May Provide Access to Preferred Viewing Areas-please sign up early)_**
* _Sat. Nov. 2: _
* Vice President Harris: [Charlotte, NC](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=9978364479&e=43463f1dee) And [Atlanta, GA](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=f598c85088&e=43463f1dee)
* Michelle Obama: [Philly Suburbs, PA](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=e441f1f1e1&e=43463f1dee)
* Governor Walz: [Tucson, AZ](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=3288e1a5f5&e=43463f1dee) and [Flagstaff, AZ](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=cd642e04d6&e=43463f1dee)
* _Sun. Nov. 3:_
* Vice President Harris: [Lansing, MI](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=f32eaadf3b&e=43463f1dee)

**Resources: _To Equip Your Communities to Vote – see more _**[**_here_**](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=4bd3265d49&e=43463f1dee)
* **Help others make their plan to vote** using [IWillVote.org](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=9b4b020351&e=43463f1dee)
* **Help others vote in whatever way they need** ; for example, giving them a ride;
* [**Host a house party this weekend**](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=c8c3b92544&e=43463f1dee)** With your family and friends to encourage them to vote**; and;
* **Put up a Harris/Walz yard sign**. They make a difference!

**_“Let’s not get tired of doing good, because in time we’ll have a harvest if we don’t give up.” _**(Galatians 6:9)

Blessings,
The Evangelicals for Harris Team

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, the 2024
general election is only three days away.

On Tuesday, we face a critical presidential election that will have
impacts for decades to come, in addition to important races for Congress,
state legislatures, and local office.

Regardless of the outcome, it's clear that our country is divided and in
desperate need of new leaders who can unify everyday people across our
shared priorities and against our shared enemies: corporations,
billionaires, and right-wing extremists.

Everyday people don't see any party fighting for their interests anymore.
They see what we see: corporate Super PACs and billionaire donors
dictating an agenda that rewards the wealthy few at the expense of
everyone else.

The outcomes of Tuesday's election will drastically reshape the future of
our nation and will demand different urgencies from our movement. But no
matter what, this moment calls for building a new Democratic Party, led by
new leaders that working families actually see fighting for their most

Peter, did you see what Kamala Harris had to say about the state of reproductive health in Texas?
“...Texas has a law now that offers a cash bounty for turning in someone who merely helps a friend or a family member get the care they need.

In Texas, the law provides prison for life, for healthcare providers, for doing what they believe is in the best interest of their patient.

In some counties in Texas, they have passed travel bans to prevent women from going to other states to receive care.

**These are the stakes — and we know how we got here.** ”
She’s right — we _do_ know how we got here: In 2021, Texas completely banned abortion with very limited exceptions.
Then, the Texas Supreme Court then ruled that a woman did not qualify for an abortion under the state’s medical exception despite the fact that her doctor determined she needed the procedure to save her life. That decision forced a pregnant woman to travel out of state to receive the care she needed to save her life.
The justices doubled down on that extreme decision this year, ruling against 20 women who said they were denied the ability to receive medically necessary abortions as a result of the state’s extreme abortion ban.
**This is unconscionable, Peter — and we won’t sit on the sidelines while elected state supreme court justices rip away people’s rights.**
The NDRC is proud to have endorsed Judge DaSean Jones, Judge Christine Weems, and Judge Bonnie Lee Goldstein for the Texas Supreme Court because of their commitment to be fair-minded, conduct an independent evaluation of the law, ensuring rights and protecting freedoms.

In Texas, the law provides prison for life, for healthcare providers, for doing what they believe is in the best interest of their patient. In some counties in Texas, they have passed travel bans to prevent women from going to other states to receive care. These are the stakes — and we know how we got here. ” She’s right — we do know how we got here: In 2021, Texas completely banned abortion with very limited exceptions. Then, the Texas Supreme Court then ruled that a woman did not qualify for an abortion under the state’s medical exception despite the fact that her doctor determined she needed the procedure to save her life. That decision forced a pregnant woman to travel out of state to receive the care she needed to save her life. ### **Five Interesting Facts About Voting
**
---
Can we really say we have an “Election Day” anymore?

So many people have already voted that it’s clear voting is now more a season than a single-day event.

And while the way we vote might have changed over the years, the importance of voting hasn't changed a bit.

**Do You Have a Plan to Vote? Will You Bring a Friend Along to the Polls?
**
Your vote might be the one that makes a difference in this election. With so much on the line in this election, we can’t afford to sit it out.

I hope you enjoy these fun voting facts (Make Voting Fun Again!), but most importantly, I hope you MAKE A PLAN TO VOTE!

**Five Fun Facts about Voting & Elections
**
**Absentee Voting: Must Be More than Two Miles from Home**
Pennsylvania was the first state to allow absentee voting during the War of 1812, but you had to be at least two miles from home!

**Bring Your Own Ballot (BYOB?)**
It wasn’t until the election of 1888 that ballots became standardized in the U.S. Before then, voters often brought ballots passed out by political parties or wrote down their choices.

**Astronauts Can Vote from Space**
Thanks to a Texas law passed in 1997, astronauts can cast their votes from space. Using a secure ballot, NASA ensures astronauts are never left out, even when orbiting the Earth.

**Why Tuesday? Why November?**
Tuesday was selected to avoid Sundays (for church) and Wednesdays (market days for farmers). November was chosen because it was after the harvest season and before the harsh winter weather.

**Voting Wasn’t Always Secret**
Before the 1890s, there was nothing secret about voting. In fact, at that time, many people believed voting should be a public act.**

clean_body: | | Five Interesting Facts About Voting Can we really say we have an “Election Day” anymore? So many people have already voted that it’s clear voting is now more a season than a single-day event. And while the way we vote might have changed over the years, the importance of voting hasn't changed a bit. Do You Have a Plan to Vote? Will You Bring a Friend Along to the Polls? Your vote might be the one that makes a difference in this election. With so much on the line in this election, we can’t afford to sit it out. I hope you enjoy these fun voting facts (Make Voting Fun Again!), but most importantly, I hope you MAKE A PLAN TO VOTE! Five Fun Facts about Voting & Elections Absentee Voting: Must Be More than Two Miles from Home Pennsylvania was the first state to allow absentee voting during the War of 1812, but you had to be at least two miles from home! Bring Your Own Ballot (BYOB?) It wasn’t until the election of 1888 that ballots became standardized in the U.S. Before then, voters often brought ballots passed out by political parties or wrote down their choices. Astronauts Can Vote from Space Thanks to a Texas law passed in 1997, astronauts can cast their votes from space. Using a secure ballot, NASA ensures astronauts are never left out, even when orbiting the Earth. Why Tuesday? Why November? Tuesday was selected to avoid Sundays (for church) and Wednesdays (market days for farmers). November was chosen because it was after the harvest season and before the harsh winter weather. Voting Wasn’t Always Secret Before the 1890s, there was nothing secret about voting. In fact, at that time, many people believed voting should be a public act. As these facts show, voting has never been a perfect system, but it is the best way to participate in shaping the future you want for your family and your country. I have said since the beginning that ours is a people-powered campaign. Whether you called your aunt to help her make a plan to vote, put a sign in your window, or donated to this campaign, you are doing the important work of powering our campaign to victory. _Thank you, Peter._ **But it will take millions of individuals acting together to preserve the promise of America.** And, even at this late hour, there are still many voters who have yet to come to a decision about who they will support on Tuesday. This weekend, folks all across the country are knocking on their neighbors’ doors and joining phone banks to have the critical conversations with voters we will need to turn out to win. Governor Walz and I will also be in key battleground states -- like Arizona, Georgia, and Michigan -- sharing our message with voters before they head to the polls. _But we cannot reach every single voter ourselves._ That is why our campaign is taking to the airwaves. **We are launching a special, two-minute long ad that will be our closing argument to undecided voters. clean_body: Even at this late hour, there are still many voters who have yet to come to a decision about who they will support on Tuesday. | | | I have said since the beginning that ours is a people-powered campaign. Whether you called your aunt to help her make a plan to vote, put a sign in your window, or donated to this campaign, you are doing the important work of powering our campaign to victory. Thank you, Peter. But it will take millions of individuals acting together to preserve the promise of America. And, even at this late hour, there are still many voters who have yet to come to a decision about who they will support on Tuesday. This weekend, folks all across the country are knocking on their neighbors’ doors and joining phone banks to have the critical conversations with voters we will need to turn out to win. Governor Walz and I will also be in key battleground states -- like Arizona, Georgia, and Michigan -- sharing our message with voters before they head to the polls. But we cannot reach every single voter ourselves. That is why our campaign is taking to the airwaves. We are launching a special, two-minute long ad that will be our closing argument to undecided voters. I wanted you to be the first to see it, as it would not have been possible without supporters like you. | | Running an ad like this is expensive, but it is important. Because we know that the more voters hear about our campaign, the more they support us. We have only been able to run it so far because supporters like you have stepped up the way you have. But we can’t stop now. Thank you and take care, Kamala Kamala Harris Vice President of the United States | | | |

subject: They want to erase 100 years of progress
body:
alt [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP33/1/100067/images/LOGO.jpg]
Friends,
Just this week, at the MAGA Madison Square Garden Rally, Trump supporters cheered at the idea of taking us back to the turn of the century – the 20th century .
They want to take us back to a time when women had no vote, workplaces were dangerous and unregulated, and freedoms were only for the privileged few.
Since then, one of the authors of Project 2025 went viral joking that they wanted “male only voting.”
It sounds absurd, but this is exactly the future ULTRA-MAGA extremists like Jim Jordan want to bring back.
They’re already attacking women’s rights, stripping reproductive freedoms and even our voting rights.
They’re fighting against equal pay protections and blocking family leave initiatives.
All in some creepy and antiquated belief system that women shouldn’t have power or agency in our society.
In order to ensure this dangerous agenda never sees the light of day we need to defeat its leaders – and that starts with the most dangerous man in Congress Jim Jordan. Donate NOW to show them that we are NOT going back! [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241102_womens_rights_link1]
Their intentions are clear, and they’re not going to stop unless we stand together and fight back with everything we have.
We are a campaign dedicated to building a future where women’s rights are fully protected and respected—where we’re not constantly fighting to keep what’s already ours.
Our vision includes safeguarding reproductive freedom, guaranteeing equal pay, and providing access to family leave, affordable healthcare, and safe workplaces.
Women deserve leaders who champion their voices and protect their choices, not representatives like Jim Jordan, who would strip us of these rights in a heartbeat.
In Jordan’s America, women are seen as second-class citizens, and every day he spends in Congress is another day spent pushing us backward.
If you believe in a future where women have true power and agency, please contribute right now. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20241102_womens_rights_link2]
Let’s send Jim Jordan packing and ensure he never has another chance to threaten our freedoms.
Together, we’ll build a nation that values and protects every woman.
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

**Knock, knock, knock.**

_It’s the scariest sound you’ll hear when you live in a communist country._

_It’s the last sound my parents heard when their fathers were taken away._

_It’s the sound of always living in fear, and it’s my family’s real-life story._

We escaped from Vietnam just days before Saigon fell to the communists, and we were given a new life in the most generous country on Earth.

**America saved my life, and I dedicated my life to paying her back.**

I graduated from the United States Naval Academy and served for 25 years in Navy Special Operations in Iraq, Afghanistan, Somalia, and Pakistan and 40 other countries around the world.

I love this country - but right now, it’s taken a dark turn.

Now, the knocks are coming from Joe Biden’s Department of Justice. Sending two dozen armed agents to arrest a pro-life activist in front of his family. Raiding gun shops and seizing records from law-abiding gun owners. Arresting his challenger in the next election.

_And he’s doing it all while real criminals are free to roam our streets._

We are losing our country. You know it. But you also know we can save it.

I’ve been all over the world. Believe me when I tell you, if America fails, there is nowhere else to go.

**It’s time to save America while we still have a chance.**

**I’m Hung Cao, retired Navy Captain, and I’m running for the United States Senate.**

**[If you’re all-in to defend the greatest country on Earth, join our team today.](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=21eacacf9fca46568f786baf52322b75&_e=26NjsYJtbyCnYXDYB2LdlPdCiOO9uWruKmI3ZojYwDSeZJlMH_K6dpnDMla5nFSAE-PQIIpQWrs-PIMhSR975gwSyYdcXmMET7jrvbbnxnKTE8eNk03VlCDbzhK8wlvXXGb0veEqxkKCv1naRAnxWfJBYtkDAUPp42n4-LzLaixK01QDuLTOT7sfaSFlouMfDGhIPh4mUgMWUQcKBrBmWbsE7Jjdi-sqNFKJ3Jp0iDmX7HAtJrtydZpyaVxAQaiALD9HYFHgrHRA51t4GhOwS4jPTkQedg2SS2kMHjFQOap7gQidc8Wylu7s9znhpjVpXqSk0Ct-edji_KGbuE7DpXwiU-eLkAwlYchWecoNHWehY9ccemBg9Y4HeCh5JgeI)**

And as someone who owes their life to the American Dream, I have an obligation to fight back against those who have trampled on it.

We need REAL fighters. Not politicians, not bureaucrats, and not keyboard warriors acting tough in custom made suits.

If we’re going to preserve our freedoms, we can’t be intimidated. We must be fearless.

clean_body: | | | Knock, knock, knock. It’s the scariest sound you’ll hear when you live in a communist country. It’s the last sound my parents heard when their fathers were taken away. It’s the sound of always living in fear, and it’s my family’s real-life story. We escaped from Vietnam just days before Saigon fell to the communists, and we were given a new life in the most generous country on Earth. America saved my life, and I dedicated my life to paying her back. I graduated from the United States Naval Academy and served for 25 years in Navy Special Operations in Iraq, Afghanistan, Somalia, and Pakistan and 40 other countries around the world. I love this country - but right now, it’s taken a dark turn. Now, the knocks are coming from Joe Biden’s Department of Justice. Sending two dozen armed agents to arrest a pro-life activist in front of his family. Raiding gun shops and seizing records from law-abiding gun owners. Arresting his challenger in the next election. And he’s doing it all while real criminals are free to roam our streets. We are losing our country. You know it. But you also know we can save it. I’ve been all over the world. Believe me when I tell you, if America fails, there is nowhere else to go. It’s time to save America while we still have a chance. I’m Hung Cao, retired Navy Captain, and I’m running for the United States Senate. I still believe America can be the land of opportunity, Fellow Patriot. And as someone who owes their life to the American Dream, I have an obligation to fight back against those who have trampled on it. We need REAL fighters. Not politicians, not bureaucrats, and not keyboard warriors acting tough in custom made suits. If we’re going to preserve our freedoms, we can’t be intimidated. We must be fearless. Let’s win this. In Liberty, CAPT Hung Cao, USN (Ret) Former Navy Special OperationsCandidate, U.S. Senate (VA) | TEXT HUNG TO 21412 | | Paid for by Hung Cao for Virginia | | Use of military rank, job titles, and photographs in uniform does not imply endorsement by the Department of the Navy or the Department of Defense.

body:
| Can I tell you a story about my family farm, folks? [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/83981?t=6&akid=17887%2E878179%2EtbMk5w) In 1910, my grandfather came to Montana. He found a piece of grassy land, took a look at it, and said, “This is the place.” And that’s where the farm began.

He farmed the land until the early 1940s, and then passed it down to my folks. In 1978, my wife Sharla and I took over the farm and we’re still here today, three generations and more than 40 years later.

We’ve made a lot of progress here — Sharla and I built a new home, several steel buildings, and more storage.

The truth is, I love this work. Yes, it makes for early mornings and late nights during planting and harvest seasons — but it also keeps me grounded, and it gives me perspective on the issues we face every day.

When I think about climate change, I’m thinking of folks on farms like mine, struggling with catastrophic droughts or historic levels of flooding. When I think about reforming the USPS, I’m thinking of the people in rural communities across Montana who rely on timely mail delivery for their medication or Social Security checks. And when I think about infrastructure, I’m thinking of the rural towns near mine that need access to affordable, high-speed internet.

**These aren’t abstract issues or talking points. They’re very real challenges that deserve real solutions, and that’s what I’m fighting for in Washington. I spend every single day trying to do right by working families, farmers, students, and veterans here in Montana and across the country.

[I’m running for reelection because there’s still work to be done. Just like my parents and grandparents on the family farm, when I commit to something, I see it through. Can you make a split donation of any amount today between my campaign and Voter Protection Project to help me keep up the fight in Washington?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/83981?t=7&akid=17887%2E878179%2EtbMk5w)** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Jon Tester and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $5 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/83982?t=8&akid=17887%2E878179%2EtbMk5w)

I’ll leave you with one last truth about farming: Some years you get the right amount of rain, and things work out really well. Other years, you get a whole lot less.

That means it’s important to be prepared for any outcome, and to have a support system by your side when things get difficult. We don’t know what this campaign will look like, or what Republicans will throw our way over these final few days. But with your support, we’ll be ready.

I appreciate anything you’re able to pitch in. Thanks for your help, and I hope I make you proud.

— Jon

Team,
There's no way to sugarcoat this: A major party is advocating for a constitutional change in Texas that would codify their power and control into the state constitution. From the Austin American-Statesman:
" The Texas Republican Party platform now calls for a state constitutional amendment to create another requirement for winning statewide office: In addition to winning the most votes statewide, a candidate would have to win a majority of the votes in a majority of Texas’ 254 counties. "
This would create a mini-Electoral College just within Texas itself, with one vote for each county. Harris County, home to Houston and nearly 5 million people, would count exactly the same as Loving County, whose population during the 2020 census was recorded as 64 people .
For example, Texas' current governor won reelection with only 55% of the popular vote but "won" 235 counties. This constitutional amendment, if passed, would guarantee no other party could win a statewide election without taking away all those rural, deeply conservative counties. Opponents of voting rights want to use land, not people, to keep themselves in power permanently.
They're openly advocating for anti-democratic rules to limit the impact of people's votes just because they want to stay in control, Team. --**Nella Domenici**

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/96422961/509945116/162262288?refcode=WTEFEW10_20241102_EOMCloserRS_PL_R3&sourceid=1055387&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5MTcyMzA3YS00NTk5LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QGEy5ZKLpz2C0aBgLWGH2iciULUpf0dZ0POBatPXGA4=) Hi Peter! I don't want to interrupt your weekend, so I'll make this quick. With Election Day around the corner, _right now_ is the most critical time to surge support for EMILYs List women up and down the ballot. **Let me explain: **

Over the past month, I've been on the ground in Michigan, Arizona, Nevada, and a few other key states. I've talked to voters, candidates, and volunteers all across the country. And I can tell you firsthand that the polls and the pundits are right: our women's races will be _close_.

There's a saying in politics, beloved by fundraisers and field organizers alike:**the margin of effort.** When the polls are tight, and a race could go either way, what matters most is the heart, grit, and commitment of the supporters. If we put in the work, we'll win. If we don't, we won't. It's that simple.

Critical races like **VP Kamala Harris', Sen. Tammy Baldwin's (WI-SEN), and Rep. Susan Wild's (PA-07)** now fall squarely within the margin of effort. And your support can help make sure we reach as many voters as possible before Nov. 5. [**Let's give it all we've got, Peter. clean_body: Let me explain what that means: | = Hi Peter! I don't want to interrupt your weekend, so I'll make this quick. With Election Day around the corner, right now is the most critical time to surge support for EMILYs List women up and down the ballot. Let me explain: Over the past month, I've been on the ground in Michigan, Arizona, Nevada, and a few other key states. I've talked to voters, candidates, and volunteers all across the country. And I can tell you firsthand that the polls and the pundits are right: our women's races will be close. There's a saying in politics, beloved by fundraisers and field organizers alike:the margin of effort. When the polls are tight, and a race could go either way, what matters most is the heart, grit, and commitment of the supporters. If we put in the work, we'll win. If we don't, we won't. It's that simple. Critical races like VP Kamala Harris', Sen. Tammy Baldwin's (WI-SEN), and Rep. Susan Wild's (PA-07) now fall squarely within the margin of effort. Well, with a whole lot of hard work (including working in a doughnut shop to help my family get by), long hours, and a ton of hope, we were able to win our American dream. During my time working at Florida International University, I spearheaded a new program to **expand affordable health care access** to more Floridians. But Rick Scott has voted to repeal the Affordable Care Act more times than I care to count. And who can forget he committed one of the largest Medicare frauds in the history of our country. Eventually, I had the honor of serving my community in the U.S. House of Representatives, where I became the first South American immigrant to be elected to Congress! Returning to Utah after his mission for the LDS church in St. Louis, Missouri, Brian’s decision to follow in his family's legal footsteps unfolded organically. Three out of five brothers became lawyers, and Brian decided to become a trial lawyer representing individuals who have been harmed by insurers’ wrongful denial of claims.

The intertwining of family, career, and public service defines Brian's narrative. As an LDS Bishop in the mid-1990s, he embraced connecting with people during vulnerable moments. Political service became a natural extension of Brian's commitment to community. Elected to the State Legislature in 2008, he later assumed the role of House Minority Leader from 2015 to 2023. In navigating the complexities of legislation, Brian learned the art of thoughtful disagreement for the better—a principle he carried into the legislative sphere from his personal and professional life.

In 2022, Brian's life took a new turn when he married Ann Silverberg Williamson, adding twin daughters and a son to his family. Their Brady Bunch family of seven children, along with three grandkids, gathers for family dinners on Mondays. These visits encapsulate the essence of shared values and a commitment to open dialogue.

| **“The U.N.’s Verdict on Climate Progress Over the Past Year: There Was None”** \- The New York Times, Oct. 24, 2024
---
Global climate action has stalled.
The latest U.N. report shows that while fossil fuel pollution surged to a record high last year, our governments are on track to miss the goals set in the Paris Agreement by a wide margin — with warming predicted to reach 2.6–2.8°C by the century’s end.
**Every fraction of a degree the planet warms means deadlier heat waves, more catastrophic wildfires, and a heartbreaking loss of biodiversity.** We can’t let this future become our reality — and that’s why this election matters so much.
November 5th is our best shot to send a message that we won’t accept inaction from our leaders any longer. The U.S. has the power to set a global standard. If we step up, we inspire other nations to act, too. But if we fail, it becomes harder for any country to hit the targets needed to keep our planet livable.

clean_body: Is anybody listening?! | | “The U.N.’s Verdict on Climate Progress Over the Past Year: There Was None” \- The New York Times, Oct. 24, 2024 Global climate action has stalled. The latest U.N. report shows that while fossil fuel pollution surged to a record high last year, our governments are on track to miss the goals set in the Paris Agreement by a wide margin — with warming predicted to reach 2.6–2.8°C by the century’s end. Every fraction of a degree the planet warms means deadlier heat waves, more catastrophic wildfires, and a heartbreaking loss of biodiversity. We can’t let this future become our reality — and that’s why this election matters so much. November 5th is our best shot to send a message that we won’t accept inaction from our leaders any longer. The U.S. has the power to set a global standard. If we step up, we inspire other nations to act, too. But if we fail, it becomes harder for any country to hit the targets needed to keep our planet livable. Electing climate champions who we can actually urge to act could be the turning point. With just 3 days until Election Day, we need to know: How urgent is it to you to elect climate leaders who are dedicated to following through on their climate promises? Select One: Your response matters because, right now, your voice and your vote will ensure we keep our leaders accountable and elect climate champions who treat the climate crisis with the urgency it deserves. | | | Donald Trump is once again stoking the fires of violence, this time threatening Liz Cheney with a firing squad, saying she should face "nine (rifle) barrels." And he may have broken the law: _" Speaking to a local TV station on Friday, Arizona Attorney General Kris Mayes said Trump might have violated state laws that prohibit death threats._ _" I have already asked my criminal division chief to start looking at that statement, analyzing it for whether it qualifies as a death threat under Arizona's laws," Mayes told 12News. ([source](https://default.salsalabs.org/T5a6e60e8-14a3-4aba-8711-d987a1ae92af/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9))_ [**Add your name, and urge Mayes to prosecute Trump.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T9a9cdae2-7eb5-4d69-90e3-dbec9a12a8fc/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Trump is not only threatening violence directly, he is whipping his supporters into a frenzy, knowing full well that many of them will be provoked into violence. It's just like what he did with the January 6th attack on the Capitol, and we can't let him get away with it. [**Sign the petition, and join us in urging that Trump be prosecuted for threatening Liz Cheney.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf339efb7-b9bb-4122-a8f3-160391e64979/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | | A lot of folks probably don’t know this, folks, but Kamala Harris and I actually go way back. Both of us came up in public service as district attorneys, and over the last decade, we’ve fought hard to protect our communities and provide opportunities for all families. She’s been a mentor and friend for more than 14 years, and our relationship has helped shape how I view public service. I often refer to her as “ _my quintessential big sister_ ,” because she has always shown up for me when I needed her. In fact, when I first won my race to become Prince George’s County Executive, one of the first calls I received was from her. I’d like to share one piece of advice that she shared with me: _More important than being first at something is to make sure you are not the last._ And now that we’re standing on the precipice of electing our country’s first woman president, that advice feels more appropriate than ever. Once again, it seems we have a huge opportunity to elevate one another’s message and campaign, and deliver for those we seek to represent. * We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness. We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution. We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal. We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night. We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans. Peter, I'm proud to say that Right Wing Revolution is like NO OTHER book you've read from the Right before: It's NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between Left and Right. It's NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American. It's NOT a call for our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference - instead, its focus is on how all Americans can improve our country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving ourselves. I want to get my new book in the hands of as many Americans as possible --which is why I'm offering to send you a hardcover edition for FREE. In this defining moment for America's future, let's come together in a spirit of FREEDOM and with a firm belief in AMERICAN GREATNESS to find all that's possible in the days ahead. Thank YOU for your patriotism, moral courage, and continued support of Turning Point USA. For America, Charlie Kirk Founder & CEO Turning Point USA 4940 East Beverly Road Phoenix, Arizona 85044

Peter, The education establishment has a track record of opposing anyone and everyone who wants to diversify the education system.

They did it with the homeschool movement and argued parents were unfit to provide their children with a proper education. But when it came to test scores, homeschooled kids outperformed their counterparts in public education.

In fact, in every state where education vouchers are available, public funding has increased, and test scores have improved... because competition works.

_Now, the education establishment is at it again._ This time, they're dead set on preventing education dollars from following the student, whether that's in a public school, private school, charter school, or homeschool. **[_THIS IS WRONG >>_](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=dda8ea24889f473da5d1e103c0ca83ed&_e=mdlmcbFqsnbtU3_LTyxvG8k7R8sX1MZ4nUsOwb9Vgrcr1o_Dn_PH-Bp0qNPH5iwYBPC0f7QXzgV4Ohx1OAazC2SvJVEfKxEy62UftBLRRn7yXDICo9NpEeAQpPFuYnuOb8KExHUzS6BYjibkp2dx5A_PXw0Kok38cPMwfkBnnBMd1qwl2_M_A3QJnHMpRp-zO1WRI5ryNTt7-wnSdiwujh1v9yZFFtuYXpGiUIgEJo_4GIRCFLeXS-1WA5ghq25HfjgDFCSC0N1RP8WdRtDapXO1hDbYTRJTRhf8Nlkiz0YdF7SZLhPpqkHzS-E8Ww4UQn-h6CGbdtmikWq12LYKt-9YIhZzH66kBgiQx7mQg3kvGI54Xef-VI4AOc8D5GLCWcpruLhdbxy8O_PLKkYx8tg4S4lPIAmno3hdi092ELyG4nviPO_beHoJoU-kriQj)**

clean_body: The education establishment has a track record of opposing anyone and everyone who wants to diversify the education system. | | | Peter, The education establishment has a track record of opposing anyone and everyone who wants to diversify the education system. They did it with the homeschool movement and argued parents were unfit to provide their children with a proper education. But when it came to test scores, homeschooled kids outperformed their counterparts in public education. In fact, in every state where education vouchers are available, public funding has increased, and test scores have improved... because competition works. Now, the education establishment is at it again. This time, they're dead set on preventing education dollars from following the student, whether that's in a public school, private school, charter school, or homeschool. Peter, I truly believe education freedom is the civil rights issue of our time. Every child, regardless of their family's income or zip code, deserves access to the best education possible--and that starts with vouchers. Greater competition means greater results, which directly benefit our sons and daughters. At the end of the day, the school choice movement is about ensuring every child has his or her needs met, and that every child has their God-given ability to flourish and thrive. Peter, every day, I fight to protect our rights, freedoms, and the Constitution. Part of fighting for those rights includes ensuring parents have the freedom to choose the best education for their children. Kari Lake has more resources at her disposal than we do, and we are falling behind. The way we retake the momentum is you. If everyone reading this donated just $5, we would not only fully fund our advertising in this final week. We would not only receive a historic number of donations. body:
We have an opportunity in just 3 days to protect our Senate majority, take back the House, send Kamala Harris and Tim Walz to the White House, and truly make the kind of progress the American people deserve.

| Friends,

If you’re particularly stressed about the 2024 elections, it can sometimes be easy to start to feel a bit of a sense of hopelessness. People are feeling anxious, and I get it — elections are stressful (for both candidates and voters!), and the stakes are high.

**But take it from an optimist: Nothing is a foregone conclusion, and we DO have the power to create the outcomes we all want in this election.**

We have an opportunity _in just 3 days_ to protect our Senate majority, take back the House, send Kamala Harris and Tim Walz to the White House, and truly make the kind of progress the American people deserve.

**And I’m genuinely optimistic that together, we can get it done! But it won’t happen without a little elbow grease, and _it definitely won’t happen if we give in to hopelessness._ Are you with me?**

[_**Split a donation of any amount that’s meaningful to you today between my campaign and Abigail Spanberger, and let’s use these final days to turn out a record-breaking number of Democratic voters.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96425612/509953998/426278963?refcode=BLU_EM_ASFG_2024-11-02_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjQvMS8xMDM4NTgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNzAzNzU2OTMtNTA5OS1lZjExLTg4Y2UtMDAwZDNhOThmYTZiIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=k5t_es0GkPtihd04prYCWIgQAyUyfTTDeV_-KbliFQI=)

**Knock, knock, knock.**

_It’s the scariest sound you’ll hear when you live in a communist country._

_It’s the last sound my parents heard when their fathers were taken away._

_It’s the sound of always living in fear, and it’s my family’s real-life story._

We escaped from Vietnam just days before Saigon fell to the communists, and we were given a new life in the most generous country on Earth.

**America saved my life, and I dedicated my life to paying her back.**

I graduated from the United States Naval Academy and served for 25 years in Navy Special Operations in Iraq, Afghanistan, Somalia, and Pakistan and 40 other countries around the world.

I love this country - but right now, it’s taken a dark turn.

Now, the knocks are coming from Joe Biden’s Department of Justice. Sending two dozen armed agents to arrest a pro-life activist in front of his family. Raiding gun shops and seizing records from law-abiding gun owners. Arresting his challenger in the next election.

_And he’s doing it all while real criminals are free to roam our streets._

We are losing our country. You know it. But you also know we can save it.

I’ve been all over the world. Believe me when I tell you, if America fails, there is nowhere else to go.

**It’s time to save America while we still have a chance.**

**1) This election is as close as it gets.** Polling shows us up 2% with tons of undecided voters. Two years ago, against the very same opponent, Andrea won with just 50.1% of the vote. The margin came down to 7,210 individual voters. If even half of the people reading this email pitch in $3, that’s enough to reach another 7,000 undecided voters with digital ads highlighting Andrea’s vision for lowering costs.

### Observers who wring their hands about the presidential election fail to realize how little it could conceivably do to support the crumbling vestiges of democracy in America
| | [Shahid Buttar](https://substack.com/@shahidbuttar)
---

As the presidential election currently underway lumbers to its culmination next Tuesday, writers across the political spectrum are issuing what some have described as "[closing arguments](https://substack.com/redirect/1f2c3e3c-a88d-418e-94b5-731e710ee350?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)." Many make important points. I write today to observe a few that seem to remain widely overlooked.
To imagine that the United States can save itself from fascism with an election among candidates handpicked by corporate elites, who agree on continuing a genocide and escalating human rights abuses at our nation's borders, and whose only disagreements appear to relate to personal epithets and lofty rhetoric about supposed rights that Democrats cynically abandoned even before Republicans, is worse than a cruel joke. It verges on public gaslighting....
_Thanks for reading Chronicles of a Dying Empire! You can help inform your friends by sharing this post._
[ Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1018597&post_id=151079455&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTUxMDc5NDU1LCJpYXQiOjE3MzA1Nzc0NjEsImV4cCI6MTczMzE2OTQ2MSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTEwMTg1OTciLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0._dx_r-DsrQ_kNvTv6iJaJon9SwcjLpoq3KL0TvGywgM)
### **A fascist rally in New York City**
Trump's rally at Madison Square Garden on Sunday was replete with [racist rhetoric](https://substack.com/redirect/c21a8036-d7fc-426a-875e-85157c428287?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and fairly described by journalists who covered it as a fascist rally, evoking [an earlier one](https://substack.com/redirect/e1184ebd-6836-459d-a0ab-9ee6156294a3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) held in the same venue in 1939.
But the 2024 version was more than just a rally on the eve of a critical election declaring one side's support for fascism. It was a reflection of the bipartisan state of American politics.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2e06f007-7850-4697-95ed-86d83272ca64?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Marshall Curry, an observer of last Sunday's rally who previously directed [a short documentary film](https://substack.com/redirect/8ec44aef-74c7-4446-814c-0b9ee1c7b200?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about its precursor in 1939, shared some pointed reflections in its wake. Speaking with _Forward_ magazine, he [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/a091b0ad-46a9-4830-9350-7c0fe7996954?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that:
> [S]uddenly all of these same people who are like my friends and family and neighbors seemed swept up by a lot of the dark stuff that was being spouted at them from the stage....you see this audience of Americans in their hats and their suits and their dresses, and they've dropped their kids off with the babysitter and gone out for an evening to cheer and laugh as somebody attacks people who will be killed by the millions in the next couple of years.
> ...
> [People] don't need to listen to liberals like me about whether [Trump is] a fascist; his own chief of staff and his own chairman of the joint chiefs and Liz Cheney...all three of those people have said he's a fascist. His own vice president, who served with him, will not endorse him because...he put himself over the Constitution.
Trump's rally was orchestrated by figures calculating that the racist perspectives featured by speakers would serve them, rather than alienate potential supporters. The mere fact that anyone would seriously embrace that calculation in 2024 is a reflection of how far our country has retreated from [the vision of a post-racial society](https://substack.com/redirect/78329851-8a51-4808-81d2-ca9071109d6b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) imagined by Barack Obama and his supporters nearly 20 years ago.
### **Liberals wring their hands while refusing to look in the mirror**
Kamala Harris has correctly labeled Trump a fascist, while refusing to look in the mirror or acknowledge that fascism is as [structural and cultural as it is political](https://substack.com/redirect/246073ea-6e88-4071-949e-5c322cc121b6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and a more apt description of a system than any particular politician produced by it. Put simply, Democrats now claim to fear fascism after having long enabled it.
Biden was chosen through back room deals [in 2020](https://substack.com/redirect/656e9269-ddbe-4ed0-9b24-4ceea2ca7b24?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and before that [in 2008](https://substack.com/redirect/dcd33772-5d99-430c-80ff-9a2ece319978?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Like him, Harris was chosen through backroom deals [in 2024](https://substack.com/redirect/64922de6-1a40-4d05-ae00-e8549d5576d1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) after withdrawing from the [2020 primary](https://substack.com/redirect/5e515246-c393-4c2e-be0f-a47986533b56?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), in which she failed to win a single state primary, including the one in her home state. Neither of them can claim any democratically defensible pathway to their current positions, let alone the mantle they claim of defenders of democracy.
The United States has never embodied democracy at any point in its history, and to imagine it to have done so sadly does a disservice to both history and the concept of democracy.
_Chronicles of a Dying Empire is a publication supported by readers, rather than advertisers. To receive new posts,**sign up for a free subscription!** To support my work documenting what professional journalists lack the independence to observe, please consider becoming a paid subscriber._
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..lG2SRO6lxOYF1OxbHPnFeCCLKSkR-7BnZR3qznBOD5Y?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=151079455)
To imagine that the United States can save itself from fascism with an election among candidates handpicked by corporate elites, who agree on continuing a genocide and escalating human rights abuses at our nation's borders, and whose only disagreements appear to relate to personal epithets and lofty rhetoric about supposed rights that Democrats cynically abandoned even before Republicans, is worse than a cruel joke. It verges on public gaslighting, which is precisely what propagandists get paid to do.
### **What is fascism?**
Kamala's description of Trump as a fascist takes some inspiration from his own former appointees. [Many](https://substack.com/redirect/e7a1cbab-935e-4e8c-92c4-a67211aaad85?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) have described him, his mannerisms, and his policies, as similar to those embraced by Adolf Hitler in the last century.
But to reduce fascism to an aesthetic overlooks the extent to which it is actually rooted in particular principles which both Democrats and Republicans have widely come to embrace. [Fascism is defined](https://substack.com/redirect/8b63bb7a-a5cf-4534-8992-6b30454fde0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by specific and particular elements, including the fusion of the public and private spheres; xenophobia towards immigrants and foreigners; international belligerence and militarism; and a disregard for human rights. Every one of those factors suggests that fascism is not only a threat under a future Trump presidency, but [has been a defining feature of the United States for at least the past generation](https://substack.com/redirect/b0284cca-8e2a-41af-b865-7941f4f36674?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Among the issues where Democrats have shamelessly moved towards the right wing, in both rhetoric and policy, is immigration. The United States has long prided itself on being a nation composed of immigrants. Poems inviting immigrants to come to our shores are [literally inscribed in stone](https://substack.com/redirect/5eda3bb7-fd9c-43b6-bf7e-d83cf19c2bdf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at the base of national monuments.
Yet, across political parties, Americans have turned their backs on themselves and their own histories, demonizing migrant laborers and their families as everything from "rapists and murderers" (to borrow Donald Trump's phrasing) to threats to American jobs and prosperity, ignoring the fact that immigrants typically [work harder](https://substack.com/redirect/a882485b-e127-49c0-9ec7-0f213fa445ee?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) than people born in the United States and are more often job creators then competitors for working class jobs.
_Help inform your friends!_
[ Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=1018597&post_id=151079455&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTUxMDc5NDU1LCJpYXQiOjE3MzA1Nzc0NjEsImV4cCI6MTczMzE2OTQ2MSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTEwMTg1OTciLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0._dx_r-DsrQ_kNvTv6iJaJon9SwcjLpoq3KL0TvGywgM)
Meanwhile, international belligerence and militarism have become firmly entrenched under both political parties. In fact, Harris' greatest electoral threat is the possibility that so many voters, particularly in the pivotal state of Michigan, stand aside rather than support her given her complicity in an [escalating genocide in Gaza](https://substack.com/redirect/7cdb2af8-5cd6-4ed1-8d64-741431196909?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
American foreign policy [remains defined](https://substack.com/redirect/09928d66-fe53-4883-a04d-76da48377a02?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by any opportunity to sell weapons to any particular dictator abroad. That is a defining factor of not only fascism, but of an international role in spreading it across the globe. That role, meanwhile, has been firmly entrenched for the past 75 years, even though oblivious journalists and editors lack the independence to observe the reality under their feet that compromised their independence a long time ago.
To counter their complicity in international human rights abuses, Democrats claim to care a great deal about the inclusion of domestic minority communities. Yet they have [actively leveraged white supremacy as an election strategy](https://substack.com/redirect/367e0635-b9b7-4647-9d16-ec1d7bd524bf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) when threatened by voices from within the communities they claim to defend. To imagine the Democratic Party as anything but fascist requires profound ignorance, which has grown unfortunately widespread through the co-opted work of journalists.
### **Billionaires wield capital as a weapon louder than any vote**
> [N]ewspapers across the country have announced their unapologetic abandonment of journalism at the behest of wealthy owners putting their financial interests before the ethical interests of journalism, and the role of journalism in what Americans imagine to be a functional democracy.
> ...
> The loss of an independent press is as much an indication of fascism as bipartisan fealty to Israel.
"One person, one vote" is a great vision. The Supreme Court [relied on it](https://substack.com/redirect/1fcd735a-59e2-4e81-afb7-1d5ce520071c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) when striking down an earlier era of unapologetically skewed representation. Yet no one seems to blink today, as wealthy capitalists demonstrate unprecedented influence making a mockery of the political equality on which democracy relies.
For instance, consider the vastly different levels of political power enjoyed by essential workers [forced to work](https://substack.com/redirect/617133d9-f2b6-4e3d-abd7-d5d83e82b7b4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--even at the risk of their own health in the middle of a global pandemic--and billionaire tech bros whose whims threaten to shift the election. One is entirely funding the ground game of one of the candidates, which appears to have revealed [predictable gaps](https://substack.com/redirect/24d52de3-7287-41a8-a14b-80f3d683e691?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) when trying to mobilizing a workforce [without even telling workers what they're working on](https://substack.com/redirect/6ef78b2f-4925-4a4b-9a47-ac4f3dc02c3c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) until after they've been hired and signed nondisclosure agreements.
As if billionaires personally funding presidential turnout campaigns were not enough, newspapers across the country have announced their unapologetic abandonment of journalism at the behest of wealthy owners putting their financial interests before the ethical interests of journalism, and the role of journalism in what Americans imagine to be a functional democracy.
Both the _Los Angeles Times_ and the _Washington Post_ have been forced by their respective owners, both billionaires, not to endorse a presidential candidate. On the one hand, this doesn't particularly bother me, since both of the candidates nominated by the major political parties have been complicit in the rise of fascism, and there isn't much meaningful daylight between them for the legions of precarious people challenged by existential risks, such as homelessness, police violence, Washington-backed state terrorism, or the operation of markets that relentlessly prey on working people.
On the other hand, newspapers refusing to do their jobs at the behest of their wealthy owners reflect a structural problem beyond the circumstances of any particular election. Journalists at both the _Post_ and the _Times_ have ridiculed their respective owners, while subscribers have been defecting from both publications en masse.
The point remains, however, that these news organizations have abandoned the project of reporting on current events and opining about electoral options, more or less, because they are intimidated by the prospect of being held accountable by a future administration. That is the quintessence of timidity, the abdication of an ethical role to which journalism is institutionally committed, and for which it is granted substantial protection under the First Amendment of the U.S. Constitution.
The loss of an independent press is as much an indication of fascism as bipartisan fealty to Israel. Imagining a non-fascist future for the United States requires a wholesale revolution. One was offered in 2016, and again 2020, but suppressed by Democrats shamelessly willing to undermine, marginalize, and even deploy false accusations against their own strongest standard bearers.
Musk's role at Twitter, and Bezos's role at the _Washington Post_ , demonstrate all of the predictable and gross realities of oligarchy. Any number of people have observed them, while continuing to pretend that a presidential election can avoid the fascism that has already structurally consolidated itself. When the world's richest men co-opt critical institutions of mass communication and unapologetically bend them to serve their whims, we can all rest assured that any pretense of democracy faded a long time ago.

The article featured races that we are actively involved in here at the NDRC: Michigan, Montana, Ohio, and North Carolina. In Montana, Politico reports that Planned Parenthood has warned that two right-wing candidates would ban abortion if elected. | | I’m so proud to be a part of Fair Fight’s work in this critical moment for our country. [**That’s why I’m asking if you can make a donation today to help them reach voters in the final days of this election.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96427214/509959768/1373839404?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20241102_f_EOM3_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZjJlZDM3MS01NTk5LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UMP2RnFFTs_t2ebCFm24XQpubhry3z6hkTBiq7qlraQ=) I think about political behavior a lot — what inspires or encourages someone to vote, and how that intersects with race and ethnicity. So of course I’d be drawn to an organization that was co-founded by a Black woman after experiencing voter suppression in her historic run for Governor. Over the years, Fair Fight has served as a leading champion for voting rights and free and fair elections. Fair Fight has helped restore thousands of voters to the voting rolls, taken on voter suppression, and exposed the biggest threats to democracy head on. Protecting people of color, disabled folks, the elderly, young voters, rural voters, and the homeless and unhoused, they are dedicated to uplifting the opportunity for every voter to make their voice heard and be fairly represented. This year, this work is more important than ever. Across the country, and especially in Georgia, we’re seeing increasingly aggressive attacks on the right to vote:
* More legislation specifically designed to deny voters their rights;
* Mass voter purges in attempts to remove thousands from voter rolls;
* Xenophobic lies circulating about noncitizens turning out to vote;
* Election officials attempting to disrupt the election certification process and administration.

And with two well-known and documented election deniers running on the Republican ticket for the highest office, we must be committed to doing all we can to fight for our freedoms. [**Fair Fight needs to be ready to respond swiftly and effectively to attempts to undermine free and fair elections — your contribution today can help them empower voters, train volunteers, create educational materials, and stop anti-voter extremists.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/96427215/509959769/1373839404?refcode=bsc_emm_ff_20241102_f_EOM3_v1s2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDMvMS84ODQ1MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZjJlZDM3MS01NTk5LWVmMTEtODhjZS0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UMP2RnFFTs_t2ebCFm24XQpubhry3z6hkTBiq7qlraQ=) I’m grateful for everything the Fair Fight team has done to expose voter suppression and protect access to the polls, and your support plays a vital role in this fight. Thank you for all that you do. Christina Greer

clean_body: Protecting our elections, this year and in the future | | | I’m so proud to be a part of Fair Fight’s work in this critical moment for our country. = I think about political behavior a lot — what inspires or encourages someone to vote, and how that intersects with race and ethnicity. So of course I’d be drawn to an organization that was co-founded by a Black woman after experiencing voter suppression in her historic run for Governor. Over the years, Fair Fight has served as a leading champion for voting rights and free and fair elections. Fair Fight has helped restore thousands of voters to the voting rolls, taken on voter suppression, and exposed the biggest threats to democracy head on. Protecting people of color, disabled folks, the elderly, young voters, rural voters, and the homeless and unhoused, they are dedicated to uplifting the opportunity for every voter to make their voice heard and be fairly represented. This year, this work is more important than ever. Across the country, and especially in Georgia, we’re seeing increasingly aggressive attacks on the right to vote: More legislation specifically designed to deny voters their rights; Mass voter purges in attempts to remove thousands from voter rolls; Xenophobic lies circulating about noncitizens turning out to vote; Election officials attempting to disrupt the election certification process and administration. And with two well-known and documented election deniers running on the Republican ticket for the highest office, we must be committed to doing all we can to fight for our freedoms. = I’m grateful for everything the Fair Fight team has done to expose voter suppression and protect access to the polls, and your support plays a vital role in this fight. If anti-choice Republicans win, they'll finish the job they started, and two and a half years _from now_ , abortion will likely be banned nationwide. The most draconian bans — like the ones currently in place in Texas and Georgia, which have forced women to flee their states for lifesaving care — could be the law of the land. And then they'll come for IVF. And contraception.

This election is about freedom. We're fighting for the right to make decisions about our own bodies and futures. And every election since _Roe_ fell has shown that if we stay clear-eyed about those stakes, _we will win_. **Abortion. Wins. Elections.**

Everyone's got an opinion on this election. So we're here to remind you that the stakes of these races, while high, are actually very simple. The reality is that since the U.S. Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade , one in three women of reproductive age now lives in a state with an abortion ban. | = If Democratic pro-choice women win on Nov. 5, we can start repairing the damage done by Republicans over the past two and a half years. If anti-choice Republicans win, they'll finish the job they started, and two and a half years from now , abortion will likely be banned nationwide. The most draconian bans — like the ones currently in place in Texas and Georgia, which have forced women to flee their states for lifesaving care — could be the law of the land. And then they'll come for IVF. And contraception. This election is about freedom. We're fighting for the right to make decisions about our own bodies and futures. And every election since Roe fell has shown that if we stay clear-eyed about those stakes, we will win. Abortion. Wins. Unfortunately, my grandmother’s story isn’t unique, Peter.

**_Hi Team Mackenzie, _**

3 days to go!

Because of everyone's help, we are finishing strong. I cannot thank our volunteers enough. While the Wild campaign is busing in volunteers from NEW YORK, we are talking to voters with volunteers from the Lehigh Valley. You have all been amazing. Tomorrow (Sunday) will be nice, and we are finishing strong. Below are a couple of opportunities, one in Lehigh County and one in Northampton County, for door-knocking.

**
**

**Monday 11/4/2024** : ALL DAY Office open from 9:30 AM to 8:00 PM Location: Mackenzie HQ 1125 S Cedar Crest Blvd. Allentown PA (bottom floor)

**Tuesday, 11/5/2024 - ELECTION DAY:** If you have not contacted Sara yet about poll greeting on election day, please call her at 484-860-5989 or stop into the Mackenzie HQ office at the times listed above.

Sincerely,

ANDRES WELLER
Ryan Mackenzie for U.S. Congress
Campaign Manager

We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. | | Fellow Patriot,I have an important message that I didn’t think I’d be sending you today. In just a moment, I am going to ask you to make a contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate. November 5th is _days away_ , and I’d really appreciate the chance to explain why this request — especially today — is so critically important.Here’s the truth:Right now, we have a week of media buys to pay for — the most important week of the entire campaign. And if we don’t raise what we need now, we will be forced to give up the airwaves and let Adam Schiff and the Democrat-machine backing him up run their attacks on me unopposed.What matters most right now is that we do whatever we can to fund a campaign that can win. That’s the most important thing. Winning this race. Not just for the sake of winning, but because of what it would mean to substitute my presence with Adam Schiff’s in the Senate.That’s a reality I don’t think any of us want to consider, but it’s what will happen if we come up short.Now, time is running out. Peter, The education establishment has a track record of opposing anyone and everyone who wants to diversify the education system.

They did it with the homeschool movement and argued parents were unfit to provide their children with a proper education. But when it came to test scores, homeschooled kids outperformed their counterparts in public education.

In fact, in every state where education vouchers are available, public funding has increased, and test scores have improved... because competition works.

_Now, the education establishment is at it again._ This time, they're dead set on preventing education dollars from following the student, whether that's in a public school, private school, charter school, or homeschool. **[_THIS IS WRONG >>_](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=afb1cbc88cc4406794d7beeb2ea4882c&_e=nMUKdHBZIEmqSK13Y4xIS-SBSDMIrr7-JPuAA4klC1JtJuwe7Cw-dxIwrUP_vpEmD6VUz3gPXifKLaJMBSqQ8U3qZWHmjSdJTItH_VhYWWq6NE_P9OciuVnW9in_AZ-quvxCmf0sroe0L6i1mlGjed7E49vje3IoZ9KSHhKmxBdSMKjl1la4WbcHimWYAcyiMaZOTTf28OxO4xd7zgqob52sAzYpcROKh7xHY_j928zjq-UfmKeX_s0gs5OS4eDJ6lBi-Lx_qEBciGahdGbjuAPp3RYudQoGRwNzyUIksJ819Vw1CxwyAsCQVQ8U5M6UVlvCf4HfRkE7ZLzngiEIUKu2qmv58QysmCRB9vuVZqgN23Oihtu-XcPPJ5iYT89mn3x0vhlRpt0dBwjvC7sEh3DTL_aQcVbNOQWTuhS3rRRcRzB69fnhYE-IbIoGd0Bx)**

**Peter, I truly believe education freedom is the civil rights issue of our time.**

Every child, regardless of their family's income or zip code, deserves access to the best education possible--and that starts with vouchers. Greater competition means greater results, which directly benefit our sons and daughters.

At the end of the day, the school choice movement is about ensuring every child has his or her needs met, and that every child has their God-given ability to flourish and thrive. [**With education freedom, we can ensure that 's a reality for every child, in every state.**](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=afb1cbc88cc4406794d7beeb2ea4882c&_e=nMUKdHBZIEmqSK13Y4xIS-SBSDMIrr7-JPuAA4klC1JtJuwe7Cw-dxIwrUP_vpEmD6VUz3gPXifKLaJMBSqQ8U3qZWHmjSdJTItH_VhYWWq6NE_P9OciuVnW9in_AZ-quvxCmf0sroe0L6i1mlGjed7E49vje3IoZ9KSHhKmxBdSMKjl1la4WbcHimWYAcyiMaZOTTf28OxO4xd7zgqob52sAzYpcROKh7xHY_j928zjq-UfmKeX_s0gs5OS4eDJ6lBi-Lx_qEBciGahdGbjuAPp3RYudQoGRwNzyUIksJ_nLueElJr-ZNimGHeE0wM9tH3H0WSCPEMFjJXklLMbYzYH5lz2msDgtmlNuf1NTOaIiNS1MJLDuIPynsbjBq_Ggx-blH8WQWSSr4Q1sNh5Cn64qB3yvoUWOY4T_jtOt854UW5RHuTZUGyRgxKtWSuc)
