clean_body: The education establishment has a track record of opposing anyone and everyone who wants to diversify the education system. | | | Peter, The education establishment has a track record of opposing anyone and everyone who wants to diversify the education system. They did it with the homeschool movement and argued parents were unfit to provide their children with a proper education. But when it came to test scores, homeschooled kids outperformed their counterparts in public education. In fact, in every state where education vouchers are available, public funding has increased, and test scores have improved... because competition works. Now, the education establishment is at it again. This time, they're dead set on preventing education dollars from following the student, whether that's in a public school, private school, charter school, or homeschool. Peter, I truly believe education freedom is the civil rights issue of our time. Every child, regardless of their family's income or zip code, deserves access to the best education possible--and that starts with vouchers. Greater competition means greater results, which directly benefit our sons and daughters. At the end of the day, the school choice movement is about ensuring every child has his or her needs met, and that every child has their God-given ability to flourish and thrive. Peter, every day, I fight to protect our rights, freedoms, and the Constitution. Part of fighting for those rights includes ensuring parents have the freedom to choose the best education for their children. In liberty, Rand Paul | | | | | | Paid for by Rand Paul for Senate | | P.O. Hi, it’s Tammy Baldwin. We got an alarming polling update today, and I wanted you to be the first to know: **Eric Hovde has officially taken the lead for the first time in public polling — a brand new poll from Trafalgar shows me down by one point, 49-48.** This moment has been building up for months. He and his Republican allies launched a $100 million ad blitz to close the polling gap and buy this seat, and they’ve never been closer to succeeding. I don’t mean to be alarmist, but we’re running out of time to fight back. Team: More than 700,000 North Carolinians had their voter registration “purged” before Election Day. The State Elections Board made the announcement of compliance with state law.
This means that North Carolina -- emerging as a crucial state in this year's election -- completed their removal of roughly 10% of their 7.7 million registered voters a little more than a month before the election.
T hese state by state purges, driven by lies and disinformation, often disenfranchise legitimate registered voters who haven’t moved or had other changes to their status as voters . We've seen it reported in other states, like Georgia, and we're sure it's the case in North Carolina this year too.
What can we do about it with just weeks to go and voting already starting? To start, you can ask your friends and family in North Carolina to check their registration status, make sure they are still on the rolls, and make a plan for voting. If you knew a donation of $10 could defeat Kari Lake for good, wouldn’t you chip it in right away?

If you knew that $10 could help defeat Trump in Arizona (and probably make sure he loses nationwide) wouldn’t that be some of the best money you’ve ever spent?

If that $10 donation could put an end to the last eight years of MAGA Right politics and help us move forward, together, as a country... Why wouldn’t you donate?

It might not seem like your donation of $10 could do all that. Up against millions of dollars from Lake and the outside groups who are trying to get her elected, I get that.

But I’ve got to tell you: Just about every dollar we’ve raised in this campaign has come from someone like you, chipping in whatever they could, when the time was right for them.

Those donations have gotten us this far. 400,000 of them.

And today, I need you to make one more. With Kari Lake outspending us on television, every dollar we raise goes towards narrowing the gap.

Your $10 could determine the outcome of this election. Really. [**So, please. **I will always identify with and advocate for the lower and middle class.** I was born in High Point, NC, to a hardworking, caring mother. From a young age, I was taught values like determination, hard work, and resilience.

Watching my mother care about her community as much as she did pushed me into a career of giving back: education.

**I will always advocate for public education and for all students.** After serving as an educator at Bennett College for 4 decades, I became the first Black woman elected to the Greensboro City School Board where I served for 2 years.

But by then, I knew even more needed to be done.

So I went on to serve on the Greensboro City Council for 9 years, and then the State House for a total of 10 terms. _Now this brings us to how I ended up in your inbox today_ —**I was then elected to represent the Charlotte area in Congress in 2014 because my work wasn’t finished yet!**

And while I worked hard to get here, I know that times have changed. _Working hard is not enough when you’re not earning enough._

**That’s why I am focused on addressing the 4 Hs** —housing, hunger, healthcare, and higher education—because I know firsthand how difficult it is to struggle without basic necessities.

She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

Peter — with only THREE DAYS left until Election Day, here are three reasons why we need your help now more than ever.
1. **Lucas Kunce is in a STATISTICAL TIE with Josh Hawley.** This is huge news. The latest poll shows Lucas within the margin of error, only down three points behind Josh Hawley. Our chances of winning this race have never been better, and it’s why we need all the help we can get to reach voters over these last three days to close this small gap.

I can assure you that I did not feel the love while thousands of Trump’s supporters attacked the Capitol. subject: Senator Mark Kirk is Standing with Jim Carris – Please Join Him!
body:

When a Party Loses Its Way, We Choose a New One
---
[LET’S HEAL AMERICA](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-next?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=next_generation_11_2_24_1&n=4)
[](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-next?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=next_generation_11_2_24_1&n=5)
Dear Peter,
When I started this journey 16 months ago it was as a Democrat--built upon the tradition of my father and my uncle Jack Kennedy. I attended my first Democrat convention at the age of six in 1960.
Back then Democrats were champions of the Constitution and Civil Rights–they opposed forever wars. They prioritized labor and the working class; they stood for government transparency and our environment. They used to stand up against corporate greed and big money interests.
What I discovered was a political party I no longer recognized. The Democrat Party is the party that _prioritizes_ censorship, conformity, and raw political power over the “We the People.”
[Urgent: Donate Now](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-next?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=next_generation_11_2_24_1&n=6)
They will not allow debate, they will not allow challengers to the status quo–and indeed, they would not allow any candidate to take on an ailing President Joe Biden.
They forced me out, and a few months later, President Trump was nearly assassinated. After reliving my own horrible, personal memories, I was surprised when President Trump called me the next day.
Trump asked for my support to heal America, to help stem the hate that nearly took his life, and to _Make America Healthy Again_.
After that conversation, I made the decision to suspend my campaign and support the former President.
The most unifying theme for all Americans is this: We all love our children. If we all unite around that issue now, we can finally give them the healthy future they deserve.
**That is why we fight. For them.** [Help our _Make America Healthy Again_ movement accomplish just that with your support today.](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-next?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=next_generation_11_2_24_1&n=7) The election may end on Tuesday, but our movement will continue to fight for the least of these. We owe it to them. It’s time we pay it forward.
[Please consider a contribution of $20, $30, $40 or even $50](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-next?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=next_generation_11_2_24_1&n=8) or more to help us save the next generation and give them the same opportunities you and I shared.
[Urgent: Donate Now](https://www.mahanow.org/donate-em-next?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=next_generation_11_2_24_1&n=9)
Thank you again for your support and prayers,

Derek, David
McMillan here — Adam Schiff’s Little Brother.

I’m reaching out to you one last time before this consequential election
because your donation can still make a difference in turning out
California voters — [ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2907?c0=nov2024_abs_em.SALZ0e&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20241102_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=1004&akid=8131%2E5257348%2EggZgKj ]so please chip in.

Los Angeles and we filled out an application. I wished for three things: a
Big Brother, a puppy, and a beautiful world.

Adam walked in one day to volunteer, and out of all the applications, he
chose mine.

I never imagined our first day on the beach in Venice would lead to us
being in each other’s lives forever. From Adam’s wedding, my Yale
graduation, his elections to the California Senate and Congress, my career
in the entertainment industry, or him managing Trump’s impeachment and
serving on the January 6 Committee. We have been there for each other at
every big moment.

I’m not so “little” anymore, but Adam and I are still brothers because in
all of the important ways, we’re family.

Donald Trump has spent the closing weeks of this race attacking Adam as
“the enemy from within” and threatening to call out the military against
him. When Trump looks out at the world and most of the people in it, he
sees profound ugliness.

Adam and Vice President Kamala Harris see something else. They see our
country’s potential, its possibility, and its beauty. They see the
beautiful world we can create together — the one I wished for all those
years ago.

body:
| Tammy and her right-wing opponent are statistically tied.
# [](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/67?t=1&akid=4457%2E35263%2EqitV2O)
[](https://act.tammybaldwin.com/go/2155?c0=tbe-em-nov24.ANyQo7&refcode=AU_STB_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20241102_AM1_V1_S1&t=4&akid=4457%2E35263%2EqitV2O) Hi Peter, it’s Ken Burns. I’ve dedicated my life to telling America’s stories through film. They examine moments of our country in crisis and threats to our democracy. And more often than not, those stories aren’t easy ones to tell. With that in mind, it’s not difficult for me to assess that our country is at a crossroads right now, and this is the most consequential election of our lives. I’m not exaggerating when I say the stakes have never been higher: _the fate of our one-seat Democratic Senate majority — and all the progress that comes with it — lies with Wisconsin and Tammy Baldwin’s reelection._ **This is a challenge we _must_ meet.** As history shows, this race will come down to the smallest percentage of votes. And Republicans have already poured tens of millions of dollars into Tammy’s opponent in an effort to flip Wisconsin’s Senate seat and take back the Senate majority. Reproductive freedom, access to affordable health care, and our very democracy is at stake. With so much on the line, we cannot afford to lose this seat and Tammy’s leadership in the Senate. [**So Peter, will you please join me in supporting Tammy’s campaign during this critical moment by making a donation today? body:

| | | | |
#
---
| Jim Brown mocks public service and good government when he signs in using false names for his meetings at the State Auditor's office. Oddly, he recently signed in as Peter Parker aka Spiderman, and another time as Clark Kent, aka Superman. Who would do that? And why would he do that? Seems there must be something to hide...or he just has a weird obsession with superheroes.
---
[](https://repkeformontana.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6eb69d19d9c1f768256e137cf&id=4c9b8bc3fa&e=9ec0a0596f)
| Trust me, Jim Brown is no superhero to the people of Montana. As the Chair of the Public Service Commission he raised rates on Montana families and small businesses rates by 24% while corporations received millions of dollars in tax breaks. Just when all of our family budgets are tight, Jim Brown bends the knee to corporate lobbyists and gives them our money. But he's a lobbyist himself - even while drawing a taxpayer funded salary - so it pretty much fits.
Just imagine what he would do with your insurance rates. That's why he is supported by insurance company lobbyists and executives.
---
[ACT NOW](https://repkeformontana.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6eb69d19d9c1f768256e137cf&id=60622623dd&e=9ec0a0596f)
| In contrast, I will fight to make sure insurance in Montana is affordable and readily available. I'll protect seniors and prosecute fraudsters. I will be on your side and have your back.
We don't need a fake superhero cowering to insurance company lobbyists. We need a State Auditor who will fight to do what is right for Montana families. And we don't need a fraudster who uses fake name in charge of preventing fraud.
Please vote for me, John Repke, to be your next Montana State Auditor. I have the experience to do the job and the integrity to do it right.
[**If you want a State Auditor that you can rely on, we need your donation today. Can I count on you?**](https://repkeformontana.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6eb69d19d9c1f768256e137cf&id=cded5a46e6&e=9ec0a0596f)
**Best,**

subject: LAST CHANCE: Turn out voters in PA, MI, WI, NC, NV, and AZ — we need you, Peter!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by LCV Victory Fund,www
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTE3MTM2NDYS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjEwMDAyNjgxNAS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
Peter — see my message below — we’re reaching out one final time because today is the last dayof our pre-election fundraising campaign. A group of donors has pledged to
triple match all contributions up until midnight. Whether Kamala Harris or Donald Trump wins Pennsylvania, Michigan, Wisconsin,
North Carolina, Nevada, and Arizona will come down to a small number of votes. All we can do now is turn out every last voter. We have expert field teams on
the ground in each of these states. We’ve already knocked on more than THREE MILLION doors. Please, don’t wake up after the election wishing you had done more. This is truly your last chance. TRIPLE YOUR IMPACT >> https://links.messages.lcv. Don't miss this opportunity to make a triple-matched donation. Make your gift
now — even $5 makes a difference. Let's keep pushing until Election Day, no
matter what! — Pete Peter — this is it. The election is on Tuesday, and our field teams are out knocking on doors right
now to help Kamala Harris beat Donald Trump and elect environmental champions
down the ballot. I’m reaching out because their ability to keep going depends on you, Peter. Folks from all over the country have been pitching in — $5, $10, $50 — to help
turn out environmental voters. But if we’re going to win in the swing states of
Pennsylvania, Michigan, Wisconsin, North Carolina, Nevada, and Arizona — it’s going to take all of us. Our team has knocked on more than 3 MILLION doors in states that could be
decided by a small number of votes. We’re STILL reaching voters who are
undecided. Are you with us? Today is the final day of our pre-election fundraising campaign. A group of donors is triple matching every contribution until midnight. https://links.messages.lcv. MAKE YOUR 3X GIFT >> https://links.messages.lcv. You know what’s at stake. The future of our democracy — and of our planet —
comes down to what happens in the next few days. Every. Single. Vote. Counts.I’ve never seen an election polling this close — where virtually every swing
state is a true toss-up. When things are this close, victory will come down to
turnout. If the environmental movement turns out, I know we can win.And I also know that if voters who support our issues stay home, Trump will be
our next president. So we’re asking one last time today — please, help our organizers knock on
doors, call, and text to get environmental voters to the polls. It’s the final weekend before Election Day — our organizers are working around
the clock, running on cold coffee and even colder pizza. We’re asking everyone
who can to pitch in to let them know: we’re cheering you on! TRIPLE YOUR IMPACT: Help turn out environmental voters in PA, MI, WI, NC, NV, and AZ. Let our organizers know you’ve got their backs! Even $5 helps >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/8wqzCj6k4GS~ MAKE YOUR 3X GIFT >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/KybpT- Thanks, Peter — for everything you do for people and the planet! Onward, Pete Maysmith

subject: We did not come this far to lose to Kari Lake

body:
#

Hey everybody, it’s Mark Kelly. Ruben Gallego is in a tight race here in Arizona, and we’re working to support him. I hope you’ll read the message below from him, and [**consider splitting a donation between Ruben's campaign and mine.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-rg-nov24.XoCX8B&refcode=em241102-1-120&t=1&akid=5918%2E6688874%2Ef7D4fO)
---

Team —
When I was in Iraq, in urban combat, we had a special knock we’d use when we were surrounded by insurgents.
The comfort in that knock was knowing that while danger was all around you, the person on the other side of the door was friendly — someone you could depend on.
I’ve never been afraid to ask for help when I needed it. And right now, I’m knocking. I’m coming to you for help, my friend.
Kari Lake is on the offense. With just a few days until voting ends, she has a resource advantage over us. She’s got more money to spend, and she is funneling all of it into a massive surge. She’s leading us in two recent polls. **But I refuse to let her win.**
I did not swear an oath to support and defend the Constitution to lose against someone who has spread more lies and disinformation about our elections than any other politician in the country after Trump himself. [**If you’re with me, split $20.24 with me and Mark Kelly.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-rg-nov24.XoCX8B&refcode=em241102-1-120&t=2&akid=5918%2E6688874%2Ef7D4fO)
I did not lose some of my best friends in combat to cede the democracy they fought for to Trump, Lake, and the MAGA Right. This election is bigger than just who controls the House, the Senate, or the White House. It is about ensuring our democracy survives for our kids and our grandkids. [**If you’re with me, split $20.24 with me and Mark Kelly.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-rg-nov24.XoCX8B&refcode=em241102-1-120&t=3&akid=5918%2E6688874%2Ef7D4fO)
In the toughest times of my life, I have been incredibly fortunate to have the support I needed to get through. My mom, my sisters, my community, my Marines. In this campaign, I have you. **And we did not come this far to lose to Kari Lake.**
[**I can’t overstate how important this is: Please, split a $20.24 donation between Mark Kelly and me today if you are ready to help me win this campaign for U.S. Senate, hold our Senate Majority, and defend our democracy.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-rg-nov24.XoCX8B&refcode=em241102-1-120&t=4&akid=5918%2E6688874%2Ef7D4fO)

| | Peter, As you know, I'm in a razor close race against liberal Democrat Colin Allred. That's why I've been barnstorming the state and sending so many emails asking for help. I truly appreciate all you've done to support my campaign. But I still need help- _this race is still too close!_ **Why is my race so close?** Unfortunately, one reason is that my opponent Colin Allred is untruthful, and is attempting to hide his radical liberal views from Texas voters. body:

Friend,
Today was one for the books — Barbara Lee and I cast our votes at Mills College/Northeastern University in Oakland!
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=X_110224_Voting [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=X_110224_Voting] https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=X_110224_Voting [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=X_110224_Voting]
Standing there with my mentor, my friend, and my biggest supporter, I felt the weight of all we’ve worked for. It was a big moment for me, for our campaign, and for CA-12.
I’d be lying if I said it’s been easy to get here. From the start, right-wing extremists have targeted my campaign, throwing everything they can to try and stop us. They don’t see a Black woman with a vision for justice and commitment to delivering for the East Bay. They see a candidate who will stand in the way of their regressive agenda once elected.
Through it all, though, Barbara Lee has been right there with me, cheering me on every step of the way. She’s stood up for me because she believes in what we’re building together. This moment — running to continue her legacy — is one I’m ready for because of her support and yours.
And now, we’re here. Election Day is in just THREE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=X_110224_Voting] days.
After everything, it all comes down to this. Every door knocked, every conversation, every dollar you gave — it all adds up to the choice we’ll make on Tuesday. I couldn’t be more grateful to be in this fight with you.
So, let’s make it count. Can I count on you to help me in this final push by donating to my campaign before Tuesday? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=X_110224_Voting]
DONATE TODAY [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lateefah-for-congress-uplift?refcode=X_110224_Voting]
And, Friend, make your plan to vote here [https://www.sos.ca.gov/elections/] . Let’s keep pushing until the very last vote is cast.
With everything I’ve got,
Lateefah
